section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Hwæt!
text_bare: Hwæt!

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: wē Gār-Dena in geār-dagum þēod-cyninga þrym gefrūnon, hū þā æðelingas ellen fremedon.
text_bare: we Gar-Dena in gear-dagum þeod-cyninga þrym gefrunon, hu þa æðelingas ellen fremedon.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Oft Scyld Scēfing sceaðena þrēatum, monegum mǣgðum meodo-setla oftēah.
text_bare: Oft Scyld Scefing sceaðena þreatum, monegum mægðum meodo-setla ofteah.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Egsode eorl, syððan ǣrest wearð fēa-sceaft funden: hē þæs frōfre gebād, wēox under wolcnum, weorð-myndum ðāh, oð þæt him ǣghwylc þāra ymb-sittendra ofer hron-rāde hȳran scolde, gomban gyldan: þæt wæs gōd cyning!
text_bare: Egsode eorl, syððan ærest wearð fea-sceaft funden: he þæs frofre gebad, weox under wolcnum, weorð-myndum ðah, oð þæt him æghwylc þara ymb-sittendra ofer hron-rade hyran scolde, gomban gyldan: þæt wæs god cyning!

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: þǣm eafera wæs æfter cenned geong in geardum, þone god sende folce tō frōfre; fyren-þearfe ongeat, þæt hīe ǣr drugon aldor-lēase lange hwīle.
text_bare: þæm eafera wæs æfter cenned geong in geardum, þone god sende folce to frofre; fyren-þearfe ongeat, þæt hie ær drugon aldor-lease lange hwile.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Him þæs līf-frēa, wuldres wealdend, worold-āre forgeaf; Bēowulf wæs brēme blǣd wīde sprang , Scyldes eafera Scede-landum in.
text_bare: Him þæs lif-frea, wuldres wealdend, worold-are forgeaf; Beowulf wæs breme blæd wide sprang , Scyldes eafera Scede-landum in.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Swā sceal geong guma, gōde gewyrcean, fromum feoh-giftum on fæder wine, þæt hine on ylde eft gewunigen wil-gesīðas, þonne wīg cume, lēode gelǣsten: lof-dǣdum sceal in mǣgða gehwǣre man geþēon.
text_bare: Swa sceal geong guma, gode gewyrcean, fromum feoh-giftum on fæder wine, þæt hine on ylde eft gewunigen wil-gesiðas, þonne wig cume, leode gelæsten: lof-dædum sceal in mægða gehwære man geþeon.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Him þā Scyld gewāt tō gescæp-hwīle fela-hrōr fēran on frēan wǣre; hī hyne þā ætbǣron tō brimes faroðe.
text_bare: Him þa Scyld gewat to gescæp-hwile fela-hror feran on frean wære; hi hyne þa ætbæron to brimes faroðe.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: swǣse gesīðas, swā hē selfa bæd, þenden wordum wēold wine Scyldinga, lēof land-fruma lange āhte.
text_bare: swæse gesiðas, swa he selfa bæd, þenden wordum weold wine Scyldinga, leof land-fruma lange ahte.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Þǣr æt hȳðe stōd hringed-stefna, īsig and ūtfūs, æðelinges fær; ā-lēdon þā lēofne þēoden, bēaga bryttan on bearm scipes, mǣrne be mæste.
text_bare: Þær æt hyðe stod hringed-stefna, isig and utfus, æðelinges fær; a-ledon þa leofne þeoden, beaga bryttan on bearm scipes, mærne be mæste.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Þǣr wæs mādma fela, of feor-wegum frætwa gelǣded: ne hȳrde ic cȳmlīcor cēol gegyrwan hilde-wǣpnum and heaðo-wǣdum, billum and byrnum; him on bearme læg mādma mænigo, þā him mid scoldon on flōdes ǣht feor gewītan.
text_bare: Þær wæs madma fela, of feor-wegum frætwa gelæded: ne hyrde ic cymlicor ceol gegyrwan hilde-wæpnum and heaðo-wædum, billum and byrnum; him on bearme læg madma mænigo, þa him mid scoldon on flodes æht feor gewitan.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Nalas hī hine lǣssan lācum tēodan, þēod-gestrēonum, þonne þā dydon, þē hine æt frumsceafte forð onsendon ǣnne ofer ȳðe umbor wesende: þā gȳt hīe him āsetton segen gyldenne hēah ofer hēafod, lēton holm beran, gēafon on gār-secg: him wæs geōmor sefa, murnende mōd.
text_bare: Nalas hi hine læssan lacum teodan, þeod-gestreonum, þonne þa dydon, þe hine æt frumsceafte forð onsendon ænne ofer yðe umbor wesende: þa gyt hie him asetton segen gyldenne heah ofer heafod, leton holm beran, geafon on gar-secg: him wæs geomor sefa, murnende mod.

section: I. THE PASSING OF SCYLD.
text: Men ne cunnon secgan tō soðe sele-rǣdende, hæleð under heofenum, hwā þǣm hlæste onfēng.
text_bare: Men ne cunnon secgan to soðe sele-rædende, hæleð under heofenum, hwa þæm hlæste onfeng.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Þā wæs on burgum Bēowulf Scyldinga, lēof lēod-cyning, longe þrāge folcum gefrǣge fæder ellor hwearf, aldor of earde , oð þæt him eft onwōc hēah Healfdene; hēold þenden lifde, gamol and gūð-rēow, glæde Scyldingas.
text_bare: Þa wæs on burgum Beowulf Scyldinga, leof leod-cyning, longe þrage folcum gefræge fæder ellor hwearf, aldor of earde , oð þæt him eft onwoc heah Healfdene; heold þenden lifde, gamol and guð-reow, glæde Scyldingas.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Þǣm fēower bearn forð-gerīmed in worold wōcun, weoroda rǣswan, Heorogār and Hrōðgār and Hālga til; hȳrde ic, þat Elan cwēn Ongenþēowes wæs Heaðoscilfinges heals-gebedde.
text_bare: Þæm feower bearn forð-gerimed in worold wocun, weoroda ræswan, Heorogar and Hroðgar and Halga til; hyrde ic, þat Elan cwen Ongenþeowes wæs Heaðoscilfinges heals-gebedde.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Þā wæs Hrōðgāre here-spēd gyfen, wīges weorð-mynd, þæt him his wine-māgas georne hȳrdon, oð þæt sēo geogoð gewēox, mago-driht micel.
text_bare: Þa wæs Hroðgare here-sped gyfen, wiges weorð-mynd, þæt him his wine-magas georne hyrdon, oð þæt seo geogoð geweox, mago-driht micel.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Him on mōd bearn, þæt heal-reced hātan wolde, medo-ærn micel men gewyrcean, þone yldo bearn ǣfre gefrūnon, and þǣr on innan eall gedǣlan geongum and ealdum, swylc him god sealde, būton folc-scare and feorum gumena.
text_bare: Him on mod bearn, þæt heal-reced hatan wolde, medo-ærn micel men gewyrcean, þone yldo bearn æfre gefrunon, and þær on innan eall gedælan geongum and ealdum, swylc him god sealde, buton folc-scare and feorum gumena.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Þā ic wīde gefrægn weorc gebannan manigre mǣgðe geond þisne middan-geard, folc-stede frætwan.
text_bare: Þa ic wide gefrægn weorc gebannan manigre mægðe geond þisne middan-geard, folc-stede frætwan.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Him on fyrste gelomp ǣdre mid yldum, þæt hit wearð eal gearo, heal-ærna mǣst; scōp him Heort naman, sē þe his wordes geweald wīde hæfde.
text_bare: Him on fyrste gelomp ædre mid yldum, þæt hit wearð eal gearo, heal-ærna mæst; scop him Heort naman, se þe his wordes geweald wide hæfde.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Hē bēot ne ālēh, bēagas dǣlde, sinc æt symle.
text_bare: He beot ne aleh, beagas dælde, sinc æt symle.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Sele hlīfade hēah and horn-gēap: heaðo-wylma bād, lāðan līges; ne wæs hit lenge þā gēn þæt se ecg-hete āðum-swerian æfter wæl-nīðe wæcnan scolde.
text_bare: Sele hlifade heah and horn-geap: heaðo-wylma bad, laðan liges; ne wæs hit lenge þa gen þæt se ecg-hete aðum-swerian æfter wæl-niðe wæcnan scolde.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Þā se ellen-gǣst earfoðlīce þrāge geþolode, sē þe in þȳstrum bād, þæt hē dōgora gehwām drēam gehȳrde hlūdne in healle; þǣr wæs hearpan swēg, swutol sang scopes.
text_bare: Þa se ellen-gæst earfoðlice þrage geþolode, se þe in þystrum bad, þæt he dogora gehwam dream gehyrde hludne in healle; þær wæs hearpan sweg, swutol sang scopes.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Sægde sē þe cūðe frum-sceaft fīra feorran reccan, cwæð þæt se ælmihtiga eorðan worhte, wlite-beorhtne wang, swā wæter bebūgeð, gesette sige-hrēðig sunnan and mōnan lēoman tō lēohte land-būendum, and gefrætwade foldan scēatas leomum and lēafum; līf ēac gesceōp cynna gehwylcum, þāra þe cwice hwyrfað.
text_bare: Sægde se þe cuðe frum-sceaft fira feorran reccan, cwæð þæt se ælmihtiga eorðan worhte, wlite-beorhtne wang, swa wæter bebugeð, gesette sige-hreðig sunnan and monan leoman to leohte land-buendum, and gefrætwade foldan sceatas leomum and leafum; lif eac gesceop cynna gehwylcum, þara þe cwice hwyrfað.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Swā þā driht-guman drēamum lifdon ēadiglīce, oð þæt ān ongan fyrene fremman, fēond on helle: wæs se grimma gæst Grendel hāten, mǣre mearc-stapa, sē þe mōras hēold, fen and fæsten; fīfel-cynnes eard won-sǣlig wer weardode hwīle, siððan him scyppend forscrifen hæfde.
text_bare: Swa þa driht-guman dreamum lifdon eadiglice, oð þæt an ongan fyrene fremman, feond on helle: wæs se grimma gæst Grendel haten, mære mearc-stapa, se þe moras heold, fen and fæsten; fifel-cynnes eard won-sælig wer weardode hwile, siððan him scyppend forscrifen hæfde.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: In Caines cynne þone cwealm gewræc, ēce drihten, þæs þe hē Ābel slōg; ne gefeah hē þǣre fǣhðe, ac hē hine feor forwræc, metod for þȳ māne man-cynne fram.
text_bare: In Caines cynne þone cwealm gewræc, ece drihten, þæs þe he Abel slog; ne gefeah he þære fæhðe, ac he hine feor forwræc, metod for þy mane man-cynne fram.

section: II. THE HALL HEOROT.
text: Þanon untȳdras ealle onwōcon, eotenas and ylfe and orcnēas, swylce gīgantas, þā wið gode wunnon lange þrāge; hē him þæs lēan forgeald.
text_bare: Þanon untydras ealle onwocon, eotenas and ylfe and orcneas, swylce gigantas, þa wið gode wunnon lange þrage; he him þæs lean forgeald.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Gewāt þā nēosian, syððan niht becōm, hēan hūses, hū hit Hring-Dene æfter bēor-þege gebūn hæfdon.
text_bare: Gewat þa neosian, syððan niht becom, hean huses, hu hit Hring-Dene æfter beor-þege gebun hæfdon.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Fand þā þǣr inne æðelinga gedriht swefan æfter symble; sorge ne cūðon, won-sceaft wera.
text_bare: Fand þa þær inne æðelinga gedriht swefan æfter symble; sorge ne cuðon, won-sceaft wera.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Wiht unhǣlo grim and grǣdig gearo sōna wæs, rēoc and rēðe, and on ræste genam þrītig þegna: þanon eft gewāt hūðe hrēmig tō hām faran, mid þǣre wæl-fylle wīca nēosan.
text_bare: Wiht unhælo grim and grædig gearo sona wæs, reoc and reðe, and on ræste genam þritig þegna: þanon eft gewat huðe hremig to ham faran, mid þære wæl-fylle wica neosan.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Þā wæs on ūhtan mid ǣr-dæge Grendles gūð-cræft gumum undyrne: þā wæs æfter wiste wōp up āhafen, micel morgen-swēg.
text_bare: Þa wæs on uhtan mid ær-dæge Grendles guð-cræft gumum undyrne: þa wæs æfter wiste wop up ahafen, micel morgen-sweg.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Mǣre þēoden, æðeling ǣr-gōd, unblīðe sæt, þolode þrȳð-swȳð, þegn-sorge drēah, syððan hīe þæs lāðan lāst scēawedon, wergan gāstes; wæs þæt gewin tō strang, lāð and longsum.
text_bare: Mære þeoden, æðeling ær-god, unbliðe sæt, þolode þryð-swyð, þegn-sorge dreah, syððan hie þæs laðan last sceawedon, wergan gastes; wæs þæt gewin to strang, lað and longsum.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Næs hit lengra fyrst, ac ymb āne niht eft gefremede morð-beala māre and nō mearn fore fǣhðe and fyrene; wæs tō fæst on þām.
text_bare: Næs hit lengra fyrst, ac ymb ane niht eft gefremede morð-beala mare and no mearn fore fæhðe and fyrene; wæs to fæst on þam.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Þā wæs ēað-fynde, þē him elles hwǣr gerūmlīcor ræste sōhte, bed æfter būrum, þā him gebēacnod wæs, gesægd sōðlīce sweotolan tācne heal-þegnes hete; hēold hine syððan fyr and fæstor, sē þǣm fēonde ætwand.
text_bare: Þa wæs eað-fynde, þe him elles hwær gerumlicor ræste sohte, bed æfter burum, þa him gebeacnod wæs, gesægd soðlice sweotolan tacne heal-þegnes hete; heold hine syððan fyr and fæstor, se þæm feonde ætwand.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Swā rīxode and wið rihte wan āna wið eallum, oð þæt īdel stōd hūsa sēlest.
text_bare: Swa rixode and wið rihte wan ana wið eallum, oð þæt idel stod husa selest.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Wæs sēo hwīl micel: twelf wintra tīd torn geþolode wine Scyldinga, wēana gehwelcne, sīdra sorga; forþām syððan wearð ylda bearnum undyrne cūð, gyddum geōmore, þætte Grendel wan, hwīle wið Hrōðgār;— hete-nīðas wæg, fyrene and fǣhðe fela missēra, singāle sæce, sibbe ne wolde wið manna hwone mægenes Deniga feorh-bealo feorran, fēo þingian, nē þǣr nǣnig witena wēnan þorfte beorhtre bōte tō banan folmum; atol ǣglǣca ēhtende wæs, deorc dēað-scūa duguðe and geogoðe seomade and syrede.
text_bare: Wæs seo hwil micel: twelf wintra tid torn geþolode wine Scyldinga, weana gehwelcne, sidra sorga; forþam syððan wearð ylda bearnum undyrne cuð, gyddum geomore, þætte Grendel wan, hwile wið Hroðgar;— hete-niðas wæg, fyrene and fæhðe fela missera, singale sæce, sibbe ne wolde wið manna hwone mægenes Deniga feorh-bealo feorran, feo þingian, ne þær nænig witena wenan þorfte beorhtre bote to banan folmum; atol æglæca ehtende wæs, deorc deað-scua duguðe and geogoðe seomade and syrede.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Sin-nihte hēold mistige mōras; men ne cunnon, hwyder hel-rūnan hwyrftum scrīðað.
text_bare: Sin-nihte heold mistige moras; men ne cunnon, hwyder hel-runan hwyrftum scriðað.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Swā fela fyrena fēond man-cynnes, atol ān-gengea, oft gefremede heardra hȳnða; Heorot eardode, sinc-fāge sel sweartum nihtum nō hē þone gif-stōl grētan mōste, māððum for metode, nē his myne wisse ; þæt wæs wrǣc micel wine Scyldinga, mōdes brecða.
text_bare: Swa fela fyrena feond man-cynnes, atol an-gengea, oft gefremede heardra hynða; Heorot eardode, sinc-fage sel sweartum nihtum no he þone gif-stol gretan moste, maððum for metode, ne his myne wisse ; þæt wæs wræc micel wine Scyldinga, modes brecða.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Monig-oft gesæt rīce tō rūne; rǣd eahtedon, hwæt swīð-ferhðum sēlest wǣre wið fǣr-gryrum tō gefremmanne.
text_bare: Monig-oft gesæt rice to rune; ræd eahtedon, hwæt swið-ferhðum selest wære wið fær-gryrum to gefremmanne.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Hwīlum hīe gehēton æt hærg-trafum wīg-weorðunga, wordum bǣdon, þæt him gāst-bona gēoce gefremede wið þēod-þrēaum.
text_bare: Hwilum hie geheton æt hærg-trafum wig-weorðunga, wordum bædon, þæt him gast-bona geoce gefremede wið þeod-þreaum.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Swylc wæs þēaw hyra, hǣðenra hyht; helle gemundon in mōd-sefan, metod hīe ne cūðon, dǣda dēmend, ne wiston hīe drihten god, nē hīe hūru heofena helm herian ne cūðon, wuldres waldend.
text_bare: Swylc wæs þeaw hyra, hæðenra hyht; helle gemundon in mod-sefan, metod hie ne cuðon, dæda demend, ne wiston hie drihten god, ne hie huru heofena helm herian ne cuðon, wuldres waldend.

section: III. GRENDEL'S VISITS.
text: Wā bið þǣm þe sceal þurh slīðne nīð sāwle bescūfan in fȳres fæðm, frōfre ne wēnan, wihte gewendan; wēl bið þǣm þe mōt æfter dēað-dæge drihten sēcean and tō fæder fæðmum freoðo wilnian.
text_bare: Wa bið þæm þe sceal þurh sliðne nið sawle bescufan in fyres fæðm, frofre ne wenan, wihte gewendan; wel bið þæm þe mot æfter deað-dæge drihten secean and to fæder fæðmum freoðo wilnian.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Swā þā mǣl-ceare maga Healfdenes singāla sēað; ne mihte snotor hæleð wēan onwendan: wæs þæt gewin tō swȳð, lāð and longsum, þē on þā lēode becōm, nȳd-wracu nīð-grim, niht-bealwa mǣst.
text_bare: Swa þa mæl-ceare maga Healfdenes singala seað; ne mihte snotor hæleð wean onwendan: wæs þæt gewin to swyð, lað and longsum, þe on þa leode becom, nyd-wracu nið-grim, niht-bealwa mæst.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Þæt fram hām gefrægn Higelāces þegn, gōd mid Gēatum, Grendles dǣda: sē wæs mon-cynnes mægenes strengest on þǣm dæge þysses līfes, æðele and ēacen.
text_bare: Þæt fram ham gefrægn Higelaces þegn, god mid Geatum, Grendles dæda: se wæs mon-cynnes mægenes strengest on þæm dæge þysses lifes, æðele and eacen.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Hēt him ȳð-lidan gōdne gegyrwan; cwæð hē gūð-cyning ofer swan-rāde sēcean wolde, mǣrne þēoden, þā him wæs manna þearf.
text_bare: Het him yð-lidan godne gegyrwan; cwæð he guð-cyning ofer swan-rade secean wolde, mærne þeoden, þa him wæs manna þearf.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Þone sīð-fæt him snotere ceorlas lȳt-hwōn lōgon, þēah hē him lēof wǣre; hwetton higerōfne, hǣl scēawedon.
text_bare: Þone sið-fæt him snotere ceorlas lyt-hwon logon, þeah he him leof wære; hwetton higerofne, hæl sceawedon.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Hæfde se gōda Gēata lēoda cempan gecorone, þāra þe hē cēnoste findan mihte; fīftȳna sum sund-wudu sōhte; secg wīsade, lagu-cræftig mon, land-gemyrcu.
text_bare: Hæfde se goda Geata leoda cempan gecorone, þara þe he cenoste findan mihte; fiftyna sum sund-wudu sohte; secg wisade, lagu-cræftig mon, land-gemyrcu.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Fyrst forð gewāt: flota wæs on ȳðum, bāt under beorge.
text_bare: Fyrst forð gewat: flota wæs on yðum, bat under beorge.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Beornas gearwe on stefn stigon; strēamas wundon sund wið sande; secgas bǣron on bearm nacan beorhte frætwe, gūð-searo geatolīc; guman ūt scufon, weras on wil-sīð wudu bundenne.
text_bare: Beornas gearwe on stefn stigon; streamas wundon sund wið sande; secgas bæron on bearm nacan beorhte frætwe, guð-searo geatolic; guman ut scufon, weras on wil-sið wudu bundenne.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Gewāt þā ofer wǣg-holm winde gefȳsed flota fāmig-heals fugle gelīcost, oð þæt ymb ān-tīd ōðres dōgores wunden-stefna gewaden hæfde, þæt þā līðende land gesāwon, brim-clifu blīcan, beorgas stēape, sīde sǣ-næssas: þā wæs sund liden, eoletes æt ende.
text_bare: Gewat þa ofer wæg-holm winde gefysed flota famig-heals fugle gelicost, oð þæt ymb an-tid oðres dogores wunden-stefna gewaden hæfde, þæt þa liðende land gesawon, brim-clifu blican, beorgas steape, side sæ-næssas: þa wæs sund liden, eoletes æt ende.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Þanon up hraðe Wedera lēode on wang stigon, sǣ-wudu sǣldon syrcan hrysedon, gūð-gewǣdo ; gode þancedon, þæs þe him ȳð-lāde ēaðe wurdon.
text_bare: Þanon up hraðe Wedera leode on wang stigon, sæ-wudu sældon syrcan hrysedon, guð-gewædo ; gode þancedon, þæs þe him yð-lade eaðe wurdon.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Þā of wealle geseah weard Scildinga, sē þe holm-clifu healdan scolde, beran ofer bolcan beorhte randas, fyrd-searu fūslīcu; hine fyrwyt bræc mōd-gehygdum, hwæt þā men wǣron.
text_bare: Þa of wealle geseah weard Scildinga, se þe holm-clifu healdan scolde, beran ofer bolcan beorhte randas, fyrd-searu fuslicu; hine fyrwyt bræc mod-gehygdum, hwæt þa men wæron.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Gewāt him þā tō waroðe wicge rīdan þegn Hrōðgāres, þrymmum cwehte mægen-wudu mundum, meðel-wordum frægn: "Hwæt syndon gē searo-hæbbendra "byrnum werede, þē þus brontne cēol "ofer lagu-strǣte lǣdan cwōmon, "hider ofer holmas helmas bǣron?
text_bare: Gewat him þa to waroðe wicge ridan þegn Hroðgares, þrymmum cwehte mægen-wudu mundum, meðel-wordum frægn: "Hwæt syndon ge searo-hæbbendra "byrnum werede, þe þus brontne ceol "ofer lagu-stræte lædan cwomon, "hider ofer holmas helmas bæron?

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: "Ic wæs ende-sǣta, ǣg-wearde hēold, "þæt on land Dena lāðra nǣnig "mid scip-herge sceððan ne meahte.
text_bare: "Ic wæs ende-sæta, æg-wearde heold, "þæt on land Dena laðra nænig "mid scip-herge sceððan ne meahte.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: "Nō hēr cūðlīcor cuman ongunnon "lind-hæbbende; nē gē lēafnes-word "gūð-fremmendra gearwe ne wisson, "māga gemēdu.
text_bare: "No her cuðlicor cuman ongunnon "lind-hæbbende; ne ge leafnes-word "guð-fremmendra gearwe ne wisson, "maga gemedu.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Nǣfre ic māran geseah "eorla ofer eorðan, þonne is ēower sum, "secg on searwum; nis þæt seld-guma "wǣpnum geweorðad, næfne him his wlite lēoge, "ǣnlīc an-sȳn.
text_bare: Næfre ic maran geseah "eorla ofer eorðan, þonne is eower sum, "secg on searwum; nis þæt seld-guma "wæpnum geweorðad, næfne him his wlite leoge, "ænlic an-syn.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Nū ic ēower sceal "frum-cyn witan, ǣr gē fyr heonan "lēase scēaweras on land Dena "furður fēran.
text_bare: Nu ic eower sceal "frum-cyn witan, ær ge fyr heonan "lease sceaweras on land Dena "furður feran.

section: IV. HYGELAC'S THANE.
text: Nū gē feor-būend, "mere-līðende, mīnne gehȳrað "ān-fealdne geþōht: ofost is sēlest "tō gecȳðanne, hwanan ēowre cyme syndon."
text_bare: Nu ge feor-buend, "mere-liðende, minne gehyrað "an-fealdne geþoht: ofost is selest "to gecyðanne, hwanan eowre cyme syndon."

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: Him se yldesta andswarode, werodes wīsa, word-hord onlēac: "Wē synt gum-cynnes Gēata lēode "and Higelāces heorð-genēatas.
text_bare: Him se yldesta andswarode, werodes wisa, word-hord onleac: "We synt gum-cynnes Geata leode "and Higelaces heorð-geneatas.

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: "Wæs mīn fæder folcum gecȳðed, "æðele ord-fruma Ecgþēow hāten; "gebād wintra worn, ǣr hē on weg hwurfe, "gamol of geardum; hine gearwe geman "witena wēl-hwylc wīde geond eorðan.— "Wē þurh holdne hige hlāford þinne, "sunu Healfdenes, sēcean cwōmon, "lēod-gebyrgean: wes þū ūs lārena gōd!
text_bare: "Wæs min fæder folcum gecyðed, "æðele ord-fruma Ecgþeow haten; "gebad wintra worn, ær he on weg hwurfe, "gamol of geardum; hine gearwe geman "witena wel-hwylc wide geond eorðan.— "We þurh holdne hige hlaford þinne, "sunu Healfdenes, secean cwomon, "leod-gebyrgean: wes þu us larena god!

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: "Habbað wē tō þǣm mǣran micel ǣrende "Deniga frēan; ne sceal þǣr dyrne sum "wesan, þæs ic wēne.
text_bare: "Habbað we to þæm mæran micel ærende "Deniga frean; ne sceal þær dyrne sum "wesan, þæs ic wene.

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: Þū wāst, gif hit is, "swā wē sōðlice secgan hȳrdon, "þæt mid Scyldingum sceaða ic nāt hwylc, "dēogol dǣd-hata, deorcum nihtum "ēaweð þurh egsan uncūðne nīð, "hȳnðu and hrā-fyl.
text_bare: Þu wast, gif hit is, "swa we soðlice secgan hyrdon, "þæt mid Scyldingum sceaða ic nat hwylc, "deogol dæd-hata, deorcum nihtum "eaweð þurh egsan uncuðne nið, "hynðu and hra-fyl.

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: Ic þæs Hrōðgār mæg "þurh rūmne sefan rǣd gelǣran, "hū hē frōd and gōd fēond oferswȳðeð, "gyf him ed-wendan ǣfre scolde "bealuwa bisigu, bōt eft cuman "and þā cear-wylmas cōlran wurðað; "oððe ā syððan earfoð-þrāge, "þrēa-nȳd þolað, þenden þǣr wunað "on hēah-stede hūsa sēlest." Weard maðelode, þǣr on wicge sæt ombeht unforht: "Ǣghwæðres sceal "scearp scyld-wiga gescād witan, "worda and worca, sē þe wēl þenceð.
text_bare: Ic þæs Hroðgar mæg "þurh rumne sefan ræd gelæran, "hu he frod and god feond oferswyðeð, "gyf him ed-wendan æfre scolde "bealuwa bisigu, bot eft cuman "and þa cear-wylmas colran wurðað; "oððe a syððan earfoð-þrage, "þrea-nyd þolað, þenden þær wunað "on heah-stede husa selest." Weard maðelode, þær on wicge sæt ombeht unforht: "Æghwæðres sceal "scearp scyld-wiga gescad witan, "worda and worca, se þe wel þenceð.

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: "Ic þæt gehȳre, þæt þis is hold weorod "frēan Scyldinga.
text_bare: "Ic þæt gehyre, þæt þis is hold weorod "frean Scyldinga.

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: Gewītað forð beran "wǣpen and gewǣdu, ic ēow wīsige: "swylce ic magu-þegnas mīne hāte "wið fēonda gehwone flotan ēowerne, "nīw-tyrwedne nacan on sande "ārum healdan, oð þæt eft byreð "ofer lagu-strēamas lēofne mannan "wudu wunden-hals tō Weder-mearce.
text_bare: Gewitað forð beran "wæpen and gewædu, ic eow wisige: "swylce ic magu-þegnas mine hate "wið feonda gehwone flotan eowerne, "niw-tyrwedne nacan on sande "arum healdan, oð þæt eft byreð "ofer lagu-streamas leofne mannan "wudu wunden-hals to Weder-mearce.

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: "Gūð-fremmendra swylcum gifeðe bið, "þæt þone hilde-rǣs hāl gedīgeð." Gewiton him þā fēran flota stille bād, seomode on sāle sīd-fæðmed scyp, on ancre fæst ; eofor-līc scionon ofer hlēor-beran gehroden golde fāh and fȳr-heard, ferh wearde hēold.
text_bare: "Guð-fremmendra swylcum gifeðe bið, "þæt þone hilde-ræs hal gedigeð." Gewiton him þa feran flota stille bad, seomode on sale sid-fæðmed scyp, on ancre fæst ; eofor-lic scionon ofer hleor-beran gehroden golde fah and fyr-heard, ferh wearde heold.

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: Gūðmōde grummon, guman ōnetton, sigon ætsomne, oð þæt hȳ sæl timbred geatolīc and gold-fāh ongytan mihton; þæt wæs fore-mǣrost fold-būendum receda under roderum, on þǣm se rīca bād; līxte se lēoma ofer landa fela.
text_bare: Guðmode grummon, guman onetton, sigon ætsomne, oð þæt hy sæl timbred geatolic and gold-fah ongytan mihton; þæt wæs fore-mærost fold-buendum receda under roderum, on þæm se rica bad; lixte se leoma ofer landa fela.

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: Him þā hilde-dēor hof mōdigra torht getǣhte, þæt hīe him tō mihton gegnum gangan; gūð-beorna sum wicg gewende, word æfter cwæð: "Mǣl is mē tō fēran; fæder alwalda "mid ār-stafum ēowic gehealde "sīða gesunde!
text_bare: Him þa hilde-deor hof modigra torht getæhte, þæt hie him to mihton gegnum gangan; guð-beorna sum wicg gewende, word æfter cwæð: "Mæl is me to feran; fæder alwalda "mid ar-stafum eowic gehealde "siða gesunde!

section: V. THE ERRAND.
text: ic tō sǣ wille, "wið wrāð werod wearde healdan."
text_bare: ic to sæ wille, "wið wrað werod wearde healdan."

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: Strǣt wæs stān-fāh, stīg wīsode gumum ætgædere.
text_bare: Stræt wæs stan-fah, stig wisode gumum ætgædere.

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: Gūð-byrne scān heard hond-locen, hring-īren scīr song in searwum, þā hīe tō sele furðum in hyra gryre-geatwum gangan cwōmon.
text_bare: Guð-byrne scan heard hond-locen, hring-iren scir song in searwum, þa hie to sele furðum in hyra gryre-geatwum gangan cwomon.

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: Setton sǣ-mēðe sīde scyldas, rondas regn-hearde wið þæs recedes weal, bugon þā tō bence; byrnan hringdon, gūð-searo gumena; gāras stōdon, sǣ-manna searo, samod ætgædere, æsc-holt ufan grǣg: wæs se īren-þrēat wǣpnum gewurðad.
text_bare: Setton sæ-meðe side scyldas, rondas regn-hearde wið þæs recedes weal, bugon þa to bence; byrnan hringdon, guð-searo gumena; garas stodon, sæ-manna searo, samod ætgædere, æsc-holt ufan græg: wæs se iren-þreat wæpnum gewurðad.

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: Þā þǣr wlonc hæleð ōret-mecgas æfter æðelum frægn: "Hwanon ferigeað gē fǣtte scyldas, "grǣge syrcan and grīm-helmas, "here-sceafta hēap?— Ic eom Hrōðgāres "ār and ombiht.
text_bare: Þa þær wlonc hæleð oret-mecgas æfter æðelum frægn: "Hwanon ferigeað ge fætte scyldas, "græge syrcan and grim-helmas, "here-sceafta heap?— Ic eom Hroðgares "ar and ombiht.

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: Ne seah ic el-þēodige "þus manige men mōdiglīcran.
text_bare: Ne seah ic el-þeodige "þus manige men modiglicran.

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: "Wēn' ic þæt gē for wlenco, nalles for wræc-sīðum, "ac for hige-þrymmum Hrōðgār sōhton." Him þā ellen-rōf andswarode, wlanc Wedera lēod word æfter spræc, heard under helme: "Wē synt Higelāces "bēod-genēatas; Bēowulf is mīn nama.
text_bare: "Wen' ic þæt ge for wlenco, nalles for wræc-siðum, "ac for hige-þrymmum Hroðgar sohton." Him þa ellen-rof andswarode, wlanc Wedera leod word æfter spræc, heard under helme: "We synt Higelaces "beod-geneatas; Beowulf is min nama.

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: "Wille ic āsecgan suna Healfdenes, "mǣrum þēodne mīn ǣrende, "aldre þīnum, gif hē ūs geunnan wile, "þæt wē hine swā gōdne grētan mōton." Wulfgār maðelode þæt wæs Wendla lēod, wæs his mōd-sefa manegum gecȳðed, wīg and wīs-dōm : "ic þæs wine Deniga, "frēan Scildinga frīnan wille, "bēaga bryttan, swā þū bēna eart, "þēoden mǣrne ymb þīnne sīð ; "and þē þā andsware ǣdre gecȳðan, "þē mē se gōda āgifan þenceð." Hwearf þā hrædlīce, þǣr Hrōðgār sæt, eald and unhār mid his eorla gedriht; ēode ellen-rōf, þæt hē for eaxlum gestōd Deniga frēan, cūðe hē duguðe þēaw.
text_bare: "Wille ic asecgan suna Healfdenes, "mærum þeodne min ærende, "aldre þinum, gif he us geunnan wile, "þæt we hine swa godne gretan moton." Wulfgar maðelode þæt wæs Wendla leod, wæs his mod-sefa manegum gecyðed, wig and wis-dom : "ic þæs wine Deniga, "frean Scildinga frinan wille, "beaga bryttan, swa þu bena eart, "þeoden mærne ymb þinne sið ; "and þe þa andsware ædre gecyðan, "þe me se goda agifan þenceð." Hwearf þa hrædlice, þær Hroðgar sæt, eald and unhar mid his eorla gedriht; eode ellen-rof, þæt he for eaxlum gestod Deniga frean, cuðe he duguðe þeaw.

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: Wulfgār maðelode tō his wine-drihtne: "Hēr syndon geferede feorran cumene "ofer geofenes begang Gēata lēode: "þone yldestan ōret-mecgas "Bēowulf nemnað.
text_bare: Wulfgar maðelode to his wine-drihtne: "Her syndon geferede feorran cumene "ofer geofenes begang Geata leode: "þone yldestan oret-mecgas "Beowulf nemnað.

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: Hȳ bēnan synt, "þæt hīe, þēoden mīn, wið þē mōton "wordum wrixlan; nō þū him wearne getēoh, "þīnra gegn-cwida glædnian, Hrōðgār!
text_bare: Hy benan synt, "þæt hie, þeoden min, wið þe moton "wordum wrixlan; no þu him wearne geteoh, "þinra gegn-cwida glædnian, Hroðgar!

section: VI. BEOWULF'S SPEECH.
text: "Hȳ on wīg-geatwum wyrðe þinceað "eorla geæhtlan; hūru se aldor dēah, "sē þǣm heaðo-rincum hider wīsade."
text_bare: "Hy on wig-geatwum wyrðe þinceað "eorla geæhtlan; huru se aldor deah, "se þæm heaðo-rincum hider wisade."

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: Hrōðgār maðelode, helm Scyldinga: "Ic hine cūðe cniht-wesende.
text_bare: Hroðgar maðelode, helm Scyldinga: "Ic hine cuðe cniht-wesende.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: "Wæs his eald-fæder Ecgþēo hāten, "þǣm tō hām forgeaf Hrēðel Gēata "āngan dōhtor; is his eafora nū "heard hēr cumen, sōhte holdne wine.
text_bare: "Wæs his eald-fæder Ecgþeo haten, "þæm to ham forgeaf Hreðel Geata "angan dohtor; is his eafora nu "heard her cumen, sohte holdne wine.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: "þonne sægdon þæt sǣ-līðende, "þā þe gif-sceattas Gēata fyredon "þyder tō þance, þæt hē þrīttiges "manna mægen-cræft on his mund-grīpe "heaðo-rōf hæbbe.
text_bare: "þonne sægdon þæt sæ-liðende, "þa þe gif-sceattas Geata fyredon "þyder to þance, þæt he þrittiges "manna mægen-cræft on his mund-gripe "heaðo-rof hæbbe.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: Hine hālig god "for ār-stafum us onsende, "tō West-Denum, þæs ic wēn hæbbe, "wið Grendles gryre: ic þǣm gōdan sceal "for his mōd-þræce mādmas bēodan.
text_bare: Hine halig god "for ar-stafum us onsende, "to West-Denum, þæs ic wen hæbbe, "wið Grendles gryre: ic þæm godan sceal "for his mod-þræce madmas beodan.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: "Bēo þū on ofeste, hāt hig in gān, "sēon sibbe-gedriht samod ætgædere; "gesaga him ēac wordum, þæt hīe sint wil-cuman "Deniga lēodum." Þā wið duru healle Wulfgār ēode, word inne ābēad: "Ēow hēt secgan sige-drihten mīn, "aldor Ēast-Dena, þæt hē ēower æðelu can "and gē him syndon ofer sǣ-wylmas, "heard-hicgende, hider wil-cuman.
text_bare: "Beo þu on ofeste, hat hig in gan, "seon sibbe-gedriht samod ætgædere; "gesaga him eac wordum, þæt hie sint wil-cuman "Deniga leodum." Þa wið duru healle Wulfgar eode, word inne abead: "Eow het secgan sige-drihten min, "aldor East-Dena, þæt he eower æðelu can "and ge him syndon ofer sæ-wylmas, "heard-hicgende, hider wil-cuman.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: "Nū gē mōton gangan in ēowrum guð-geatawum, "under here-grīman, Hrōðgār gesēon; "lǣtað hilde-bord hēr onbidian, "wudu wæl-sceaftas, worda geþinges." Ārās þā se rīca, ymb hine rinc manig, þrȳðlīc þegna hēap; sume þǣr bidon, heaðo-rēaf hēoldon, swā him se hearda bebēad.
text_bare: "Nu ge moton gangan in eowrum guð-geatawum, "under here-griman, Hroðgar geseon; "lætað hilde-bord her onbidian, "wudu wæl-sceaftas, worda geþinges." Aras þa se rica, ymb hine rinc manig, þryðlic þegna heap; sume þær bidon, heaðo-reaf heoldon, swa him se hearda bebead.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: Snyredon ætsomne, þā secg wīsode under Heorotes hrōf; hyge-rōf ēode, heard under helme, þæt hē on heoðe gestōd.
text_bare: Snyredon ætsomne, þa secg wisode under Heorotes hrof; hyge-rof eode, heard under helme, þæt he on heoðe gestod.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: Bēowulf maðelode on him byrne scān, searo-net sēowed smiðes or-þancum : "Wes þū Hrōðgār hāl!
text_bare: Beowulf maðelode on him byrne scan, searo-net seowed smiðes or-þancum : "Wes þu Hroðgar hal!

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: ic eom Higelāces "mǣg and mago-þegn; hæbbe ic mǣrða fela "ongunnen on geogoðe.
text_bare: ic eom Higelaces "mæg and mago-þegn; hæbbe ic mærða fela "ongunnen on geogoðe.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: Mē wearð Grendles þing "on mīnre ēðel-tyrf undyrne cūð: "secgað sǣ-līðend, þæt þes sele stande, "reced sēlesta, rinca gehwylcum "īdel and unnyt, siððan ǣfen-lēoht "under heofenes hādor beholen weorðeð.
text_bare: Me wearð Grendles þing "on minre eðel-tyrf undyrne cuð: "secgað sæ-liðend, þæt þes sele stande, "reced selesta, rinca gehwylcum "idel and unnyt, siððan æfen-leoht "under heofenes hador beholen weorðeð.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: "Þā mē þæt gelǣrdon lēode mīne, "þā sēlestan, snotere ceorlas, "þēoden Hrōðgār, þæt ic þē sōhte; "forþan hīe mægenes cræft mīnne cūðon: "selfe ofersāwon, þā ic of searwum cwōm, "fāh from fēondum, þǣr ic fīfe geband, "ȳðde eotena cyn, and on ȳðum slōg "niceras nihtes, nearo-þearfe drēah, "wræc Wedera nīð wēan āhsodon "forgrand gramum; and nū wið Grendel sceal, "wið þām āglǣcan, āna gehegan "þing wið þyrse.
text_bare: "Þa me þæt gelærdon leode mine, "þa selestan, snotere ceorlas, "þeoden Hroðgar, þæt ic þe sohte; "forþan hie mægenes cræft minne cuðon: "selfe ofersawon, þa ic of searwum cwom, "fah from feondum, þær ic fife geband, "yðde eotena cyn, and on yðum slog "niceras nihtes, nearo-þearfe dreah, "wræc Wedera nið wean ahsodon "forgrand gramum; and nu wið Grendel sceal, "wið þam aglæcan, ana gehegan "þing wið þyrse.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: Ic þē nū þā, "brego Beorht-Dena, biddan wille, "eodor Scyldinga, ānre bēne; "þæt þū mē ne forwyrne, wīgendra hlēo, "frēo-wine folca, nū ic þus feorran cōm, "þæt ic mōte āna and mīnra eorla gedryht, "þes hearda hēap, Heorot fǣlsian.
text_bare: Ic þe nu þa, "brego Beorht-Dena, biddan wille, "eodor Scyldinga, anre bene; "þæt þu me ne forwyrne, wigendra hleo, "freo-wine folca, nu ic þus feorran com, "þæt ic mote ana and minra eorla gedryht, "þes hearda heap, Heorot fælsian.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: "Hæbbe ic ēac geāhsod, þæt se ǣglǣca "for his won-hȳdum wǣpna ne rēceð; "ic þæt þonne forhicge, swā mē Higelāc sīe, "mīn mon-drihten, mōdes blīðe, "þæt ic sweord bere oððe sīdne scyld "geolo-rand tō gūðe; ac ic mid grāpe sceal "fōn wið fēonde and ymb feorh sacan, "lāð wið lāðum; þǣr gelȳfan sceal "dryhtnes dōme sē þe hine dēað nimeð.
text_bare: "Hæbbe ic eac geahsod, þæt se æglæca "for his won-hydum wæpna ne receð; "ic þæt þonne forhicge, swa me Higelac sie, "min mon-drihten, modes bliðe, "þæt ic sweord bere oððe sidne scyld "geolo-rand to guðe; ac ic mid grape sceal "fon wið feonde and ymb feorh sacan, "lað wið laðum; þær gelyfan sceal "dryhtnes dome se þe hine deað nimeð.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: "Wēn' ic þæt hē wille, gif hē wealdan mōt, "in þǣm gūð-sele Gēatena lēode "etan unforhte, swā hē oft dyde "mægen Hrēðmanna.
text_bare: "Wen' ic þæt he wille, gif he wealdan mot, "in þæm guð-sele Geatena leode "etan unforhte, swa he oft dyde "mægen Hreðmanna.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: Nā þū mīnne þearft "hafalan hȳdan, ac hē mē habban wile "drēore fāhne, gif mec dēað nimeð; "byreð blōdig wæl, byrgean þenceð, "eteð ān-genga unmurnlīce, "mearcað mōr-hopu: nō þū ymb mīnes ne þearft "līces feorme leng sorgian.
text_bare: Na þu minne þearft "hafalan hydan, ac he me habban wile "dreore fahne, gif mec deað nimeð; "byreð blodig wæl, byrgean þenceð, "eteð an-genga unmurnlice, "mearcað mor-hopu: no þu ymb mines ne þearft "lices feorme leng sorgian.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: "Onsend Higelāce, gif mec hild nime, "beadu-scrūda betst, þæt mīne brēost wereð, "hrægla sēlest; þæt is Hrēðlan lāf, "Wēlandes geweorc.
text_bare: "Onsend Higelace, gif mec hild nime, "beadu-scruda betst, þæt mine breost wereð, "hrægla selest; þæt is Hreðlan laf, "Welandes geweorc.

section: VII. HROTHGAR'S WELCOME.
text: Gǣð ā Wyrd swā hīo scel!"
text_bare: Gæð a Wyrd swa hio scel!"

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: Hrōðgār maðelode, helm Scyldinga: "for were-fyhtum þū, wine mīn Bēowulf, "and for ār-stafum ūsic sōhtest.
text_bare: Hroðgar maðelode, helm Scyldinga: "for were-fyhtum þu, wine min Beowulf, "and for ar-stafum usic sohtest.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: "Geslōh þin fæder fǣhðe mǣste, "wearð hē Heaðolāfe tō hand-bonan "mid Wilfingum; þā hine Wedera cyn "for here-brōgan habban ne mihte.
text_bare: "Gesloh þin fæder fæhðe mæste, "wearð he Heaðolafe to hand-bonan "mid Wilfingum; þa hine Wedera cyn "for here-brogan habban ne mihte.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: "Þanon hē gesōhte Sūð-Dena folc "ofer ȳða gewealc, Ār-Scyldinga; "þā ic furðum wēold folce Deninga, "and on geogoðe hēold gimme-rīce "hord-burh hæleða: þā wæs Heregār dēad, "mīn yldra mǣg unlifigende, "bearn Healfdenes.
text_bare: "Þanon he gesohte Suð-Dena folc "ofer yða gewealc, Ar-Scyldinga; "þa ic furðum weold folce Deninga, "and on geogoðe heold gimme-rice "hord-burh hæleða: þa wæs Heregar dead, "min yldra mæg unlifigende, "bearn Healfdenes.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: Sē wæs betera þonne ic!
text_bare: Se wæs betera þonne ic!

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: "Siððan þā fǣhðe fēo þingode; "sende ic Wylfingum ofer wæteres hrycg "ealde mādmas: hē mē āðas swōr.
text_bare: "Siððan þa fæhðe feo þingode; "sende ic Wylfingum ofer wæteres hrycg "ealde madmas: he me aðas swor.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: "Sorh is mē tō secganne on sefan mīnum "gumena ǣngum, hwæt mē Grendel hafað "hȳnðo on Heorote mid his hete-þancum, "fǣr-nīða gefremed.
text_bare: "Sorh is me to secganne on sefan minum "gumena ængum, hwæt me Grendel hafað "hynðo on Heorote mid his hete-þancum, "fær-niða gefremed.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: Is mīn flet-werod, "wīg-hēap gewanod; hīe Wyrd forswēop "on Grendles gryre.
text_bare: Is min flet-werod, "wig-heap gewanod; hie Wyrd forsweop "on Grendles gryre.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: God ēaðe mæg "þone dol-scaðan dǣda getwǣfan!
text_bare: God eaðe mæg "þone dol-scaðan dæda getwæfan!

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: "Ful oft gebēotedon bēore druncne "ofer ealo-wǣge ōret-mecgas, "þæt hīe in bēor-sele bīdan woldon "Grendles gūðe mid gryrum ecga.
text_bare: "Ful oft gebeotedon beore druncne "ofer ealo-wæge oret-mecgas, "þæt hie in beor-sele bidan woldon "Grendles guðe mid gryrum ecga.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: "Þonne wæs þēos medo-heal on morgen-tīd, "driht-sele drēor-fāh, þonne dæg līxte, "eal benc-þelu blōde bestȳmed, "heall heoru-drēore: āhte ic holdra þȳ lǣs, "dēorre duguðe, þē þā dēað fornam.
text_bare: "Þonne wæs þeos medo-heal on morgen-tid, "driht-sele dreor-fah, þonne dæg lixte, "eal benc-þelu blode bestymed, "heall heoru-dreore: ahte ic holdra þy læs, "deorre duguðe, þe þa deað fornam.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: "Site nū tō symle and onsǣl meoto, "sige-hrēð secgum, swā þīn sefa hwette!" Þā wæs Gēat-mæcgum geador ætsomne on bēor-sele benc gerȳmed; þǣr swīð-ferhðe sittan ēodon þrȳðum dealle.
text_bare: "Site nu to symle and onsæl meoto, "sige-hreð secgum, swa þin sefa hwette!" Þa wæs Geat-mæcgum geador ætsomne on beor-sele benc gerymed; þær swið-ferhðe sittan eodon þryðum dealle.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: Þegn nytte behēold, sē þe on handa bær hroden ealo-wǣge, scencte scīr wered.
text_bare: Þegn nytte beheold, se þe on handa bær hroden ealo-wæge, scencte scir wered.

section: VIII. HROTHGAR TELLS OF GRENDEL.
text: Scop hwīlum sang hādor on Heorote; þǣr wæs hæleða drēam, duguð unlȳtel Dena and Wedera.
text_bare: Scop hwilum sang hador on Heorote; þær wæs hæleða dream, duguð unlytel Dena and Wedera.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: Unferð maðelode, Ecglāfes bearn, þē æt fōtum sæt frēan Scyldinga; onband beadu-rūne wæs him Bēowulfes sīð, mōdges mere-faran, micel æf-þunca, forþon þe hē ne ūðe, þæt ǣnig ōðer man ǣfre mǣrða þon mā middan-geardes gehēdde under heofenum þonne hē sylfa : "Eart þū sē Bēowulf, sē þe wið Brecan wunne, "on sīdne sǣ ymb sund flite, "þǣr git for wlence wada cunnedon "and for dol-gilpe on dēop wæter "aldrum nēðdon?
text_bare: Unferð maðelode, Ecglafes bearn, þe æt fotum sæt frean Scyldinga; onband beadu-rune wæs him Beowulfes sið, modges mere-faran, micel æf-þunca, forþon þe he ne uðe, þæt ænig oðer man æfre mærða þon ma middan-geardes gehedde under heofenum þonne he sylfa : "Eart þu se Beowulf, se þe wið Brecan wunne, "on sidne sæ ymb sund flite, "þær git for wlence wada cunnedon "and for dol-gilpe on deop wæter "aldrum neðdon?

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: Nē inc ǣnig mon, "nē lēof nē lāð, belēan mihte "sorh-fullne sīð; þā git on sund rēon, "þǣr git ēagor-strēam earmum þehton, "mǣton mere-strǣta, mundum brugdon, "glidon ofer gār-secg; geofon ȳðum wēol, "wintres wylme.
text_bare: Ne inc ænig mon, "ne leof ne lað, belean mihte "sorh-fullne sið; þa git on sund reon, "þær git eagor-stream earmum þehton, "mæton mere-stræta, mundum brugdon, "glidon ofer gar-secg; geofon yðum weol, "wintres wylme.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: Git on wæteres ǣht "seofon niht swuncon; hē þē æt sunde oferflāt, "hæfde māre mægen.
text_bare: Git on wæteres æht "seofon niht swuncon; he þe æt sunde oferflat, "hæfde mare mægen.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: Þā hine on morgen-tīd "on Heaðo-rǣmas holm up ætbær, "þonon hē gesōhte swǣsne ēðel "lēof his lēodum lond Brondinga, "freoðo-burh fægere, þǣr hē folc āhte, "burg and bēagas.
text_bare: Þa hine on morgen-tid "on Heaðo-ræmas holm up ætbær, "þonon he gesohte swæsne eðel "leof his leodum lond Brondinga, "freoðo-burh fægere, þær he folc ahte, "burg and beagas.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: Bēot eal wið þē "sunu Bēanstānes sōðe gelǣste.
text_bare: Beot eal wið þe "sunu Beanstanes soðe gelæste.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: "Þonne wēne ic tō þē wyrsan geþinges, "þēah þū heaðo-rǣsa gehwǣr dohte, "grimre gūðe, gif þū Grendles dearst "niht-longne fyrst nēan bīdan!" Bēowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: "Hwæt!
text_bare: "Þonne wene ic to þe wyrsan geþinges, "þeah þu heaðo-ræsa gehwær dohte, "grimre guðe, gif þu Grendles dearst "niht-longne fyrst nean bidan!" Beowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: "Hwæt!

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: þū worn fela, wine mīn Unferð, "bēore druncen ymb Brecan sprǣce, "sægdest from his sīðe!
text_bare: þu worn fela, wine min Unferð, "beore druncen ymb Brecan spræce, "sægdest from his siðe!

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: Sōð ic talige, "þæt ic mere-strengo māran āhte, "earfeðo on ȳðum, þonne ǣnig ōðer man.
text_bare: Soð ic talige, "þæt ic mere-strengo maran ahte, "earfeðo on yðum, þonne ænig oðer man.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: "Wit þæt gecwǣdon cniht-wesende "and gebēotedon wǣron bēgen þā gīt "on geogoð-feore þæt wit on gār-secg ūt "aldrum nēðdon; and þæt geæfndon swā.
text_bare: "Wit þæt gecwædon cniht-wesende "and gebeotedon wæron begen þa git "on geogoð-feore þæt wit on gar-secg ut "aldrum neðdon; and þæt geæfndon swa.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: "Hæfdon swurd nacod, þā wit on sund rēon, "heard on handa, wit unc wið hron-fixas "werian þōhton.
text_bare: "Hæfdon swurd nacod, þa wit on sund reon, "heard on handa, wit unc wið hron-fixas "werian þohton.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: Nō hē wiht fram mē "flōd-ȳðum feor flēotan meahte, "hraðor on holme, nō ic fram him wolde.
text_bare: No he wiht fram me "flod-yðum feor fleotan meahte, "hraðor on holme, no ic fram him wolde.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: "Þā wit ætsomne on sǣ wǣron "fīf nihta fyrst, oð þæt unc flōd tōdrāf, "wado weallende, wedera cealdost, "nīpende niht and norðan wind "heaðo-grim andhwearf; hrēo wǣron ȳða, "Wæs mere-fixa mōd onhrēred: "þǣr mē wið lāðum līc-syrce mīn, "heard hond-locen, helpe gefremede; "beado-hrægl brōden on brēostum læg, "golde gegyrwed.
text_bare: "Þa wit ætsomne on sæ wæron "fif nihta fyrst, oð þæt unc flod todraf, "wado weallende, wedera cealdost, "nipende niht and norðan wind "heaðo-grim andhwearf; hreo wæron yða, "Wæs mere-fixa mod onhrered: "þær me wið laðum lic-syrce min, "heard hond-locen, helpe gefremede; "beado-hrægl broden on breostum læg, "golde gegyrwed.

section: IX. HUNFERTH OBJECTS TO BEOWULF.
text: Mē tō grunde tēah "fāh fēond-scaða, fæste hæfde "grim on grāpe: hwæðre mē gyfeðe wearð, "þæt ic āglǣcan orde gerǣhte, "hilde-bille; heaðo-rǣs fornam "mihtig mere-dēor þurh mīne hand.
text_bare: Me to grunde teah "fah feond-scaða, fæste hæfde "grim on grape: hwæðre me gyfeðe wearð, "þæt ic aglæcan orde geræhte, "hilde-bille; heaðo-ræs fornam "mihtig mere-deor þurh mine hand.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: "Swā mec gelōme lāð-getēonan "þrēatedon þearle.
text_bare: "Swa mec gelome lað-geteonan "þreatedon þearle.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Ic him þēnode "dēoran sweorde, swā hit gedēfe wæs; "næs hīe þǣre fylle gefēan hæfdon, "mān-fordǣdlan, þæt hīe mē þēgon, "symbel ymb-sǣton sǣ-grunde nēah, "ac on mergenne mēcum wunde "be ȳð-lāfe uppe lǣgon, "sweordum āswefede, þæt syððan nā "ymb brontne ford brim-līðende "lāde ne letton.
text_bare: Ic him þenode "deoran sweorde, swa hit gedefe wæs; "næs hie þære fylle gefean hæfdon, "man-fordædlan, þæt hie me þegon, "symbel ymb-sæton sæ-grunde neah, "ac on mergenne mecum wunde "be yð-lafe uppe lægon, "sweordum aswefede, þæt syððan na "ymb brontne ford brim-liðende "lade ne letton.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Lēoht ēastan cōm, "beorht bēacen godes; brimu swaðredon, "þæt ic sǣ-næssas gesēon mihte, "windige weallas.
text_bare: Leoht eastan com, "beorht beacen godes; brimu swaðredon, "þæt ic sæ-næssas geseon mihte, "windige weallas.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Wyrd oft nereð "unfǣgne eorl, ðonne his ellen dēah!
text_bare: Wyrd oft nereð "unfægne eorl, ðonne his ellen deah!

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: "Hwæðere mē gesǣlde, þæt ic mid sweorde ofslōh "niceras nigene.
text_bare: "Hwæðere me gesælde, þæt ic mid sweorde ofsloh "niceras nigene.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Nō ic on niht gefrægn "under heofones hwealf heardran feohtan, "nē on ēg-strēamum earmran mannan; "hwæðere ic fāra feng fēore gedīgde, "siðes wērig.
text_bare: No ic on niht gefrægn "under heofones hwealf heardran feohtan, "ne on eg-streamum earmran mannan; "hwæðere ic fara feng feore gedigde, "siðes werig.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Þā mec sǣ oðbær, "flōd æfter faroðe, on Finna land, "wadu weallendu.
text_bare: Þa mec sæ oðbær, "flod æfter faroðe, on Finna land, "wadu weallendu.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Nō ic wiht fram þē "swylcra searo-nīða secgan hȳrde, "billa brōgan: Breca nǣfre gīt "æt heaðo-lāce, nē gehwæðer incer "swā dēorlīce dǣd gefremede "fāgum sweordum .
text_bare: No ic wiht fram þe "swylcra searo-niða secgan hyrde, "billa brogan: Breca næfre git "æt heaðo-lace, ne gehwæðer incer "swa deorlice dæd gefremede "fagum sweordum .

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: nō ic þæs gylpe; "þēah þū þīnum brōðrum tō banan wurde, "hēafod-mǣgum; þæs þū in helle scealt "werhðo drēogan, þēah þīn wit duge, "Secge ic þē tō sōðe, sunu Ecglāfes, "þæt nǣfre Grendel swā fela gryra gefremede, "atol ǣglǣca ealdre þīnum, "hȳnðo on Heorote, gif þīn hige wǣre, "sefa swā searo-grim, swā þū self talast.
text_bare: no ic þæs gylpe; "þeah þu þinum broðrum to banan wurde, "heafod-mægum; þæs þu in helle scealt "werhðo dreogan, þeah þin wit duge, "Secge ic þe to soðe, sunu Ecglafes, "þæt næfre Grendel swa fela gryra gefremede, "atol æglæca ealdre þinum, "hynðo on Heorote, gif þin hige wære, "sefa swa searo-grim, swa þu self talast.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: "Ac hē hafað onfunden, þæt hē þā fǣhðe ne þearf, "atole ecg-þræce ēower lēode "swīðe onsittan, Sige-Scyldinga; "nymeð nȳd-bāde, nǣnegum ārað "lēode Deniga, ac hē on lust wīgeð, "swefeð ond sendeð, secce ne wēneð "tō Gār-Denum.
text_bare: "Ac he hafað onfunden, þæt he þa fæhðe ne þearf, "atole ecg-þræce eower leode "swiðe onsittan, Sige-Scyldinga; "nymeð nyd-bade, nænegum arað "leode Deniga, ac he on lust wigeð, "swefeð ond sendeð, secce ne weneð "to Gar-Denum.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Ac him Gēata sceal "eafoð and ellen ungeāra nū "gūðe gebēodan.
text_bare: Ac him Geata sceal "eafoð and ellen ungeara nu "guðe gebeodan.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Gǣð eft sē þe mōt "tō medo mōdig, siððan morgen-lēoht "ofer ylda bearn ōðres dōgores, "sunne swegl-wered sūðan scīneð!" Þā wæs on sālum sinces brytta gamol-feax and gūð-rōf, gēoce gelȳfde brego Beorht-Dena; gehȳrde on Bēowulfe folces hyrde fæst-rǣdne geþōht.
text_bare: Gæð eft se þe mot "to medo modig, siððan morgen-leoht "ofer ylda bearn oðres dogores, "sunne swegl-wered suðan scineð!" Þa wæs on salum sinces brytta gamol-feax and guð-rof, geoce gelyfde brego Beorht-Dena; gehyrde on Beowulfe folces hyrde fæst-rædne geþoht.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Þǣr wæs hæleða hleahtor; hlyn swynsode, word wǣron wynsume.
text_bare: Þær wæs hæleða hleahtor; hlyn swynsode, word wæron wynsume.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Ēode Wealhþēow forð, cwēn Hrōðgāres, cynna gemyndig, grētte gold-hroden guman on healle, and þā frēolīc wīf ful gesealde ǣrest Ēast-Dena ēðel-wearde, bæd hine blīðne æt þǣre bēor-þege, lēodum lēofne; hē on lust geþeah symbel and sele-ful, sige-rōf kyning.
text_bare: Eode Wealhþeow forð, cwen Hroðgares, cynna gemyndig, grette gold-hroden guman on healle, and þa freolic wif ful gesealde ærest East-Dena eðel-wearde, bæd hine bliðne æt þære beor-þege, leodum leofne; he on lust geþeah symbel and sele-ful, sige-rof kyning.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Ymb-ēode þā ides Helminga duguðe and geogoðe dǣl ǣghwylcne; sinc-fato sealde, oð þæt sǣl ālamp, þæt hīo Bēowulfe, bēag-hroden cwēn, mōde geþungen, medo-ful ætbær; grētte Gēata lēod, gode þancode wīs-fæst wordum, þæs þe hire se willa gelamp, þæt hēo on ǣnigne eorl gelȳfde fyrena frōfre.
text_bare: Ymb-eode þa ides Helminga duguðe and geogoðe dæl æghwylcne; sinc-fato sealde, oð þæt sæl alamp, þæt hio Beowulfe, beag-hroden cwen, mode geþungen, medo-ful ætbær; grette Geata leod, gode þancode wis-fæst wordum, þæs þe hire se willa gelamp, þæt heo on ænigne eorl gelyfde fyrena frofre.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Hē þæt ful geþeah, wæl-rēow wiga æt Wealhþēon, and þā gyddode gūðe gefȳsed, Bēowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: "Ic þæt hogode, þā ic on holm gestāh, "sǣ-bāt gesæt mid mīnra secga gedriht, "þæt ic ānunga ēowra lēoda "willan geworhte, oððe on wæl crunge, "fēond-grāpum fæst.
text_bare: He þæt ful geþeah, wæl-reow wiga æt Wealhþeon, and þa gyddode guðe gefysed, Beowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: "Ic þæt hogode, þa ic on holm gestah, "sæ-bat gesæt mid minra secga gedriht, "þæt ic anunga eowra leoda "willan geworhte, oððe on wæl crunge, "feond-grapum fæst.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Ic gefremman sceal "eorlīc ellen, oððe ende-dæg "on þisse meodu-healle mīnne gebīdan." Þām wīfe þā word wēl līcodon, gilp-cwide Gēates; ēode gold-hroden frēolīcu folc-cwēn tō hire frēan sittan.
text_bare: Ic gefremman sceal "eorlic ellen, oððe ende-dæg "on þisse meodu-healle minne gebidan." Þam wife þa word wel licodon, gilp-cwide Geates; eode gold-hroden freolicu folc-cwen to hire frean sittan.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Þā wæs eft swā ǣr inne on healle þrȳð-word sprecen, þēod on sǣlum, sige-folca swēg, oð þæt semninga sunu Healfdenes sēcean wolde ǣfen-ræste; wiste æt þǣm āhlǣcan tō þǣm hēah-sele hilde geþinged, siððan hīe sunnan lēoht gesēon ne meahton, oððe nīpende niht ofer ealle, scadu-helma gesceapu scrīðan cwōman, wan under wolcnum.
text_bare: Þa wæs eft swa ær inne on healle þryð-word sprecen, þeod on sælum, sige-folca sweg, oð þæt semninga sunu Healfdenes secean wolde æfen-ræste; wiste æt þæm ahlæcan to þæm heah-sele hilde geþinged, siððan hie sunnan leoht geseon ne meahton, oððe nipende niht ofer ealle, scadu-helma gesceapu scriðan cwoman, wan under wolcnum.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Werod eall ārās.
text_bare: Werod eall aras.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Grētte þā giddum guma ōðerne, Hrōðgār Bēowulf, and him hǣl ābēad, wīn-ærnes geweald and þæt word ācwæð: "Nǣfre ic ǣnegum men ǣr ālȳfde, "siððan ic hond and rond hebban mihte, "þrȳð-ærn Dena būton þē nū þā.
text_bare: Grette þa giddum guma oðerne, Hroðgar Beowulf, and him hæl abead, win-ærnes geweald and þæt word acwæð: "Næfre ic ænegum men ær alyfde, "siððan ic hond and rond hebban mihte, "þryð-ærn Dena buton þe nu þa.

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: "Hafa nū and geheald hūsa sēlest; "gemyne mǣrðo, mægen-ellen cȳð, "waca wið wrāðum!
text_bare: "Hafa nu and geheald husa selest; "gemyne mærðo, mægen-ellen cyð, "waca wið wraðum!

section: X. BEOWULF'S CONTEST WITH BRECA.—THE FEAST.
text: Ne bið þē wilna gād, "gif þū þæt ellen-weorc aldre gedīgest."
text_bare: Ne bið þe wilna gad, "gif þu þæt ellen-weorc aldre gedigest."

section: XI. THE WATCH FOR GRENDEL.
text: Þā him Hrōðgār gewāt mid his hæleða gedryht, eodur Scyldinga ūt of healle; wolde wīg-fruma Wealhþēo sēcan, cwēn tō gebeddan Hæfde kyninga wuldor Grendle tō-gēanes, swā guman gefrungon, sele-weard āseted, sundor-nytte behēold ymb aldor Dena, eoton weard ābēad; hūru Gēata lēod georne truwode mōdgan mægnes, metodes hyldo.
text_bare: Þa him Hroðgar gewat mid his hæleða gedryht, eodur Scyldinga ut of healle; wolde wig-fruma Wealhþeo secan, cwen to gebeddan Hæfde kyninga wuldor Grendle to-geanes, swa guman gefrungon, sele-weard aseted, sundor-nytte beheold ymb aldor Dena, eoton weard abead; huru Geata leod georne truwode modgan mægnes, metodes hyldo.

section: XI. THE WATCH FOR GRENDEL.
text: Þā hē him of dyde īsern-byrnan, helm of hafelan, sealde his hyrsted sweord, īrena cyst ombiht-þegne, and gehealdan hēt hilde-geatwe.
text_bare: Þa he him of dyde isern-byrnan, helm of hafelan, sealde his hyrsted sweord, irena cyst ombiht-þegne, and gehealdan het hilde-geatwe.

section: XI. THE WATCH FOR GRENDEL.
text: Gespræc þā se gōda gylp-worda sum Bēowulf Gēata, ǣr hē on bed stige: "Nō ic mē an here-wǣsmum hnāgran talige "gūð-geweorca, þonne Grendel hine; "forþan ic hine sweorde swebban nelle, "aldre benēotan, þēah ic eal mǣge.
text_bare: Gespræc þa se goda gylp-worda sum Beowulf Geata, ær he on bed stige: "No ic me an here-wæsmum hnagran talige "guð-geweorca, þonne Grendel hine; "forþan ic hine sweorde swebban nelle, "aldre beneotan, þeah ic eal mæge.

section: XI. THE WATCH FOR GRENDEL.
text: "Nāt hē þāra gōda, þæt hē mē on-gēan slēa, "rand gehēawe, þēah þe hē rōf sīe "nīð-geweorca; ac wit on niht sculon "secge ofersittan, gif hē gesēcean dear "wīg ofer wǣpen, and siððan wītig god "on swā hwæðere hond hālig dryhten "mǣrðo dēme, swā him gemet þince." Hylde hine þā heaðo-dēor, hlēor-bolster onfēng eorles andwlitan; and hine ymb monig snellīc sǣ-rinc sele-reste gebēah.
text_bare: "Nat he þara goda, þæt he me on-gean slea, "rand geheawe, þeah þe he rof sie "nið-geweorca; ac wit on niht sculon "secge ofersittan, gif he gesecean dear "wig ofer wæpen, and siððan witig god "on swa hwæðere hond halig dryhten "mærðo deme, swa him gemet þince." Hylde hine þa heaðo-deor, hleor-bolster onfeng eorles andwlitan; and hine ymb monig snellic sæ-rinc sele-reste gebeah.

section: XI. THE WATCH FOR GRENDEL.
text: Nǣnig heora þōhte þæt hē þanon scolde eft eard-lufan ǣfre gesēcean, folc oððe frēo-burh, þǣr hē āfēded wæs, ac hīe hæfdon gefrūnen, þæt hīe ǣr tō fela micles in þǣm wīn-sele wæl-dēað fornam, Denigea lēode.
text_bare: Nænig heora þohte þæt he þanon scolde eft eard-lufan æfre gesecean, folc oððe freo-burh, þær he afeded wæs, ac hie hæfdon gefrunen, þæt hie ær to fela micles in þæm win-sele wæl-deað fornam, Denigea leode.

section: XI. THE WATCH FOR GRENDEL.
text: Ac him dryhten forgeaf wīg-spēda gewiofu, Wedera lēodum frōfor and fultum, þæt hīe fēond heora þurh ānes cræft ealle ofercōmon, selfes mihtum: sōð is gecȳðed, þæt mihtig god manna cynnes wēold wīde-ferhð.
text_bare: Ac him dryhten forgeaf wig-speda gewiofu, Wedera leodum frofor and fultum, þæt hie feond heora þurh anes cræft ealle ofercomon, selfes mihtum: soð is gecyðed, þæt mihtig god manna cynnes weold wide-ferhð.

section: XI. THE WATCH FOR GRENDEL.
text: Cōm on wanre niht scrīðan sceadu-genga.
text_bare: Com on wanre niht scriðan sceadu-genga.

section: XI. THE WATCH FOR GRENDEL.
text: Scēotend swǣfon, þā þæt horn-reced healdan scoldon, ealle būton ānum.
text_bare: Sceotend swæfon, þa þæt horn-reced healdan scoldon, ealle buton anum.

section: XI. THE WATCH FOR GRENDEL.
text: Þæt wæs yldum cūð, þæt hīe ne mōste, þā metod nolde, se syn-scaða under sceadu bregdan; ac hē wæccende wrāðum on andan bād bolgen-mōd beadwa geþinges.
text_bare: Þæt wæs yldum cuð, þæt hie ne moste, þa metod nolde, se syn-scaða under sceadu bregdan; ac he wæccende wraðum on andan bad bolgen-mod beadwa geþinges.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Þā cōm of mōre under mist-hleoðum Grendel gongan, godes yrre bær.
text_bare: Þa com of more under mist-hleoðum Grendel gongan, godes yrre bær.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Mynte se mān-scaða manna cynnes sumne besyrwan in sele þām hēan; wōd under wolcnum, tō þæs þe hē wīn-reced, gold-sele gumena, gearwost wisse fǣttum fāhne.
text_bare: Mynte se man-scaða manna cynnes sumne besyrwan in sele þam hean; wod under wolcnum, to þæs þe he win-reced, gold-sele gumena, gearwost wisse fættum fahne.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Ne wæs þæt forma sīð, þæt hē Hrōðgāres hām gesōhte: nǣfre hē on aldor-dagum ǣr nē siððan heardran hæle, heal-þegnas fand!
text_bare: Ne wæs þæt forma sið, þæt he Hroðgares ham gesohte: næfre he on aldor-dagum ær ne siððan heardran hæle, heal-þegnas fand!

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Cōm þā tō recede rinc sīðian drēamum bedǣled.
text_bare: Com þa to recede rinc siðian dreamum bedæled.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Duru sōna onarn fȳr-bendum fæst, syððan hē hire folmum hrān; onbræd þā bealo-hȳdig, þā hē ābolgen wæs, recedes mūðan.
text_bare: Duru sona onarn fyr-bendum fæst, syððan he hire folmum hran; onbræd þa bealo-hydig, þa he abolgen wæs, recedes muðan.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Raðe æfter þon on fāgne flōr fēond treddode, ēode yrre-mōd; him of ēagum stōd līge gelīcost lēoht unfǣger.
text_bare: Raðe æfter þon on fagne flor feond treddode, eode yrre-mod; him of eagum stod lige gelicost leoht unfæger.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Geseah hē in recede rinca manige, swefan sibbe-gedriht samod ætgædere, mago-rinca hēap: þā his mōd āhlōg, mynte þæt hē gedǣlde, ǣr þon dæg cwōme, atol āglǣca, ānra gehwylces līf wið līce, þā him ālumpen wæs wist-fylle wēn.
text_bare: Geseah he in recede rinca manige, swefan sibbe-gedriht samod ætgædere, mago-rinca heap: þa his mod ahlog, mynte þæt he gedælde, ær þon dæg cwome, atol aglæca, anra gehwylces lif wið lice, þa him alumpen wæs wist-fylle wen.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Ne wæs þæt wyrd þā gēn, þæt hē mā mōste manna cynnes þicgean ofer þā niht.
text_bare: Ne wæs þæt wyrd þa gen, þæt he ma moste manna cynnes þicgean ofer þa niht.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Þrȳð-swȳð behēold mǣg Higelāces, hū se mān-scaða under fǣr-gripum gefaran wolde.
text_bare: Þryð-swyð beheold mæg Higelaces, hu se man-scaða under fær-gripum gefaran wolde.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Nē þæt se āglǣca yldan þōhte, ac hē gefēng hraðe forman siðe slǣpendne rinc, slāt unwearnum, bāt bān-locan, blōd ēdrum dranc, syn-snǣdum swealh: sōna hæfde unlyfigendes eal gefeormod fēt and folma.
text_bare: Ne þæt se aglæca yldan þohte, ac he gefeng hraðe forman siðe slæpendne rinc, slat unwearnum, bat ban-locan, blod edrum dranc, syn-snædum swealh: sona hæfde unlyfigendes eal gefeormod fet and folma.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Forð nēar ætstōp, nam þā mid handa hige-þīhtigne rinc on ræste; rǣhte ongēan fēond mid folme, hē onfēng hraðe inwit-þancum and wið earm gesæt.
text_bare: Forð near ætstop, nam þa mid handa hige-þihtigne rinc on ræste; ræhte ongean feond mid folme, he onfeng hraðe inwit-þancum and wið earm gesæt.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Sōna þæt onfunde fyrena hyrde, þæt hē ne mētte middan-geardes eorðan scēata on elran men mund-gripe māran: hē on mōde wearð forht on ferhðe, nō þȳ ǣr fram meahte; hyge wæs him hin-fūs, wolde on heolster flēon, sēcan dēofla gedræg: ne wæs his drohtoð þǣr, swylce hē on ealder-dagum ǣr gemētte.
text_bare: Sona þæt onfunde fyrena hyrde, þæt he ne mette middan-geardes eorðan sceata on elran men mund-gripe maran: he on mode wearð forht on ferhðe, no þy ær fram meahte; hyge wæs him hin-fus, wolde on heolster fleon, secan deofla gedræg: ne wæs his drohtoð þær, swylce he on ealder-dagum ær gemette.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Gemunde þā se gōda mǣg Higelāces ǣfen-sprǣce, up-lang āstōd and him fæste wiðfēng.
text_bare: Gemunde þa se goda mæg Higelaces æfen-spræce, up-lang astod and him fæste wiðfeng.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Fingras burston; eoten wæs ūt-weard, eorl furður stōp.
text_bare: Fingras burston; eoten wæs ut-weard, eorl furður stop.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Mynte se mǣra, þǣr hē meahte swā, wīdre gewindan and on weg þanon flēon on fen-hopu; wiste his fingra geweald on grames grāpum.
text_bare: Mynte se mæra, þær he meahte swa, widre gewindan and on weg þanon fleon on fen-hopu; wiste his fingra geweald on grames grapum.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Þæt wæs gēocor sīð, þæt se hearm-scaða tō Heorute ātēah: dryht-sele dynede, Denum eallum wearð, ceaster-būendum, cēnra gehwylcum, eorlum ealu-scerwen.
text_bare: Þæt wæs geocor sið, þæt se hearm-scaða to Heorute ateah: dryht-sele dynede, Denum eallum wearð, ceaster-buendum, cenra gehwylcum, eorlum ealu-scerwen.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Yrre wǣron bēgen, rēðe rēn-weardas.
text_bare: Yrre wæron begen, reðe ren-weardas.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Reced hlynsode; þā wæs wundor micel, þæt se wīn-sele wiðhæfde heaðo-dēorum, þæt hē on hrūsan ne fēol, fǣger fold-bold; ac hē þæs fæste wæs innan and ūtan īren-bendum searo-þoncum besmiðod.
text_bare: Reced hlynsode; þa wæs wundor micel, þæt se win-sele wiðhæfde heaðo-deorum, þæt he on hrusan ne feol, fæger fold-bold; ac he þæs fæste wæs innan and utan iren-bendum searo-þoncum besmiðod.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Þǣr fram sylle ābēag medu-benc monig mīne gefrǣge, golde geregnad, þǣr þā graman wunnon; þæs ne wēndon ǣr witan Scyldinga, þæt hit ā mid gemete manna ǣnig betlīc and bān-fāg tōbrecan meahte, listum tōlūcan, nymðe līges fæðm swulge on swaðule.
text_bare: Þær fram sylle abeag medu-benc monig mine gefræge, golde geregnad, þær þa graman wunnon; þæs ne wendon ær witan Scyldinga, þæt hit a mid gemete manna ænig betlic and ban-fag tobrecan meahte, listum tolucan, nymðe liges fæðm swulge on swaðule.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Swēg up āstāg nīwe geneahhe; Norð-Denum stōd atelīc egesa ānra gehwylcum þāra þe of wealle wōp gehȳrdon, gryre-lēoð galan godes andsacan, sige-lēasne sang, sār wānigean helle hæftan.
text_bare: Sweg up astag niwe geneahhe; Norð-Denum stod atelic egesa anra gehwylcum þara þe of wealle wop gehyrdon, gryre-leoð galan godes andsacan, sige-leasne sang, sar wanigean helle hæftan.

section: XII. GRENDEL'S RAID.
text: Hēold hine tō fæste sē þe manna wæs mægene strengest on þǣm dæge þysses līfes.
text_bare: Heold hine to fæste se þe manna wæs mægene strengest on þæm dæge þysses lifes.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Nolde eorla hlēo ǣnige þinga þone cwealm-cuman cwicne forlǣtan, nē his līf-dagas lēoda ǣnigum nytte tealde.
text_bare: Nolde eorla hleo ænige þinga þone cwealm-cuman cwicne forlætan, ne his lif-dagas leoda ænigum nytte tealde.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Þǣr genehost brægd eorl Bēowulfes ealde lāfe, wolde frēa-drihtnes feorh ealgian mǣres þēodnes, þǣr hīe meahton swā; hīe þæt ne wiston, þā hīe gewin drugon, heard-hicgende hilde-mecgas, and on healfa gehwone hēawan þōhton, sāwle sēcan, þæt þone syn-scaðan ǣnig ofer eorðan īrenna cyst, gūð-billa nān grētan nolde; ac hē sige-wǣpnum forsworen hæfde, ecga gehwylcre.
text_bare: Þær genehost brægd eorl Beowulfes ealde lafe, wolde frea-drihtnes feorh ealgian mæres þeodnes, þær hie meahton swa; hie þæt ne wiston, þa hie gewin drugon, heard-hicgende hilde-mecgas, and on healfa gehwone heawan þohton, sawle secan, þæt þone syn-scaðan ænig ofer eorðan irenna cyst, guð-billa nan gretan nolde; ac he sige-wæpnum forsworen hæfde, ecga gehwylcre.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Scolde his aldor-gedāl on þǣm dæge þysses līfes earmlīc wurðan and se ellor-gāst on fēonda geweald feor sīðian.
text_bare: Scolde his aldor-gedal on þæm dæge þysses lifes earmlic wurðan and se ellor-gast on feonda geweald feor siðian.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Þā þæt onfunde sē þe fela ǣror mōdes myrðe manna cynne fyrene gefremede hē wæs fāg wið god þæt him se līc-homa lǣstan nolde, ac hine se mōdega mǣg Hygelāces hæfde be honda; wæs gehwæðer ōðrum lifigende lāð.
text_bare: Þa þæt onfunde se þe fela æror modes myrðe manna cynne fyrene gefremede he wæs fag wið god þæt him se lic-homa læstan nolde, ac hine se modega mæg Hygelaces hæfde be honda; wæs gehwæðer oðrum lifigende lað.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Līc-sār gebād atol ǣglǣca, him on eaxle wearð syn-dolh sweotol, seonowe onsprungon burston bān-locan.
text_bare: Lic-sar gebad atol æglæca, him on eaxle wearð syn-dolh sweotol, seonowe onsprungon burston ban-locan.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Bēowulfe wearð gūð-hrēð gyfeðe; scolde Grendel þonan feorh-sēoc flēon under fen-hleoðu, sēcean wyn-lēas wīc; wiste þē geornor, þæt his aldres wæs ende gegongen, dōgera dæg-rīm.
text_bare: Beowulfe wearð guð-hreð gyfeðe; scolde Grendel þonan feorh-seoc fleon under fen-hleoðu, secean wyn-leas wic; wiste þe geornor, þæt his aldres wæs ende gegongen, dogera dæg-rim.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Denum eallum wearð æfter þām wæl-rǣse willa gelumpen.
text_bare: Denum eallum wearð æfter þam wæl-ræse willa gelumpen.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Hæfde þā gefǣlsod, sē þe ǣr feorran cōm, snotor and swȳð-ferhð sele Hrōðgāres, genered wið nīðe.
text_bare: Hæfde þa gefælsod, se þe ær feorran com, snotor and swyð-ferhð sele Hroðgares, genered wið niðe.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Niht-weorce gefeh, ellen-mǣrðum; hæfde Ēast-Denum Gēat-mecga lēod gilp gelǣsted, swylce oncȳððe ealle gebētte, inwid-sorge, þē hīe ǣr drugon and for þrēa-nȳdum þolian scoldon, torn unlȳtel.
text_bare: Niht-weorce gefeh, ellen-mærðum; hæfde East-Denum Geat-mecga leod gilp gelæsted, swylce oncyððe ealle gebette, inwid-sorge, þe hie ær drugon and for þrea-nydum þolian scoldon, torn unlytel.

section: XIII. BEOWULF TEARS OFF GRENDEL'S ARM.
text: Þæt wæs tācen sweotol, syððan hilde-dēor hond ālegde, earm and eaxle þǣr wæs eal geador Grendles grāpe under gēapne hrōf.
text_bare: Þæt wæs tacen sweotol, syððan hilde-deor hond alegde, earm and eaxle þær wæs eal geador Grendles grape under geapne hrof.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Þā wæs on morgen mīne gefrǣge ymb þā gif-healle gūð-rinc monig: fērdon folc-togan feorran and nēan geond wīd-wegas wundor scēawian, lāðes lāstas.
text_bare: Þa wæs on morgen mine gefræge ymb þa gif-healle guð-rinc monig: ferdon folc-togan feorran and nean geond wid-wegas wundor sceawian, laðes lastas.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Nō his līf-gedāl sārlīc þūhte secga ǣnegum, þāra þe tīr-lēases trode scēawode, hū hē wērig-mōd on weg þanon, nīða ofercumen, on nicera mere fǣge and geflȳmed feorh-lāstas bær.
text_bare: No his lif-gedal sarlic þuhte secga ænegum, þara þe tir-leases trode sceawode, hu he werig-mod on weg þanon, niða ofercumen, on nicera mere fæge and geflymed feorh-lastas bær.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Þǣr wæs on blōde brim weallende, atol ȳða geswing eal gemenged hātan heolfre, heoro-drēore wēol; dēað-fǣge dēog, siððan drēama lēas in fen-freoðo feorh ālegde hǣðene sāwle, þǣr him hel onfēng.
text_bare: Þær wæs on blode brim weallende, atol yða geswing eal gemenged hatan heolfre, heoro-dreore weol; deað-fæge deog, siððan dreama leas in fen-freoðo feorh alegde hæðene sawle, þær him hel onfeng.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Þanon eft gewiton eald-gesīðas, swylce geong manig of gomen-wāðe, fram mere mōdge, mēarum rīdan, beornas on blancum.
text_bare: Þanon eft gewiton eald-gesiðas, swylce geong manig of gomen-waðe, fram mere modge, mearum ridan, beornas on blancum.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Þǣr wæs Bēowulfes mǣrðo mǣned; monig oft gecwæð, þætte sūð nē norð be sǣm tweonum ofer eormen-grund ōðer nǣnig under swegles begong sēlra nǣre rond-hæbbendra, rīces wyrðra.
text_bare: Þær wæs Beowulfes mærðo mæned; monig oft gecwæð, þætte suð ne norð be sæm tweonum ofer eormen-grund oðer nænig under swegles begong selra nære rond-hæbbendra, rices wyrðra.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Nē hīe hūru wine-drihten wiht ne lōgon, glædne Hrōðgār, ac þæt wæs gōd cyning.
text_bare: Ne hie huru wine-drihten wiht ne logon, glædne Hroðgar, ac þæt wæs god cyning.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Hwīlum heaðo-rōfe hlēapan lēton, on geflīt faran fealwe mēaras, þǣr him fold-wegas fægere þūhton, cystum cūðe; hwīlum cyninges þegn, guma gilp-hlæden gidda gemyndig, sē þe eal-fela eald-gesegena worn gemunde, word ōðer fand sōðe gebunden: secg eft ongan sīð Bēowulfes snyttrum styrian and on spēd wrecan spel gerāde, wordum wrixlan, wēl-hwylc gecwæð, þæt hē fram Sigemunde secgan hȳrde, ellen-dǣdum, uncūðes fela, Wælsinges gewin, wīde sīðas, þāra þe gumena bearn gearwe ne wiston, fǣhðe and fyrene, būton Fitela mid hine, þonne hē swylces hwæt secgan wolde ēam his nefan, swā hīe ā wǣron æt nīða gehwām nȳd-gesteallan: hæfdon eal-fela eotena cynnes sweordum gesǣged.
text_bare: Hwilum heaðo-rofe hleapan leton, on geflit faran fealwe mearas, þær him fold-wegas fægere þuhton, cystum cuðe; hwilum cyninges þegn, guma gilp-hlæden gidda gemyndig, se þe eal-fela eald-gesegena worn gemunde, word oðer fand soðe gebunden: secg eft ongan sið Beowulfes snyttrum styrian and on sped wrecan spel gerade, wordum wrixlan, wel-hwylc gecwæð, þæt he fram Sigemunde secgan hyrde, ellen-dædum, uncuðes fela, Wælsinges gewin, wide siðas, þara þe gumena bearn gearwe ne wiston, fæhðe and fyrene, buton Fitela mid hine, þonne he swylces hwæt secgan wolde eam his nefan, swa hie a wæron æt niða gehwam nyd-gesteallan: hæfdon eal-fela eotena cynnes sweordum gesæged.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Sigemunde gesprong æfter dēað-dæge dōm unlȳtel, syððan wīges heard wyrm ācwealde, hordes hyrde; hē under hārne stān, æðelinges bearn, āna genēðde frēcne dǣde; ne wæs him Fitela mid.
text_bare: Sigemunde gesprong æfter deað-dæge dom unlytel, syððan wiges heard wyrm acwealde, hordes hyrde; he under harne stan, æðelinges bearn, ana geneðde frecne dæde; ne wæs him Fitela mid.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Hwæðre him gesǣlde, þæt þæt swurd þurhwōd wrǣtlīcne wyrm, þæt hit on wealle ætstōd, dryhtlīc īren; draca morðre swealt.
text_bare: Hwæðre him gesælde, þæt þæt swurd þurhwod wrætlicne wyrm, þæt hit on wealle ætstod, dryhtlic iren; draca morðre swealt.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Hæfde āglǣca elne gegongen, þæt hē bēah-hordes brūcan mōste selfes dōme: sǣ-bāt gehlōd, bær on bearm scipes beorhte frætwa, Wælses eafera; wyrm hāt gemealt.
text_bare: Hæfde aglæca elne gegongen, þæt he beah-hordes brucan moste selfes dome: sæ-bat gehlod, bær on bearm scipes beorhte frætwa, Wælses eafera; wyrm hat gemealt.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Sē wæs wreccena wīde mǣrost ofer wer-þēode, wīgendra hlēo ellen-dǣdum: hē þæs āron þāh.
text_bare: Se wæs wreccena wide mærost ofer wer-þeode, wigendra hleo ellen-dædum: he þæs aron þah.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Siððan Heremōdes hild sweðrode eafoð and ellen.
text_bare: Siððan Heremodes hild sweðrode eafoð and ellen.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Hē mid eotenum wearð on fēonda geweald forð forlācen, snūde forsended.
text_bare: He mid eotenum wearð on feonda geweald forð forlacen, snude forsended.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Hine sorh-wylmas lemede tō lange, hē his lēodum wearð, eallum æðelingum tō aldor-ceare; swylce oft bemearn ǣrran mǣlum swīð-ferhðes sīð snotor ceorl monig, sē þe him bealwa tō bōte gelȳfde, þæt þæt þēodnes bearn geþēon scolde, fæder-æðelum onfōn, folc gehealdan, hord and hlēo-burh, hæleða rīce, ēðel Scyldinga.
text_bare: Hine sorh-wylmas lemede to lange, he his leodum wearð, eallum æðelingum to aldor-ceare; swylce oft bemearn ærran mælum swið-ferhðes sið snotor ceorl monig, se þe him bealwa to bote gelyfde, þæt þæt þeodnes bearn geþeon scolde, fæder-æðelum onfon, folc gehealdan, hord and hleo-burh, hæleða rice, eðel Scyldinga.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Hē þǣr eallum wearð, mǣg Higelāces manna cynne, frēondum gefægra; hine fyren onwōd.
text_bare: He þær eallum wearð, mæg Higelaces manna cynne, freondum gefægra; hine fyren onwod.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Hwīlum flītende fealwe strǣte mēarum mǣton.
text_bare: Hwilum flitende fealwe stræte mearum mæton.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Þā wæs morgen-lēoht scofen and scynded.
text_bare: Þa wæs morgen-leoht scofen and scynded.

section: XIV. THE JOY AT HEOROT.
text: Ēode scealc monig swīð-hicgende tō sele þām hēan, searo-wundor sēon, swylce self cyning, of brȳd-būre bēah-horda weard, tryddode tīr-fæst getrume micle, cystum gecȳðed, and his cwēn mid him medo-stīg gemæt mægða hōse.
text_bare: Eode scealc monig swið-hicgende to sele þam hean, searo-wundor seon, swylce self cyning, of bryd-bure beah-horda weard, tryddode tir-fæst getrume micle, cystum gecyðed, and his cwen mid him medo-stig gemæt mægða hose.

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: Hrōðgār maðelode hē tō healle gēong, stōd on stapole, geseah stēapne hrōf golde fāhne and Grendles hond : "þisse ansȳne al-wealdan þanc "lungre gelimpe!
text_bare: Hroðgar maðelode he to healle geong, stod on stapole, geseah steapne hrof golde fahne and Grendles hond : "þisse ansyne al-wealdan þanc "lungre gelimpe!

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: Fela ic lāðes gebād, "grynna æt Grendle: ā mæg god wyrcan "wunder æfter wundre, wuldres hyrde!
text_bare: Fela ic laðes gebad, "grynna æt Grendle: a mæg god wyrcan "wunder æfter wundre, wuldres hyrde!

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: "Þæt wæs ungeāra, þæt ic ǣnigra mē "wēana ne wēnde tō wīdan feore "bōte gebīdan þonne blōde fāh "hūsa sēlest heoro-drēorig stōd; "wēa wīd-scofen witena gehwylcne "þāra þe ne wēndon, þæt hīe wīde-ferhð "lēoda land-geweorc lāðum beweredon "scuccum and scinnum.
text_bare: "Þæt wæs ungeara, þæt ic ænigra me "weana ne wende to widan feore "bote gebidan þonne blode fah "husa selest heoro-dreorig stod; "wea wid-scofen witena gehwylcne "þara þe ne wendon, þæt hie wide-ferhð "leoda land-geweorc laðum beweredon "scuccum and scinnum.

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: Nū scealc hafað "þurh drihtnes miht dǣd gefremede, "þē wē ealle ǣr ne meahton "snyttrum besyrwan.
text_bare: Nu scealc hafað "þurh drihtnes miht dæd gefremede, "þe we ealle ær ne meahton "snyttrum besyrwan.

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: Hwæt!
text_bare: Hwæt!

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: þæt secgan mæg "efne swā hwylc mægða, swā þone magan cende "æfter gum-cynnum, gyf hēo gȳt lyfað, "þæt hyre eald-metod ēste wǣre "bearn-gebyrdo.
text_bare: þæt secgan mæg "efne swa hwylc mægða, swa þone magan cende "æfter gum-cynnum, gyf heo gyt lyfað, "þæt hyre eald-metod este wære "bearn-gebyrdo.

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: Nū ic Bēowulf "þec, secg betsta, mē for sunu wylle "frēogan on ferhðe; heald forð tela "nīwe sibbe.
text_bare: Nu ic Beowulf "þec, secg betsta, me for sunu wylle "freogan on ferhðe; heald forð tela "niwe sibbe.

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: Ne bið þē nǣnigra gād "worolde wilna, þē ic geweald hæbbe.
text_bare: Ne bið þe nænigra gad "worolde wilna, þe ic geweald hæbbe.

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: "Ful-oft ic for lǣssan lēan teohhode "hord-weorðunge hnāhran rince, "sǣmran æt sæcce.
text_bare: "Ful-oft ic for læssan lean teohhode "hord-weorðunge hnahran rince, "sæmran æt sæcce.

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: Þū þē self hafast "dǣdum gefremed, þæt þīn dōm lyfað "āwa tō aldre.
text_bare: Þu þe self hafast "dædum gefremed, þæt þin dom lyfað "awa to aldre.

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: Alwalda þec "gōde forgylde, swā hē nū gȳt dyde!" Bēowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: "Wē þæt ellen-weorc ēstum miclum, "feohtan fremedon, frēcne genēðdon "eafoð uncūðes; ūðe ic swīðor, "þæt þū hinc selfne gesēon mōste, "fēond on frætewum fyl-wērigne!
text_bare: Alwalda þec "gode forgylde, swa he nu gyt dyde!" Beowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: "We þæt ellen-weorc estum miclum, "feohtan fremedon, frecne geneðdon "eafoð uncuðes; uðe ic swiðor, "þæt þu hinc selfne geseon moste, "feond on frætewum fyl-werigne!

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: "Ic hine hrædlīce heardan clammum "on wæl-bedde wrīðan þōhte, "þæt hē for mund-gripe mīnum scolde "licgean līf-bysig, būtan his līc swice; "ic hine ne mihte, þā metod nolde, "ganges getwǣman, nō ic him þæs georne ætfealh, "feorh-genīðlan; wæs tō fore-mihtig "fēond on fēðe.
text_bare: "Ic hine hrædlice heardan clammum "on wæl-bedde wriðan þohte, "þæt he for mund-gripe minum scolde "licgean lif-bysig, butan his lic swice; "ic hine ne mihte, þa metod nolde, "ganges getwæman, no ic him þæs georne ætfealh, "feorh-geniðlan; wæs to fore-mihtig "feond on feðe.

section: XV. HROTHGAR'S GRATULATION.
text: Hwæðere hē his folme forlēt "tō līf-wraðe lāst weardian, "earm and eaxle; nō þǣr ǣnige swā þēah "fēa-sceaft guma frōfre gebohte: "nō þȳ leng leofað lāð-getēona "synnum geswenced, ac hyne sār hafað "in nȳd-gripe nearwe befongen, "balwon bendum: þǣr ābīdan sceal "maga māne fāh miclan dōmes, "hū him scīr metod scrīfan wille." Þā wæs swīgra secg, sunu Ecglāfes, on gylp-sprǣce gūð-geweorca, siððan æðelingas eorles cræfte ofer hēahne hrōf hand scēawedon, fēondes fingras, foran ǣghwylc; wæs stēde nægla gehwylc, stȳle gelīcost, hǣðenes hand-sporu hilde-rinces egle unhēoru; ǣg-hwylc gecwæð, þæt him heardra nān hrīnan wolde īren ǣr-gōd, þæt þæs āhlǣcan blōdge beadu-folme onberan wolde.
text_bare: Hwæðere he his folme forlet "to lif-wraðe last weardian, "earm and eaxle; no þær ænige swa þeah "fea-sceaft guma frofre gebohte: "no þy leng leofað lað-geteona "synnum geswenced, ac hyne sar hafað "in nyd-gripe nearwe befongen, "balwon bendum: þær abidan sceal "maga mane fah miclan domes, "hu him scir metod scrifan wille." Þa wæs swigra secg, sunu Ecglafes, on gylp-spræce guð-geweorca, siððan æðelingas eorles cræfte ofer heahne hrof hand sceawedon, feondes fingras, foran æghwylc; wæs stede nægla gehwylc, style gelicost, hæðenes hand-sporu hilde-rinces egle unheoru; æg-hwylc gecwæð, þæt him heardra nan hrinan wolde iren ær-god, þæt þæs ahlæcan blodge beadu-folme onberan wolde.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Þā wæs hāten hreðe Heort innan-weard folmum gefrætwod: fela þǣra wæs wera and wīfa, þē þæt wīn-reced, gest-sele gyredon.
