text_bare: Þa wæs haten hreðe Heort innan-weard folmum gefrætwod: fela þæra wæs wera and wifa, þe þæt win-reced, gest-sele gyredon.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Gold-fāg scinon web æfter wāgum, wundor-sīona fela secga gehwylcum þāra þe on swylc starað Wæs þæt beorhte bold tōbrocen swīðe eal inne-weard īren-bendum fæst, heorras tōhlidene; hrōf āna genæs ealles ansund, þā se āglǣca fyren-dǣdum fāg on flēam gewand, aldres or-wēna.
text_bare: Gold-fag scinon web æfter wagum, wundor-siona fela secga gehwylcum þara þe on swylc starað Wæs þæt beorhte bold tobrocen swiðe eal inne-weard iren-bendum fæst, heorras tohlidene; hrof ana genæs ealles ansund, þa se aglæca fyren-dædum fag on fleam gewand, aldres or-wena.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Nō þæt ȳðe byð tō beflēonne fremme sē þe wille!
text_bare: No þæt yðe byð to befleonne fremme se þe wille!

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: ac gesacan sceal sāwl-berendra nȳde genȳdde niðða bearna grund-būendra gearwe stōwe, þǣr his līc-homa leger-bedde fæst swefeð æfter symle.
text_bare: ac gesacan sceal sawl-berendra nyde genydde niðða bearna grund-buendra gearwe stowe, þær his lic-homa leger-bedde fæst swefeð æfter symle.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Þā wæs sǣl and mǣl, þæt tō healle gang Healfdenes sunu; wolde self cyning symbel þicgan.
text_bare: Þa wæs sæl and mæl, þæt to healle gang Healfdenes sunu; wolde self cyning symbel þicgan.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Ne gefrægen ic þā mǣgðe māran weorode ymb hyra sinc-gyfan sēl gebǣran.
text_bare: Ne gefrægen ic þa mægðe maran weorode ymb hyra sinc-gyfan sel gebæran.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Bugon þā tō bence blǣd-āgende, fylle gefǣgon.
text_bare: Bugon þa to bence blæd-agende, fylle gefægon.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Fægere geþǣgon medo-ful manig māgas þāra swīð-hicgende on sele þām hēan, Hrōðgār and Hrōðulf.
text_bare: Fægere geþægon medo-ful manig magas þara swið-hicgende on sele þam hean, Hroðgar and Hroðulf.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Heorot innan wæs frēondum āfylled; nalles fācen-stafas Þēod-Scyldingas þenden fremedon.
text_bare: Heorot innan wæs freondum afylled; nalles facen-stafas Þeod-Scyldingas þenden fremedon.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Forgeaf þā Bēowulfe bearn Healfdenes segen gyldenne sigores tō lēane, hroden hilte-cumbor, helm and byrnan; mǣre māððum-sweord manige gesāwon beforan beorn beran.
text_bare: Forgeaf þa Beowulfe bearn Healfdenes segen gyldenne sigores to leane, hroden hilte-cumbor, helm and byrnan; mære maððum-sweord manige gesawon beforan beorn beran.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Bēowulf geþah ful on flette; nō hē þǣre feoh-gyfte for scēotendum scamigan þorfte, ne gefrægn ic frēondlīcor fēower mādmas golde gegyrede gum-manna fela in ealo-bence ōðrum gesellan.
text_bare: Beowulf geþah ful on flette; no he þære feoh-gyfte for sceotendum scamigan þorfte, ne gefrægn ic freondlicor feower madmas golde gegyrede gum-manna fela in ealo-bence oðrum gesellan.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Ymb þæs helmes hrōf hēafod-beorge wīrum bewunden walan ūtan hēold, þæt him fēla lāfe frēcne ne meahton scūr-heard sceððan, þonne scyld-freca ongēan gramum gangan scolde.
text_bare: Ymb þæs helmes hrof heafod-beorge wirum bewunden walan utan heold, þæt him fela lafe frecne ne meahton scur-heard sceððan, þonne scyld-freca ongean gramum gangan scolde.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Heht þā eorla hlēo eahta mēaras, fǣted-hlēore, on flet tēon in under eoderas; þāra ānum stōd sadol searwum fāh since gewurðad, þæt wæs hilde-setl hēah-cyninges, þonne sweorda gelāc sunu Healfdenes efnan wolde; nǣfre on ōre læg wīd-cūðes wīg, þonne walu fēollon.
text_bare: Heht þa eorla hleo eahta mearas, fæted-hleore, on flet teon in under eoderas; þara anum stod sadol searwum fah since gewurðad, þæt wæs hilde-setl heah-cyninges, þonne sweorda gelac sunu Healfdenes efnan wolde; næfre on ore læg wid-cuðes wig, þonne walu feollon.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: And þā Bēowulfe bēga gehwæðres eodor Ingwina onweald getēah, wicga and wǣpna; hēt hine wēl brūcan.
text_bare: And þa Beowulfe bega gehwæðres eodor Ingwina onweald geteah, wicga and wæpna; het hine wel brucan.

section: XVI. THE BANQUET AND THE GIFTS.
text: Swā manlīce mǣre þēoden, hord-weard hæleða heaðo-rǣsas geald mēarum and mādmum, swā hȳ nǣfre man lyhð, sē þe secgan wile sōð æfter rihte.
text_bare: Swa manlice mære þeoden, hord-weard hæleða heaðo-ræsas geald mearum and madmum, swa hy næfre man lyhð, se þe secgan wile soð æfter rihte.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: Þā gȳt ǣghwylcum eorla drihten þāra þe mid Bēowulfe brim-lāde tēah, on þǣre medu-bence māððum gesealde, yrfe-lāfe, and þone ǣnne heht golde forgyldan, þone þe Grendel ǣr māne ācwealde, swā hē hyra mā wolde, nefne him wītig god wyrd forstōde and þæs mannes mōd: metod eallum wēold gumena cynnes, swā hē nū gīt dēð; forþan bið andgit ǣghwǣr sēlest, ferhðes fore-þanc!
text_bare: Þa gyt æghwylcum eorla drihten þara þe mid Beowulfe brim-lade teah, on þære medu-bence maððum gesealde, yrfe-lafe, and þone ænne heht golde forgyldan, þone þe Grendel ær mane acwealde, swa he hyra ma wolde, nefne him witig god wyrd forstode and þæs mannes mod: metod eallum weold gumena cynnes, swa he nu git deð; forþan bið andgit æghwær selest, ferhðes fore-þanc!

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: fela sceal gebīdan lēofes and lāðes, sē þe longe hēr on þyssum win-dagum worolde brūceð.
text_bare: fela sceal gebidan leofes and laðes, se þe longe her on þyssum win-dagum worolde bruceð.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: Þǣr wæs sang and swēg samod ætgædere fore Healfdenes hilde-wīsan, gomen-wudu grēted, gid oft wrecen, þonne heal-gamen Hrōðgāres scop æfter medo-bence mǣnan scolde Finnes eaferum, þā hīe se fǣr begeat: "Hæleð Healfdenes, Hnæf Scyldinga, "in Fr..es wæle feallan scolde.
text_bare: Þær wæs sang and sweg samod ætgædere fore Healfdenes hilde-wisan, gomen-wudu greted, gid oft wrecen, þonne heal-gamen Hroðgares scop æfter medo-bence mænan scolde Finnes eaferum, þa hie se fær begeat: "Hæleð Healfdenes, Hnæf Scyldinga, "in Fr..es wæle feallan scolde.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: "Nē hūru Hildeburh herian þorfte "Eotena trēowe: unsynnum wearð "beloren lēofum æt þām lind-plegan "bearnum and brōðrum; hīe on gebyrd hruron "gāre wunde; þæt wæs geōmuru ides.
text_bare: "Ne huru Hildeburh herian þorfte "Eotena treowe: unsynnum wearð "beloren leofum æt þam lind-plegan "bearnum and broðrum; hie on gebyrd hruron "gare wunde; þæt wæs geomuru ides.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: "Nalles hōlinga Hōces dōhtor "meotod-sceaft bemearn, syððan morgen cōm, "þā hēo under swegle gesēon meahte "morðor-bealo māga, þǣr hēo ǣr mǣste hēold "worolde wynne: wīg ealle fornam "Finnes þegnas, nemne fēaum ānum, "þæt hē ne mehte on þǣm meðel-stede "wīg Hengeste wiht gefeohtan, "nē þā wēa-lāfe wīge forþringan "þōodnes þegne; ac hig him geþingo budon, "þæt hīe him ōðer flet eal gerȳmdon, "healle and hēah-setl, þæt hīe healfre geweald "wið Eotena bearn āgan mōston, "and æt feoh-gyftum Folcwaldan sunu "dōgra gehwylce Dene weorðode, "Hengestes hēap hringum wenede, "efne swā swīðe sinc-gestrēonum "fǣttan goldes, swā hē Frēsena cyn "on bēor-sele byldan wolde.
text_bare: "Nalles holinga Hoces dohtor "meotod-sceaft bemearn, syððan morgen com, "þa heo under swegle geseon meahte "morðor-bealo maga, þær heo ær mæste heold "worolde wynne: wig ealle fornam "Finnes þegnas, nemne feaum anum, "þæt he ne mehte on þæm meðel-stede "wig Hengeste wiht gefeohtan, "ne þa wea-lafe wige forþringan "þoodnes þegne; ac hig him geþingo budon, "þæt hie him oðer flet eal gerymdon, "healle and heah-setl, þæt hie healfre geweald "wið Eotena bearn agan moston, "and æt feoh-gyftum Folcwaldan sunu "dogra gehwylce Dene weorðode, "Hengestes heap hringum wenede, "efne swa swiðe sinc-gestreonum "fættan goldes, swa he Fresena cyn "on beor-sele byldan wolde.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: "Þā hīe getruwedon on twā healfa "fæste frioðu-wǣre; Fin Hengeste "elne unflitme āðum benemde, "þæt hē þā wēa-lāfe weotena dōme "ārum heolde, þæt þǣr ǣnig mon "wordum nē worcum wǣre ne brǣce, "nē þurh inwit-searo ǣfre gemǣnden, "þēah hīe hira bēag-gyfan banan folgedon "þēoden-lēase, þā him swā geþearfod wæs: "gyf þonne Frȳsna hwylc frēcnan sprǣce "þæs morðor-hetes myndgiend wǣre, "þonne hit sweordes ecg syððan scolde.
text_bare: "Þa hie getruwedon on twa healfa "fæste frioðu-wære; Fin Hengeste "elne unflitme aðum benemde, "þæt he þa wea-lafe weotena dome "arum heolde, þæt þær ænig mon "wordum ne worcum wære ne bræce, "ne þurh inwit-searo æfre gemænden, "þeah hie hira beag-gyfan banan folgedon "þeoden-lease, þa him swa geþearfod wæs: "gyf þonne Frysna hwylc frecnan spræce "þæs morðor-hetes myndgiend wære, "þonne hit sweordes ecg syððan scolde.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: "Āð wæs geæfned and icge gold "āhæfen of horde.
text_bare: "Að wæs geæfned and icge gold "ahæfen of horde.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: Here-Scyldinga "betst beado-rinca wæs on bǣl gearu; "æt þǣm āde wæs ēð-gesȳne "swāt-fāh syrce, swȳn eal-gylden, "eofer īren-heard, æðeling manig "wundum āwyrded; sume on wæle crungon.
text_bare: Here-Scyldinga "betst beado-rinca wæs on bæl gearu; "æt þæm ade wæs eð-gesyne "swat-fah syrce, swyn eal-gylden, "eofer iren-heard, æðeling manig "wundum awyrded; sume on wæle crungon.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: "Hēt þā Hildeburh æt Hnæfes āde "hire selfre sunu sweoloðe befæstan, "bān-fatu bærnan and on bǣl dōn.
text_bare: "Het þa Hildeburh æt Hnæfes ade "hire selfre sunu sweoloðe befæstan, "ban-fatu bærnan and on bæl don.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: "Earme on eaxle ides gnornode, "geōmrode giddum; gūð-rinc āstāh.
text_bare: "Earme on eaxle ides gnornode, "geomrode giddum; guð-rinc astah.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: "Wand tō wolcnum wæl-fȳra mǣst, "hlynode for hlāwe; hafelan multon, "ben-geato burston, þonne blōd ætspranc "lāð-bite līces.
text_bare: "Wand to wolcnum wæl-fyra mæst, "hlynode for hlawe; hafelan multon, "ben-geato burston, þonne blod ætspranc "lað-bite lices.

section: XVII. SONG OF HROTHGAR'S POET—THE LAY OF HNAEF AND HENGEST.
text: Līg ealle forswealg, "gǣsta gīfrost, þāra þe þǣr gūð fornam "bēga folces; wæs hira blǣd scacen.
text_bare: Lig ealle forswealg, "gæsta gifrost, þara þe þær guð fornam "bega folces; wæs hira blæd scacen.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: "Gewiton him þā wīgend wīca nēosian, "frēondum befeallen Frȳsland gesēon, "hāmas and hēa-burh.
text_bare: "Gewiton him þa wigend wica neosian, "freondum befeallen Frysland geseon, "hamas and hea-burh.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Hengest þā gȳt "wæl-fāgne winter wunode mid Finne "ealles unhlitme; eard gemunde, "þēah þe hē ne meahte on mere drīfan "hringed-stefnan; holm storme wēol, "won wið winde; winter ȳðe belēac "īs-gebinde oð þæt ōðer cōm "geār in geardas, swā nū gȳt dēð, "þā þe syngales sēle bewitiað, "wuldor-torhtan weder.
text_bare: Hengest þa gyt "wæl-fagne winter wunode mid Finne "ealles unhlitme; eard gemunde, "þeah þe he ne meahte on mere drifan "hringed-stefnan; holm storme weol, "won wið winde; winter yðe beleac "is-gebinde oð þæt oðer com "gear in geardas, swa nu gyt deð, "þa þe syngales sele bewitiað, "wuldor-torhtan weder.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Þā wæs winter scacen, "fæger foldan bearm; fundode wrecca, "gist of geardum; hē tō gyrn-wræce "swīðor þōhte, þonne tō sǣ-lāde, "gif hē torn-gemōt þurhtēon mihte, "þæt hē Eotena bearn inne gemunde.
text_bare: Þa wæs winter scacen, "fæger foldan bearm; fundode wrecca, "gist of geardum; he to gyrn-wræce "swiðor þohte, þonne to sæ-lade, "gif he torn-gemot þurhteon mihte, "þæt he Eotena bearn inne gemunde.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: "Swā hē ne forwyrnde worold-rǣdenne, "þonne him Hūnlāfing hilde-lēoman, "billa sēlest, on bearm dyde: "þæs wǣron mid Eotenum ecge cūðe.
text_bare: "Swa he ne forwyrnde worold-rædenne, "þonne him Hunlafing hilde-leoman, "billa selest, on bearm dyde: "þæs wæron mid Eotenum ecge cuðe.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: "Swylce ferhð-frecan Fin eft begeat "sweord-bealo slīðen æt his selfes hām, "siððan grimne gripe Gūðlaf ond Ōslāf "æfter sǣ-siðe sorge mǣndon, "ætwiton wēana dǣl; ne meahte wǣfre mōd "forhabban in hreðre.
text_bare: "Swylce ferhð-frecan Fin eft begeat "sweord-bealo sliðen æt his selfes ham, "siððan grimne gripe Guðlaf ond Oslaf "æfter sæ-siðe sorge mændon, "ætwiton weana dæl; ne meahte wæfre mod "forhabban in hreðre.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Þā wæs heal hroden "fēonda fēorum, swilce Fin slægen, "cyning on corðre, and sēo cwēn numen.
text_bare: Þa wæs heal hroden "feonda feorum, swilce Fin slægen, "cyning on corðre, and seo cwen numen.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: "Scēotend Scyldinga tō scypum feredon "eal in-gesteald eorð-cyninges, "swylce hīe æt Finnes hām findan meahton "sigla searo-gimma.
text_bare: "Sceotend Scyldinga to scypum feredon "eal in-gesteald eorð-cyninges, "swylce hie æt Finnes ham findan meahton "sigla searo-gimma.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Hīe on sǣ-lāde "drihtlīce wīf tō Denum feredon, "lǣddon tō lēodum." Lēoð wæs āsungen, glēo-mannes gyd.
text_bare: Hie on sæ-lade "drihtlice wif to Denum feredon, "læddon to leodum." Leoð wæs asungen, gleo-mannes gyd.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Gamen eft āstāh, beorhtode benc-swēg, byrelas sealdon wīn of wunder-fatum.
text_bare: Gamen eft astah, beorhtode benc-sweg, byrelas sealdon win of wunder-fatum.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Þā cwōm Wealhþēo forð gān under gyldnum bēage, þǣr þā gōdan twēgen sǣton suhter-gefæderan; þā gȳt wæs hiera sib ætgædere ǣghwylc ōðrum trȳwe.
text_bare: Þa cwom Wealhþeo forð gan under gyldnum beage, þær þa godan twegen sæton suhter-gefæderan; þa gyt wæs hiera sib ætgædere æghwylc oðrum trywe.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Swylce þǣr Unferð þyle æt fōtum sæt frēan Scyldinga: gehwylc hiora his ferhðe trēowde, þæt hē hæfde mōd micel, þēah þe hē his māgum nǣre ārfæst æt ecga gelācum.
text_bare: Swylce þær Unferð þyle æt fotum sæt frean Scyldinga: gehwylc hiora his ferhðe treowde, þæt he hæfde mod micel, þeah þe he his magum nære arfæst æt ecga gelacum.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Spræc þā ides Scyldinga: "Onfōh þissum fulle, frēo-drihten mīn, "sinces brytta; þū on sǣlum wes, "gold-wine gumena, and tō Gēatum sprec "mildum wordum!
text_bare: Spræc þa ides Scyldinga: "Onfoh þissum fulle, freo-drihten min, "sinces brytta; þu on sælum wes, "gold-wine gumena, and to Geatum sprec "mildum wordum!

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Swā sceal man dōn.
text_bare: Swa sceal man don.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: "Bēo wið Gēatas glæd, geofena gemyndig; "nēan and feorran þū nū friðu hafast.
text_bare: "Beo wið Geatas glæd, geofena gemyndig; "nean and feorran þu nu friðu hafast.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: "Mē man sægde, þæt þū þē for sunu wolde "here-rinc habban.
text_bare: "Me man sægde, þæt þu þe for sunu wolde "here-rinc habban.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Heorot is gefǣlsod, "bēah-sele beorhta; brūc þenden þū mōte "manigra mēda and þīnum māgum lǣf "folc and rīce, þonne þū forð scyle "metod-sceaft sēon.
text_bare: Heorot is gefælsod, "beah-sele beorhta; bruc þenden þu mote "manigra meda and þinum magum læf "folc and rice, þonne þu forð scyle "metod-sceaft seon.

section: XVIII. THE GLEEMAN'S TALE IS ENDED.
text: Ic mīnne can "glædne Hrōðulf, þæt hē þā geogoðe wile "ārum healdan, gyf þū ǣr þonne hē, "wine Scildinga, worold oflǣtest; "wēne ic, þæt hē mid gōde gyldan wille "uncran eaferan, gif hē þæt eal gemon, "hwæt wit tō willan and tō worð-myndum "umbor wesendum ǣr ārna gefremedon." Hwearf þā bī bence, þǣr hyre byre wǣron, Hrēðrīc and Hrōðmund, and hæleða bearn, giogoð ætgædere; þǣr se gōda sæt Bēowulf Gēata be þǣm gebrōðrum twǣm.
text_bare: Ic minne can "glædne Hroðulf, þæt he þa geogoðe wile "arum healdan, gyf þu ær þonne he, "wine Scildinga, worold oflætest; "wene ic, þæt he mid gode gyldan wille "uncran eaferan, gif he þæt eal gemon, "hwæt wit to willan and to worð-myndum "umbor wesendum ær arna gefremedon." Hwearf þa bi bence, þær hyre byre wæron, Hreðric and Hroðmund, and hæleða bearn, giogoð ætgædere; þær se goda sæt Beowulf Geata be þæm gebroðrum twæm.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Him wæs ful boren and frēond-laðu wordum bewægned and wunden gold ēstum geēawed, earm-hrēade twā, hrægl and hringas, heals-bēaga mǣst þāra þe ic on foldan gefrægen hæbbe.
text_bare: Him wæs ful boren and freond-laðu wordum bewægned and wunden gold estum geeawed, earm-hreade twa, hrægl and hringas, heals-beaga mæst þara þe ic on foldan gefrægen hæbbe.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Nǣnigne ic under swegle sēlran hȳrde hord-māððum hæleða, syððan Hāma ætwæg tō þǣre byrhtan byrig Brōsinga mene, sigle and sinc-fæt, searo-nīðas fealh Eormenrīces, gecēas ēcne rǣd.
text_bare: Nænigne ic under swegle selran hyrde hord-maððum hæleða, syððan Hama ætwæg to þære byrhtan byrig Brosinga mene, sigle and sinc-fæt, searo-niðas fealh Eormenrices, geceas ecne ræd.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Þone hring hæfde Higelāc Gēata, nefa Swertinges, nȳhstan sīðe, siððan hē under segne sinc ealgode, wæl-rēaf werede; hyne Wyrd fornam, syððan hē for wlenco wēan āhsode, fǣhðe tō Frȳsum; hē þā frætwe wæg, eorclan-stānas ofer ȳða ful, rīce þēoden, hē under rande gecranc; gehwearf þā in Francna fæðm feorh cyninges, brēost-gewǣdu and se bēah somod: wyrsan wīg-frecan wæl rēafedon æfter gūð-sceare, Gēata lēode hreā-wīc hēoldon.
text_bare: Þone hring hæfde Higelac Geata, nefa Swertinges, nyhstan siðe, siððan he under segne sinc ealgode, wæl-reaf werede; hyne Wyrd fornam, syððan he for wlenco wean ahsode, fæhðe to Frysum; he þa frætwe wæg, eorclan-stanas ofer yða ful, rice þeoden, he under rande gecranc; gehwearf þa in Francna fæðm feorh cyninges, breost-gewædu and se beah somod: wyrsan wig-frecan wæl reafedon æfter guð-sceare, Geata leode hrea-wic heoldon.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Heal swēge onfēng.
text_bare: Heal swege onfeng.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Wealhþēo maðelode, hēo fore þǣm werede spræc: "Brūc þisses bēages, Bēowulf, lēofa "hyse, mid hǣle, and þisses hrægles nēot "þēod-gestrēona, and geþēoh tela, "cen þec mid cræfte and þyssum cnyhtum wes "lāra līðe!
text_bare: Wealhþeo maðelode, heo fore þæm werede spræc: "Bruc þisses beages, Beowulf, leofa "hyse, mid hæle, and þisses hrægles neot "þeod-gestreona, and geþeoh tela, "cen þec mid cræfte and þyssum cnyhtum wes "lara liðe!

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: ic þē þæs lēan geman.
text_bare: ic þe þæs lean geman.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: "Hafast þū gefēred, þæt þē feor and nēah "ealne wīde-ferhð weras ehtigað, "efne swā sīde swā sǣ bebūgeð "windige weallas.
text_bare: "Hafast þu gefered, þæt þe feor and neah "ealne wide-ferhð weras ehtigað, "efne swa side swa sæ bebugeð "windige weallas.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Wes, þenden þū lifige, "æðeling ēadig!
text_bare: Wes, þenden þu lifige, "æðeling eadig!

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: ic þē an tela "sinc-gestrēona.
text_bare: ic þe an tela "sinc-gestreona.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Bēo þū suna mīnum "dǣdum gedēfe drēam healdende!
text_bare: Beo þu suna minum "dædum gedefe dream healdende!

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: "Hēr is ǣghwylc eorl ōðrum getrȳwe, "mōdes milde, man-drihtne hold, "þegnas syndon geþwǣre, þēod eal gearo: "druncne dryht-guman, dōð swā ic bidde!" Ēode þā tō setle.
text_bare: "Her is æghwylc eorl oðrum getrywe, "modes milde, man-drihtne hold, "þegnas syndon geþwære, þeod eal gearo: "druncne dryht-guman, doð swa ic bidde!" Eode þa to setle.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Þǣr wæs symbla cyst, druncon wīn weras: wyrd ne cūðon, geō-sceaft grimme, swā hit āgangen wearð eorla manegum, syððan ǣfen cwōm and him Hrōðgār gewāt tō hofe sīnum, rīce tō ræste.
text_bare: Þær wæs symbla cyst, druncon win weras: wyrd ne cuðon, geo-sceaft grimme, swa hit agangen wearð eorla manegum, syððan æfen cwom and him Hroðgar gewat to hofe sinum, rice to ræste.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Reced weardode unrīm eorla, swā hīe oft ǣr dydon: benc-þelu beredon, hit geond-brǣded wearð beddum and bolstrum.
text_bare: Reced weardode unrim eorla, swa hie oft ær dydon: benc-þelu beredon, hit geond-bræded wearð beddum and bolstrum.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Bēor-scealca sum fūs and fǣge flet-ræste gebēag.
text_bare: Beor-scealca sum fus and fæge flet-ræste gebeag.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Setton him tō hēafdum hilde-randas, bord-wudu beorhtan; þǣr on bence wæs ofer æðelinge ȳð-gesēne heaðo-stēapa helm, hringed byrne, þrec-wudu þrymlīc.
text_bare: Setton him to heafdum hilde-randas, bord-wudu beorhtan; þær on bence wæs ofer æðelinge yð-gesene heaðo-steapa helm, hringed byrne, þrec-wudu þrymlic.

section: XIX. BEOWULF'S JEWELLED COLLAR. THE HEROES REST.
text: Wæs þēaw hyra, þæt hīe oft wǣron an wīg gearwe, gē æt hām gē on herge, gē gehwæðer þāra efne swylce mǣla, swylce hira man-dryhtne þearf gesǣlde; wæs sēo þēod tilu.
text_bare: Wæs þeaw hyra, þæt hie oft wæron an wig gearwe, ge æt ham ge on herge, ge gehwæðer þara efne swylce mæla, swylce hira man-dryhtne þearf gesælde; wæs seo þeod tilu.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Sigon þā tō slǣpe.
text_bare: Sigon þa to slæpe.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Sum sāre angeald ǣfen-ræste, swā him ful-oft gelamp, siððan gold-sele Grendel warode, unriht æfnde, oð þæt ende becwōm, swylt æfter synnum.
text_bare: Sum sare angeald æfen-ræste, swa him ful-oft gelamp, siððan gold-sele Grendel warode, unriht æfnde, oð þæt ende becwom, swylt æfter synnum.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Þæt gesȳne wearð, wīd-cūð werum, þætte wrecend þā gȳt lifde æfter lāðum, lange þrāge æfter gūð-ceare; Grendles mōdor, ides āglǣc-wīf yrmðe gemunde, sē þe wæter-egesan wunian scolde, cealde strēamas, siððan Cain wearð tō ecg-banan āngan brēðer, fæderen-mǣge; hē þā fāg gewāt, morðre gemearcod man-drēam flēon, wēsten warode.
text_bare: Þæt gesyne wearð, wid-cuð werum, þætte wrecend þa gyt lifde æfter laðum, lange þrage æfter guð-ceare; Grendles modor, ides aglæc-wif yrmðe gemunde, se þe wæter-egesan wunian scolde, cealde streamas, siððan Cain wearð to ecg-banan angan breðer, fæderen-mæge; he þa fag gewat, morðre gemearcod man-dream fleon, westen warode.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Þanon wōc fela geōsceaft-gāsta; wæs þǣra Grendel sum, heoro-wearh hetelīc, sē æt Heorote fand wæccendne wer wīges bīdan, þǣr him āglǣca æt-grǣpe wearð; hwæðre hē gemunde mægenes strenge, gim-fæste gife, þē him god sealde, and him tō anwaldan āre gelȳfde, frōfre and fultum: þȳ hē þone fēond ofercwōm, gehnǣgde helle gāst: þā hē hēan gewāt, drēame bedǣled dēað-wīc sēon, man-cynnes fēond.
text_bare: Þanon woc fela geosceaft-gasta; wæs þæra Grendel sum, heoro-wearh hetelic, se æt Heorote fand wæccendne wer wiges bidan, þær him aglæca æt-græpe wearð; hwæðre he gemunde mægenes strenge, gim-fæste gife, þe him god sealde, and him to anwaldan are gelyfde, frofre and fultum: þy he þone feond ofercwom, gehnægde helle gast: þa he hean gewat, dreame bedæled deað-wic seon, man-cynnes feond.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: And his mōdor þā gȳt gīfre and galg-mōd gegān wolde sorh-fulne sīð, suna dēað wrecan.
text_bare: And his modor þa gyt gifre and galg-mod gegan wolde sorh-fulne sið, suna deað wrecan.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Cōm þā tō Heorote, þǣr Hring-Dene geond þæt sæld swǣfun.
text_bare: Com þa to Heorote, þær Hring-Dene geond þæt sæld swæfun.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Þā þǣr sōna wearð ed-hwyrft eorlum, siððan inne fealh Grendles mōdor; wæs se gryre lǣssa efne swā micle, swā bið mægða cræft, wīg-gryre wīfes be wǣpned-men, þonne heoru bunden, hamere geþuren, sweord swāte fāh swīn ofer helme, ecgum dyhtig andweard scireð.
text_bare: Þa þær sona wearð ed-hwyrft eorlum, siððan inne fealh Grendles modor; wæs se gryre læssa efne swa micle, swa bið mægða cræft, wig-gryre wifes be wæpned-men, þonne heoru bunden, hamere geþuren, sweord swate fah swin ofer helme, ecgum dyhtig andweard scireð.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Þā wæs on healle heard-ecg togen, sweord ofer setlum, sīd-rand manig hafen handa fæst; helm ne gemunde, byrnan sīde, þe hine se brōga angeat.
text_bare: Þa wæs on healle heard-ecg togen, sweord ofer setlum, sid-rand manig hafen handa fæst; helm ne gemunde, byrnan side, þe hine se broga angeat.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Hēo wæs on ofste, wolde ūt þanon fēore beorgan, þā hēo onfunden wæs; hraðe hēo æðelinga ānne hæfde fæste befangen, þā hēo tō fenne gang; sē wæs Hrōðgāre hæleða lēofost on gesīðes hād be sǣm tweonum, rīce rand-wiga, þone þe hēo on ræste ābrēat, blǣd-fæstne beorn.
text_bare: Heo wæs on ofste, wolde ut þanon feore beorgan, þa heo onfunden wæs; hraðe heo æðelinga anne hæfde fæste befangen, þa heo to fenne gang; se wæs Hroðgare hæleða leofost on gesiðes had be sæm tweonum, rice rand-wiga, þone þe heo on ræste abreat, blæd-fæstne beorn.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Næs Bēowulf þǣr, ac wæs ōðer in ǣr geteohhod æfter māððum-gife mǣrum Gēate.
text_bare: Næs Beowulf þær, ac wæs oðer in ær geteohhod æfter maððum-gife mærum Geate.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Hrēam wearð on Heorote.
text_bare: Hream wearð on Heorote.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Hēo under heolfre genam cūðe folme; cearu wæs genīwod geworden in wīcum: ne wæs þæt gewrixle til, þæt hīe on bā healfa bicgan scoldon frēonda fēorum.
text_bare: Heo under heolfre genam cuðe folme; cearu wæs geniwod geworden in wicum: ne wæs þæt gewrixle til, þæt hie on ba healfa bicgan scoldon freonda feorum.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Þā wæs frōd cyning, hār hilde-rinc, on hrēon mōde, syððan hē aldor-þegn unlyfigendne, þone dēorestan dēadne wisse.
text_bare: Þa wæs frod cyning, har hilde-rinc, on hreon mode, syððan he aldor-þegn unlyfigendne, þone deorestan deadne wisse.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Hraðe wæs tō būre Bēowulf fetod, sigor-ēadig secg.
text_bare: Hraðe wæs to bure Beowulf fetod, sigor-eadig secg.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Samod ǣr-dæge ēode eorla sum, æðele cempa self mid gesīðum, þǣr se snottra bād, hwæðre him al-walda ǣfre wille æfter wēa-spelle wyrpe gefremman.
text_bare: Samod ær-dæge eode eorla sum, æðele cempa self mid gesiðum, þær se snottra bad, hwæðre him al-walda æfre wille æfter wea-spelle wyrpe gefremman.

section: XX. GRENDEL'S MOTHER ATTACKS THE RING-DANES.
text: Gang þā æfter flōre fyrd-wyrðe man mid his hand-scale heal-wudu dynede þæt hē þone wīsan wordum hnǣgde frēan Ingwina; frægn gif him wǣre æfter nēod-laðu niht getǣse.
text_bare: Gang þa æfter flore fyrd-wyrðe man mid his hand-scale heal-wudu dynede þæt he þone wisan wordum hnægde frean Ingwina; frægn gif him wære æfter neod-laðu niht getæse.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: Hrōðgār maðelode, helm Scildinga: "Ne frīn þū æfter sǣlum!
text_bare: Hroðgar maðelode, helm Scildinga: "Ne frin þu æfter sælum!

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: Sorh is genīwod "Denigea lēodum.
text_bare: Sorh is geniwod "Denigea leodum.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: Dēad is Æsc-here, "Yrmenlāfes yldra brōðor, "mīn rūn-wita and mīn rǣd-bora, "eaxl-gestealla, þonne wē on orlege "hafelan weredon, þonne hniton fēðan, "eoferas cnysedan; swylc scolde eorl wesan "æðeling ǣr-gōd, swylc Æsc-here wæs.
text_bare: Dead is Æsc-here, "Yrmenlafes yldra broðor, "min run-wita and min ræd-bora, "eaxl-gestealla, þonne we on orlege "hafelan weredon, þonne hniton feðan, "eoferas cnysedan; swylc scolde eorl wesan "æðeling ær-god, swylc Æsc-here wæs.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: "Wearð him on Heorote tō hand-banan "wæl-gǣst wǣfre; ic ne wāt hwæder "atol ǣse wlanc eft-sīðas tēah, "fylle gefrǣgnod.
text_bare: "Wearð him on Heorote to hand-banan "wæl-gæst wæfre; ic ne wat hwæder "atol æse wlanc eft-siðas teah, "fylle gefrægnod.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: Hēo þā fǣhðe wræc, "þē þū gystran niht Grendel cwealdest "þurh hǣstne hād heardum clammum, "forþan hē tō lange lēode mīne "wanode and wyrde.
text_bare: Heo þa fæhðe wræc, "þe þu gystran niht Grendel cwealdest "þurh hæstne had heardum clammum, "forþan he to lange leode mine "wanode and wyrde.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: Hē æt wīge gecrang "ealdres scyldig, and nū ōðer cwōm "mihtig mān-scaða, wolde hyre mǣg wrecan, "gē feor hafað fǣhðe gestǣled, "þæs þe þincean mæg þegne monegum, "sē þe æfter sinc-gyfan on sefan grēoteð, "hreðer-bealo hearde; nū sēo hand ligeð, "sē þe ēow wēl-hwylcra wilna dohte.
text_bare: He æt wige gecrang "ealdres scyldig, and nu oðer cwom "mihtig man-scaða, wolde hyre mæg wrecan, "ge feor hafað fæhðe gestæled, "þæs þe þincean mæg þegne monegum, "se þe æfter sinc-gyfan on sefan greoteð, "hreðer-bealo hearde; nu seo hand ligeð, "se þe eow wel-hwylcra wilna dohte.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: "Ic þæt lond-būend lēode mīne "sele-rǣdende secgan hȳrde, "þæt hīe gesāwon swylce twēgen "micle mearc-stapan mōras healdan, "ellor-gǣstas: þǣra ōðer wæs, "þæs þe hīe gewislīcost gewitan meahton, "idese onlīcnes, ōðer earm-sceapen "on weres wæstmum wræc-lāstas træd, "næfne hē wæs māra þonne ǣnig man ōðer, "þone on geār-dagum Grendel nemdon "fold-būende: nō hīe fæder cunnon, "hwæðer him ǣnig wæs ǣr ācenned "dyrnra gāsta.
text_bare: "Ic þæt lond-buend leode mine "sele-rædende secgan hyrde, "þæt hie gesawon swylce twegen "micle mearc-stapan moras healdan, "ellor-gæstas: þæra oðer wæs, "þæs þe hie gewislicost gewitan meahton, "idese onlicnes, oðer earm-sceapen "on weres wæstmum wræc-lastas træd, "næfne he wæs mara þonne ænig man oðer, "þone on gear-dagum Grendel nemdon "fold-buende: no hie fæder cunnon, "hwæðer him ænig wæs ær acenned "dyrnra gasta.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: Hīe dȳgel lond "warigeað, wulf-hleoðu, windige næssas, "frēcne fen-gelād, þǣr fyrgen-strēam "under næssa genipu niðer gewīteð, "flōd under foldan; nis þæt feor heonon "mīl-gemearces, þæt se mere standeð, "ofer þǣm hongiað hrīmge bearwas, "wudu wyrtum fæst, wæter oferhelmað.
text_bare: Hie dygel lond "warigeað, wulf-hleoðu, windige næssas, "frecne fen-gelad, þær fyrgen-stream "under næssa genipu niðer gewiteð, "flod under foldan; nis þæt feor heonon "mil-gemearces, þæt se mere standeð, "ofer þæm hongiað hrimge bearwas, "wudu wyrtum fæst, wæter oferhelmað.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: "Þǣr mæg nihta gehwǣm nīð-wundor sēon, "fȳr on flōde; nō þæs frōd leofað "gumena bearna, þæt þone grund wite; "þēah þe hǣð-stapa hundum geswenced, "heorot hornum trum holt-wudu sēce, "feorran geflȳmed, ǣr hē feorh seleð, "aldor on ōfre, ǣr hē in wille, "hafelan hȳdan.
text_bare: "Þær mæg nihta gehwæm nið-wundor seon, "fyr on flode; no þæs frod leofað "gumena bearna, þæt þone grund wite; "þeah þe hæð-stapa hundum geswenced, "heorot hornum trum holt-wudu sece, "feorran geflymed, ær he feorh seleð, "aldor on ofre, ær he in wille, "hafelan hydan.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: Nis þæt hēoru stōw: "þonon ȳð-geblond up āstīgeð "won tō wolcnum, þonne wind styreð "lāð gewidru, oð þæt lyft drysmað, "roderas rēotað.
text_bare: Nis þæt heoru stow: "þonon yð-geblond up astigeð "won to wolcnum, þonne wind styreð "lað gewidru, oð þæt lyft drysmað, "roderas reotað.

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: Nū is rǣd gelang "eft æt þē ānum!
text_bare: Nu is ræd gelang "eft æt þe anum!

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: Eard gīt ne const, "frēcne stōwe, þǣr þū findan miht "sinnigne secg: sēc gif þū dyrre!
text_bare: Eard git ne const, "frecne stowe, þær þu findan miht "sinnigne secg: sec gif þu dyrre!

section: XXI. SORROW AT HEOROT: AESCHERE'S DEATH
text: "Ic þē þā fǣhðe fēo lēanige, "eald-gestrēonum, swā ic ǣr dyde, "wundnum golde, gyf þū on weg cymest."
text_bare: "Ic þe þa fæhðe feo leanige, "eald-gestreonum, swa ic ær dyde, "wundnum golde, gyf þu on weg cymest."

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Bēowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: "Ne sorga, snotor guma!
text_bare: Beowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: "Ne sorga, snotor guma!

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: sēlre bið ǣghwǣm, "þæt hē his frēond wrece, þonne hē fela murne; "ūre ǣghwylc sceal ende gebīdan "worolde līfes; wyrce sē þe mōte "dōmes ǣr dēaðe!
text_bare: selre bið æghwæm, "þæt he his freond wrece, þonne he fela murne; "ure æghwylc sceal ende gebidan "worolde lifes; wyrce se þe mote "domes ær deaðe!

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: þæt bið driht-guman "unlifgendum æfter sēlest.
text_bare: þæt bið driht-guman "unlifgendum æfter selest.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: "Ārīs, rīces weard; uton hraðe fēran, "Grendles māgan gang scēawigan!
text_bare: "Aris, rices weard; uton hraðe feran, "Grendles magan gang sceawigan!

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: "Ic hit þē gehāte: nō hē on helm losað, "nē on foldan fæðm, nē on fyrgen-holt, "nē on gyfenes grund, gā þǣr hē wille.
text_bare: "Ic hit þe gehate: no he on helm losað, "ne on foldan fæðm, ne on fyrgen-holt, "ne on gyfenes grund, ga þær he wille.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: "Þȳs dōgor þū geþyld hafa "wēana gehwylces, swā ic þē wēne tō!" Āhlēop þā se gomela, gode þancode, mihtigan drihtne, þæs se man gespræc.
text_bare: "Þys dogor þu geþyld hafa "weana gehwylces, swa ic þe wene to!" Ahleop þa se gomela, gode þancode, mihtigan drihtne, þæs se man gespræc.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Þā wæs Hrōðgāre hors gebǣted, wicg wunden-feax.
text_bare: Þa wæs Hroðgare hors gebæted, wicg wunden-feax.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Wīsa fengel geatolīc gengde; gum-fēða stōp lind-hæbbendra.
text_bare: Wisa fengel geatolic gengde; gum-feða stop lind-hæbbendra.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Lāstas wǣron æfter wald-swaðum wīde gesȳne, gang ofer grundas; gegnum fōr þā ofer myrcan mōr, mago-þegna bær þone sēlestan sāwol-lēasne, þāra þe mid Hrōðgāre hām eahtode.
text_bare: Lastas wæron æfter wald-swaðum wide gesyne, gang ofer grundas; gegnum for þa ofer myrcan mor, mago-þegna bær þone selestan sawol-leasne, þara þe mid Hroðgare ham eahtode.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Ofer-ēode þā æðelinga bearn stēap stān-hliðo, stīge nearwe, enge ān-paðas, un-cūð gelād, neowle næssas, nicor-hūsa fela; hē fēara sum beforan gengde wīsra monna, wong scēawian, oð þæt hē fǣringa fyrgen-bēamas ofer hārne stān hleonian funde, wyn-lēasne wudu; wæter under stōd drēorig and gedrēfed.
text_bare: Ofer-eode þa æðelinga bearn steap stan-hliðo, stige nearwe, enge an-paðas, un-cuð gelad, neowle næssas, nicor-husa fela; he feara sum beforan gengde wisra monna, wong sceawian, oð þæt he færinga fyrgen-beamas ofer harne stan hleonian funde, wyn-leasne wudu; wæter under stod dreorig and gedrefed.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Denum eallum wæs, winum Scyldinga, weorce on mōde, tō geþolianne þegne monegum, oncȳð eorla gehwǣm, syððan Æsc-heres on þām holm-clife hafelan mētton.
text_bare: Denum eallum wæs, winum Scyldinga, weorce on mode, to geþolianne þegne monegum, oncyð eorla gehwæm, syððan Æsc-heres on þam holm-clife hafelan metton.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Flōd blōde wēol folc tō sǣgon hātan heolfre.
text_bare: Flod blode weol folc to sægon hatan heolfre.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Horn stundum song fūslīc fyrd-lēoð.
text_bare: Horn stundum song fuslic fyrd-leoð.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Fēða eal gesæt; gesāwon þā æfter wætere wyrm-cynnes fela, sellīce sǣ-dracan sund cunnian, swylce on næs-hleoðum nicras licgean, þā on undern-mǣl oft bewitigað sorh-fulne sīð on segl-rāde, wyrmas and wil-dēor; hīe on weg hruron bitere and gebolgne, bearhtm ongeāton, gūð-horn galan.
text_bare: Feða eal gesæt; gesawon þa æfter wætere wyrm-cynnes fela, sellice sæ-dracan sund cunnian, swylce on næs-hleoðum nicras licgean, þa on undern-mæl oft bewitigað sorh-fulne sið on segl-rade, wyrmas and wil-deor; hie on weg hruron bitere and gebolgne, bearhtm ongeaton, guð-horn galan.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Sumne Gēata lēod of flān-bogan fēores getwǣfde, ȳð-gewinnes, þæt him on aldre stōd here-strǣl hearda; hē on holme wæs sundes þē sǣnra, þē hyne swylt fornam.
text_bare: Sumne Geata leod of flan-bogan feores getwæfde, yð-gewinnes, þæt him on aldre stod here-stræl hearda; he on holme wæs sundes þe sænra, þe hyne swylt fornam.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Hræðe wearð on ȳðum mid eofer-sprēotum heoro-hōcyhtum hearde genearwod, nīða genǣged and on næs togen wundorlīc wǣg-bora; weras scēawedon gryrelīcne gist.
text_bare: Hræðe wearð on yðum mid eofer-spreotum heoro-hocyhtum hearde genearwod, niða genæged and on næs togen wundorlic wæg-bora; weras sceawedon gryrelicne gist.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Gyrede hine Bēowulf eorl-gewǣdum, nalles for ealdre mearn: scolde here-byrne hondum gebrōden, sīd and searo-fāh, sund cunnian, sēo þe bān-cofan beorgan cūðe, þæt him hilde-grāp hreðre ne mihte, eorres inwit-feng, aldre gesceððan; ac se hwīta helm hafelan werede, sē þe mere-grundas mengan scolde, sēcan sund-gebland since geweorðad, befongen frēa-wrāsnum, swā hine fyrn-dagum worhte wǣpna smið, wundrum tēode, besette swīn-līcum, þæt hine syððan nō brond nē beado-mēcas bītan ne meahton.
text_bare: Gyrede hine Beowulf eorl-gewædum, nalles for ealdre mearn: scolde here-byrne hondum gebroden, sid and searo-fah, sund cunnian, seo þe ban-cofan beorgan cuðe, þæt him hilde-grap hreðre ne mihte, eorres inwit-feng, aldre gesceððan; ac se hwita helm hafelan werede, se þe mere-grundas mengan scolde, secan sund-gebland since geweorðad, befongen frea-wrasnum, swa hine fyrn-dagum worhte wæpna smið, wundrum teode, besette swin-licum, þæt hine syððan no brond ne beado-mecas bitan ne meahton.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Næs þæt þonne mǣtost mægen-fultuma, þæt him on þearfe lāh þyle Hrōðgāres; wæs þǣm hæft-mēce Hrunting nama, þæt wæs ān foran eald-gestrēona; ecg wæs īren āter-tēarum fāh, āhyrded heaðo-swāte; nǣfre hit æt hilde ne swāc manna ǣngum þāra þe hit mid mundum bewand, sē þe gryre-sīðas gegān dorste, folc-stede fāra; næs þæt forma sīð, þæt hit ellen-weorc æfnan scolde.
text_bare: Næs þæt þonne mætost mægen-fultuma, þæt him on þearfe lah þyle Hroðgares; wæs þæm hæft-mece Hrunting nama, þæt wæs an foran eald-gestreona; ecg wæs iren ater-tearum fah, ahyrded heaðo-swate; næfre hit æt hilde ne swac manna ængum þara þe hit mid mundum bewand, se þe gryre-siðas gegan dorste, folc-stede fara; næs þæt forma sið, þæt hit ellen-weorc æfnan scolde.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Hūru ne gemunde mago Ecglāfes eafoðes cræftig, þæt hē ǣr gespræc wīne druncen, þā hē þæs wǣpnes onlāh sēlran sweord-frecan: selfa ne dorste under ȳða gewin aldre genēðan, driht-scype drēogan; þǣr hē dōme forlēas, ellen-mǣrðum.
text_bare: Huru ne gemunde mago Ecglafes eafoðes cræftig, þæt he ær gespræc wine druncen, þa he þæs wæpnes onlah selran sweord-frecan: selfa ne dorste under yða gewin aldre geneðan, driht-scype dreogan; þær he dome forleas, ellen-mærðum.

section: XXII. BEOWULF SEEKS THE MONSTER IN THE HAUNTS OF THE NIXIES.
text: Ne wæs þǣm ōðrum swā, syððan hē hine tō gūðe gegyred hæfde.
text_bare: Ne wæs þæm oðrum swa, syððan he hine to guðe gegyred hæfde.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Bēowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: "geþenc nū, se mǣra maga Healfdenes, "snottra fengel, nū ic eom sīðes fūs, "gold-wine gumena, hwæt wit geō sprǣcon, "gif ic æt þearfe þīnre scolde "aldre linnan, þæt þū mē ā wǣre "forð-gewitenum on fæder stǣle; "wes þū mund-bora mīnum mago-þegnum, "hond-gesellum, gif mec hild nime: "swylce þū þā mādmas, þē þū mē sealdest, "Hrōðgār lēofa, Higelāce onsend.
text_bare: Beowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: "geþenc nu, se mæra maga Healfdenes, "snottra fengel, nu ic eom siðes fus, "gold-wine gumena, hwæt wit geo spræcon, "gif ic æt þearfe þinre scolde "aldre linnan, þæt þu me a wære "forð-gewitenum on fæder stæle; "wes þu mund-bora minum mago-þegnum, "hond-gesellum, gif mec hild nime: "swylce þu þa madmas, þe þu me sealdest, "Hroðgar leofa, Higelace onsend.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: "Mæg þonne on þǣm golde ongitan Gēata dryhten, "gesēon sunu Hrēðles, þonne hē on þæt sinc starað, "þæt ic gum-cystum gōdne funde "bēaga bryttan, brēac þonne mōste.
text_bare: "Mæg þonne on þæm golde ongitan Geata dryhten, "geseon sunu Hreðles, þonne he on þæt sinc starað, "þæt ic gum-cystum godne funde "beaga bryttan, breac þonne moste.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: "And þū Unferð lǣt ealde lāfe, "wrǣtlīc wǣg-sweord wīd-cūðne man "heard-ecg habban; ic mē mid Hruntinge "dōm gewyrce, oððe mec dēað nimeð." Æfter þǣm wordum Weder-Gēata lēod efste mid elne, nalas andsware bīdan wolde; brim-wylm onfēng hilde-rince.
text_bare: "And þu Unferð læt ealde lafe, "wrætlic wæg-sweord wid-cuðne man "heard-ecg habban; ic me mid Hruntinge "dom gewyrce, oððe mec deað nimeð." Æfter þæm wordum Weder-Geata leod efste mid elne, nalas andsware bidan wolde; brim-wylm onfeng hilde-rince.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Þā wæs hwīl dæges, ǣr hē þone grund-wong ongytan mehte.
text_bare: Þa wæs hwil dæges, ær he þone grund-wong ongytan mehte.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Sōna þæt onfunde, sē þe flōda begong heoro-gīfre behēold hund missēra, grim and grǣdig, þæt þǣr gumena sum æl-wihta eard ufan cunnode.
text_bare: Sona þæt onfunde, se þe floda begong heoro-gifre beheold hund missera, grim and grædig, þæt þær gumena sum æl-wihta eard ufan cunnode.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Grāp þā tōgēanes, gūð-rinc gefēng atolan clommum; nō þȳ ǣr in gescōd hālan līce: hring ūtan ymb-bearh, þæt hēo þone fyrd-hom þurh-fōn ne mihte, locene leoðo-syrcan lāðan fingrum.
text_bare: Grap þa togeanes, guð-rinc gefeng atolan clommum; no þy ær in gescod halan lice: hring utan ymb-bearh, þæt heo þone fyrd-hom þurh-fon ne mihte, locene leoðo-syrcan laðan fingrum.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Bær þā sēo brim-wylf, þā hēo tō botme cōm, hringa þengel tō hofe sīnum, swā hē ne mihte nō hē þæs mōdig wæs wǣpna gewealdan, ac hine wundra þæs fela swencte on sunde, sǣ-dēor monig hilde-tūxum here-syrcan bræc, ēhton āglǣcan.
text_bare: Bær þa seo brim-wylf, þa heo to botme com, hringa þengel to hofe sinum, swa he ne mihte no he þæs modig wæs wæpna gewealdan, ac hine wundra þæs fela swencte on sunde, sæ-deor monig hilde-tuxum here-syrcan bræc, ehton aglæcan.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Þā se eorl ongeat, þæt hē in nið-sele nāt-hwylcum wæs, þǣr him nǣnig wæter wihte ne sceðede, nē him for hrōf-sele hrīnan ne mehte fǣr-gripe flōdes: fȳr-lēoht geseah, blācne lēoman beorhte scīnan.
text_bare: Þa se eorl ongeat, þæt he in nið-sele nat-hwylcum wæs, þær him nænig wæter wihte ne sceðede, ne him for hrof-sele hrinan ne mehte fær-gripe flodes: fyr-leoht geseah, blacne leoman beorhte scinan.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Ongeat þā se gōda grund-wyrgenne, mere-wīf mihtig; mægen-rǣs forgeaf hilde-bille, hond swenge ne oftēah, þæt hire on hafelan hring-mǣl āgōl grǣdig gūð-lēoð.
text_bare: Ongeat þa se goda grund-wyrgenne, mere-wif mihtig; mægen-ræs forgeaf hilde-bille, hond swenge ne ofteah, þæt hire on hafelan hring-mæl agol grædig guð-leoð.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Þā se gist onfand, þæt se beado-lēoma bītan nolde, aldre sceððan, ac sēo ecg geswāc þēodne æt þearfe: þolode ǣr fela hond-gemōta, helm oft gescær, fǣges fyrd-hrægl: þæt wæs forma sīð dēorum māðme, þæt his dōm ālæg.
text_bare: Þa se gist onfand, þæt se beado-leoma bitan nolde, aldre sceððan, ac seo ecg geswac þeodne æt þearfe: þolode ær fela hond-gemota, helm oft gescær, fæges fyrd-hrægl: þæt wæs forma sið deorum maðme, þæt his dom alæg.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Eft wæs ān-rǣd, nalas elnes læt, mǣrða gemyndig mǣg Hygelāces; wearp þā wunden-mǣl wrǣttum gebunden yrre ōretta, þæt hit on eorðan læg, stīð and stȳl-ecg; strenge getruwode, mund-gripe mægenes.
text_bare: Eft wæs an-ræd, nalas elnes læt, mærða gemyndig mæg Hygelaces; wearp þa wunden-mæl wrættum gebunden yrre oretta, þæt hit on eorðan læg, stið and styl-ecg; strenge getruwode, mund-gripe mægenes.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Swā sceal man dōn, þonne hē æt gūðe gegān þenceð longsumne lof, nā ymb his līf cearað.
text_bare: Swa sceal man don, þonne he æt guðe gegan þenceð longsumne lof, na ymb his lif cearað.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Gefēng þā be eaxle nalas for fǣhðe mearn Gūð-Gēata lēod Grendles mōdor; brægd þā beadwe heard, þā hē gebolgen wæs, feorh-genīðlan, þæt hēo on flet gebēah.
text_bare: Gefeng þa be eaxle nalas for fæhðe mearn Guð-Geata leod Grendles modor; brægd þa beadwe heard, þa he gebolgen wæs, feorh-geniðlan, þæt heo on flet gebeah.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Hēo him eft hraðe and-lēan forgeald grimman grāpum and him tōgēanes fēng; oferwearp þā wērig-mōd wigena strengest, fēðe-cempa, þæt hē on fylle wearð.
text_bare: Heo him eft hraðe and-lean forgeald grimman grapum and him togeanes feng; oferwearp þa werig-mod wigena strengest, feðe-cempa, þæt he on fylle wearð.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Ofsæt þā þone sele-gyst and hyre seaxe getēah, brād and brūn-ecg wolde hire bearn wrecan, āngan eaferan.
text_bare: Ofsæt þa þone sele-gyst and hyre seaxe geteah, brad and brun-ecg wolde hire bearn wrecan, angan eaferan.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Him on eaxle læg brēost-net brōden; þæt gebearh fēore, wið ord and wið ecge ingang forstōd.
text_bare: Him on eaxle læg breost-net broden; þæt gebearh feore, wið ord and wið ecge ingang forstod.

section: XXIII. THE BATTLE WITH THE WATER-DRAKE.
text: Hæfde þā forsīðod sunu Ecgþēowes under gynne grund, Gēata cempa, nemne him heaðo-byrne helpe gefremede, here-net hearde, and hālig god gewēold wīg-sigor, wītig drihten; rodera rǣdend hit on ryht gescēd, ȳðelīce syððan hē eft āstōd.
text_bare: Hæfde þa forsiðod sunu Ecgþeowes under gynne grund, Geata cempa, nemne him heaðo-byrne helpe gefremede, here-net hearde, and halig god geweold wig-sigor, witig drihten; rodera rædend hit on ryht gesced, yðelice syððan he eft astod.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Geseah þā on searwum sige-ēadig bil, eald sweord eotenisc ecgum þȳhtig, wigena weorð-mynd: þæt wæs wǣpna cyst, būton hit wæs māre þonne ǣnig mon ōðer tō beadu-lāce ætberan meahte gōd and geatolīc gīganta geweorc.
text_bare: Geseah þa on searwum sige-eadig bil, eald sweord eotenisc ecgum þyhtig, wigena weorð-mynd: þæt wæs wæpna cyst, buton hit wæs mare þonne ænig mon oðer to beadu-lace ætberan meahte god and geatolic giganta geweorc.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Hē gefēng þā fetel-hilt, freca Scildinga, hrēoh and heoro-grim hring-mǣl gebrægd, aldres orwēna, yrringa slōh, þæt hire wið halse heard grāpode, bān-hringas bræc, bil eal þurh-wōd fǣgne flǣsc-homan, hēo on flet gecrong; sweord wæs swātig, secg weorce gefeh.
text_bare: He gefeng þa fetel-hilt, freca Scildinga, hreoh and heoro-grim hring-mæl gebrægd, aldres orwena, yrringa sloh, þæt hire wið halse heard grapode, ban-hringas bræc, bil eal þurh-wod fægne flæsc-homan, heo on flet gecrong; sweord wæs swatig, secg weorce gefeh.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Līxte se lēoma, lēoht inne stōd, efne swā of hefene hādre scīneð rodores candel.
text_bare: Lixte se leoma, leoht inne stod, efne swa of hefene hadre scineð rodores candel.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Hē æfter recede wlāt, hwearf þā be wealle, wǣpen hafenade heard be hiltum Higelāces þegn, yrre and ān-rǣd.
text_bare: He æfter recede wlat, hwearf þa be wealle, wæpen hafenade heard be hiltum Higelaces þegn, yrre and an-ræd.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Næs sēo ecg fracod hilde-rince, ac hē hraðe wolde Grendle forgyldan gūð-rǣsa fela þāra þe hē geworhte tō West-Denum oftor micle þonne on ǣnne sīð, þonne hē Hrōðgāres heorð-genēatas slōh on sweofote, slǣpende fræt folces Denigea fȳf-tȳne men and ōðer swylc ūt of-ferede, lāðlīcu lāc.
text_bare: Næs seo ecg fracod hilde-rince, ac he hraðe wolde Grendle forgyldan guð-ræsa fela þara þe he geworhte to West-Denum oftor micle þonne on ænne sið, þonne he Hroðgares heorð-geneatas sloh on sweofote, slæpende fræt folces Denigea fyf-tyne men and oðer swylc ut of-ferede, laðlicu lac.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Hē him þæs lēan forgeald, rēðe cempa, tō þæs þe hē on ræste geseah gūð-wērigne Grendel licgan, aldor-lēasne, swā him ǣr gescōd hild æt Heorote; hrā wīde sprong, syððan hē æfter dēaðe drepe þrowade, heoro-sweng heardne, and hine þā hēafde becearf, Sōna þæt gesāwon snottre ceorlas, þā þe mid Hrōðgāre on holm wliton, þæt wæs ȳð-geblond eal gemenged, brim blōde fāh: blonden-feaxe gomele ymb gōdne ongeador sprǣcon, þæt hig þæs æðelinges eft ne wēndon, þæt hē sige-hrēðig sēcean cōme mǣrne þēoden; þā þæs monige gewearð, þæt hine sēo brim-wylf ābroten hæfde.
text_bare: He him þæs lean forgeald, reðe cempa, to þæs þe he on ræste geseah guð-werigne Grendel licgan, aldor-leasne, swa him ær gescod hild æt Heorote; hra wide sprong, syððan he æfter deaðe drepe þrowade, heoro-sweng heardne, and hine þa heafde becearf, Sona þæt gesawon snottre ceorlas, þa þe mid Hroðgare on holm wliton, þæt wæs yð-geblond eal gemenged, brim blode fah: blonden-feaxe gomele ymb godne ongeador spræcon, þæt hig þæs æðelinges eft ne wendon, þæt he sige-hreðig secean come mærne þeoden; þa þæs monige gewearð, þæt hine seo brim-wylf abroten hæfde.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Þā cōm nōn dæges.
text_bare: Þa com non dæges.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Næs ofgēafon hwate Scyldingas; gewāt him hām þonon gold-wine gumena.
text_bare: Næs ofgeafon hwate Scyldingas; gewat him ham þonon gold-wine gumena.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Gistas sētan, mōdes sēoce, and on mere staredon, wiston and ne wēndon, þæt hīe heora wine-drihten selfne gesāwon.
text_bare: Gistas setan, modes seoce, and on mere staredon, wiston and ne wendon, þæt hie heora wine-drihten selfne gesawon.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Þā þæt sweord ongan æfter heaðo-swāte hilde-gicelum wīg-bil wanian; þæt wæs wundra sum, þæt hit eal gemealt īse gelīcost, þonne forstes bend fæder onlǣteð, onwindeð wæl-rāpas, sē þe geweald hafað sǣla and mǣla; þæt is sōð metod.
text_bare: Þa þæt sweord ongan æfter heaðo-swate hilde-gicelum wig-bil wanian; þæt wæs wundra sum, þæt hit eal gemealt ise gelicost, þonne forstes bend fæder onlæteð, onwindeð wæl-rapas, se þe geweald hafað sæla and mæla; þæt is soð metod.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Ne nom hē in þǣm wīcum, Weder-Gēata lēod, māðm-ǣhta mā, þēh hē þǣr monige geseah, būton þone hafelan and þā hilt somod, since fāge; sweord ǣr gemealt, forbarn brōden mǣl: wæs þæt blōd tō þæs hāt, ǣttren ellor-gǣst, sē þǣr inne swealt.
text_bare: Ne nom he in þæm wicum, Weder-Geata leod, maðm-æhta ma, þeh he þær monige geseah, buton þone hafelan and þa hilt somod, since fage; sweord ær gemealt, forbarn broden mæl: wæs þæt blod to þæs hat, ættren ellor-gæst, se þær inne swealt.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Sōna wæs on sunde, sē þe ǣr æt sæcce gebād wīg-hryre wrāðra, wæter up þurh-dēaf; wǣron ȳð-gebland eal gefǣlsod, ēacne eardas, þā se ellor-gāst oflēt līf-dagas and þās lǣnan gesceaft.
text_bare: Sona wæs on sunde, se þe ær æt sæcce gebad wig-hryre wraðra, wæter up þurh-deaf; wæron yð-gebland eal gefælsod, eacne eardas, þa se ellor-gast oflet lif-dagas and þas lænan gesceaft.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Cōm þā tō lande lid-manna helm swīð-mōd swymman, sǣ-lāce gefeah, mægen-byrðenne þāra þe hē him mid hæfde.
text_bare: Com þa to lande lid-manna helm swið-mod swymman, sæ-lace gefeah, mægen-byrðenne þara þe he him mid hæfde.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Ēodon him þā tōgēanes, gode þancodon, þrȳðlīc þegna hēap, þēodnes gefēgon, þæs þe hī hyne gesundne gesēon mōston.
text_bare: Eodon him þa togeanes, gode þancodon, þryðlic þegna heap, þeodnes gefegon, þæs þe hi hyne gesundne geseon moston.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Þā wæs of þǣm hrōran helm and byrne lungre ālȳsed: lagu drūsade, wæter under wolcnum, wæl-drēore fāg.
text_bare: Þa wæs of þæm hroran helm and byrne lungre alysed: lagu drusade, wæter under wolcnum, wæl-dreore fag.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Fērdon forð þonon fēðe-lāstum ferhðum fægne, fold-weg mǣton, cūðe strǣte; cyning-balde men from þǣm holm-clife hafelan bǣron earfoðlīce heora ǣghwæðrum fela-mōdigra: fēower scoldon on ðæm wæl-stenge weorcum geferian tō þǣm gold-sele Grendles hēafod, oð þæt semninga tō sele cōmon frome fyrd-hwate fēower-tȳne Gēata gongan; gum-dryhten mid mōdig on gemonge meodo-wongas træd.
text_bare: Ferdon forð þonon feðe-lastum ferhðum fægne, fold-weg mæton, cuðe stræte; cyning-balde men from þæm holm-clife hafelan bæron earfoðlice heora æghwæðrum fela-modigra: feower scoldon on ðæm wæl-stenge weorcum geferian to þæm gold-sele Grendles heafod, oð þæt semninga to sele comon frome fyrd-hwate feower-tyne Geata gongan; gum-dryhten mid modig on gemonge meodo-wongas træd.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Þā cōm in gān ealdor þegna, dǣd-cēne mon dōme gewurðad, hæle hilde-dēor.
text_bare: Þa com in gan ealdor þegna, dæd-cene mon dome gewurðad, hæle hilde-deor.

section: XXIV. BEOWULF SLAYS THE SPRITE.
text: Hrōðgār grētan: Þā wæs be feaxe on flet boren Grendles hēafod, þǣr guman druncon, egeslīc for eorlum and þǣre idese mid: wlite-sēon wrǣtlīc weras onsāwon.
text_bare: Hroðgar gretan: Þa wæs be feaxe on flet boren Grendles heafod, þær guman druncon, egeslic for eorlum and þære idese mid: wlite-seon wrætlic weras onsawon.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Bēowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: "Hwæt!
text_bare: Beowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: "Hwæt!

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: wē þē þās sǣ-lāc, sunu Healfdenes, "lēod Scyldinga, lustum brōhton, "tīres tō tācne, þē þū hēr tō lōcast.
text_bare: we þe þas sæ-lac, sunu Healfdenes, "leod Scyldinga, lustum brohton, "tires to tacne, þe þu her to locast.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: "Ic þæt unsōfte ealdre gedīgde: "wigge under wætere weorc genēðde "earfoðlīce, æt-rihte wæs "gūð getwǣfed, nymðe mec god scylde.
text_bare: "Ic þæt unsofte ealdre gedigde: "wigge under wætere weorc geneðde "earfoðlice, æt-rihte wæs "guð getwæfed, nymðe mec god scylde.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: "Ne meahte ic æt hilde mid Hruntinge "wiht gewyrcan, þēah þæt wǣpen duge, "ac mē geūðe ylda waldend, "þæt ic on wāge geseah wlitig hangian "eald sweord ēacen oftost wīsode "winigea lēasum þæt ic þȳ wǣpne gebrǣ.
text_bare: "Ne meahte ic æt hilde mid Hruntinge "wiht gewyrcan, þeah þæt wæpen duge, "ac me geuðe ylda waldend, "þæt ic on wage geseah wlitig hangian "eald sweord eacen oftost wisode "winigea leasum þæt ic þy wæpne gebræ.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: "Ofslōh þā æt þǣre sæcce þā mē sǣl āgeald "hūses hyrdas.
text_bare: "Ofsloh þa æt þære sæcce þa me sæl ageald "huses hyrdas.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Þā þæt hilde-bil "forbarn, brogden mǣl, swā þæt blōd gesprang, "hātost heaðo-swāta: ic þæt hilt þanan "fēondum ætferede; fyren-dǣda wræc, "dēað-cwealm Denigea, swā hit gedēfe wæs.
text_bare: Þa þæt hilde-bil "forbarn, brogden mæl, swa þæt blod gesprang, "hatost heaðo-swata: ic þæt hilt þanan "feondum ætferede; fyren-dæda wræc, "deað-cwealm Denigea, swa hit gedefe wæs.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: "Ic hit þē þonne gehāte, þæt þū on Heorote mōst "sorh-lēas swefan mid þīnra secga gedryht, "and þegna gehwylc þīnra lēoda, "duguðe and iogoðe, þæt þū him ondrǣdan ne þearft, "þēoden Scyldinga, on þā healfe, "aldor-bealu eorlum, swā þū ǣr dydest." Þā wæs gylden hilt gamelum rince.
text_bare: "Ic hit þe þonne gehate, þæt þu on Heorote most "sorh-leas swefan mid þinra secga gedryht, "and þegna gehwylc þinra leoda, "duguðe and iogoðe, þæt þu him ondrædan ne þearft, "þeoden Scyldinga, on þa healfe, "aldor-bealu eorlum, swa þu ær dydest." Þa wæs gylden hilt gamelum rince.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: hārum hild-fruman, on hand gyfen, enta ǣr-geweorc, hit on ǣht gehwearf æfter dēofla hryre Denigea frēan, wundor-smiða geweorc, and þā þās worold ofgeaf grom-heort guma, godes andsaca, morðres scyldig, and his mōdor ēac; on geweald gehwearf worold-cyninga þǣm sēlestan be sǣm twēonum þāra þe on Sceden-igge sceattas dǣlde.
text_bare: harum hild-fruman, on hand gyfen, enta ær-geweorc, hit on æht gehwearf æfter deofla hryre Denigea frean, wundor-smiða geweorc, and þa þas worold ofgeaf grom-heort guma, godes andsaca, morðres scyldig, and his modor eac; on geweald gehwearf worold-cyninga þæm selestan be sæm tweonum þara þe on Sceden-igge sceattas dælde.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Hrōðgār maðelode, hylt scēawode, ealde lāfe, on þǣm wæs ōr writen fyrn-gewinnes: syððan flōd ofslōh, gifen gēotende, gīganta cyn, frēcne gefērdon: þæt wæs fremde þēod ēcean dryhtne, him þæs ende-lēan þurh wæteres wylm waldend sealde.
text_bare: Hroðgar maðelode, hylt sceawode, ealde lafe, on þæm wæs or writen fyrn-gewinnes: syððan flod ofsloh, gifen geotende, giganta cyn, frecne geferdon: þæt wæs fremde þeod ecean dryhtne, him þæs ende-lean þurh wæteres wylm waldend sealde.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Swā wæs on þǣm scennum scīran goldes þurh rūn-stafas rihte gemearcod, geseted and gesǣd, hwām þæt sweord geworht, īrena cyst ǣrest wǣre, wreoðen-hilt and wyrm-fāh.
text_bare: Swa wæs on þæm scennum sciran goldes þurh run-stafas rihte gemearcod, geseted and gesæd, hwam þæt sweord geworht, irena cyst ærest wære, wreoðen-hilt and wyrm-fah.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: þā se wīsa spræc sunu Healfdenes swīgedon ealle : "Þæt lā mæg secgan, sē þe sōð and riht "fremeð on folce, feor eal gemon "eald ēðel-weard , þæt þes eorl wǣre "geboren betera!
text_bare: þa se wisa spræc sunu Healfdenes swigedon ealle : "Þæt la mæg secgan, se þe soð and riht "fremeð on folce, feor eal gemon "eald eðel-weard , þæt þes eorl wære "geboren betera!

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Blǣd is ārǣred "geond wīd-wegas, wine mīn Bēowulf, "þīn ofer þēoda gehwylce.
text_bare: Blæd is aræred "geond wid-wegas, wine min Beowulf, "þin ofer þeoda gehwylce.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Eal þū hit geþyldum healdest, "mægen mid mōdes snyttrum.
text_bare: Eal þu hit geþyldum healdest, "mægen mid modes snyttrum.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Ic þē sceal mīne gelǣstan "frēode, swā wit furðum sprǣcon; þū scealt tō frōfre weorðan "eal lang-twidig lēodum þīnum, "hæleðum tō helpe.
text_bare: Ic þe sceal mine gelæstan "freode, swa wit furðum spræcon; þu scealt to frofre weorðan "eal lang-twidig leodum þinum, "hæleðum to helpe.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Ne wearð Heremōd swā "eaforum Ecgwelan, Ār-Scyldingum; "ne gewēox hē him tō willan, ac tō wæl-fealle "and tō dēað-cwalum Deniga lēodum; "brēat bolgen-mōd bēod-genēatas, "eaxl-gesteallan, oð þæt hē āna hwearf, "mǣre þēoden.
text_bare: Ne wearð Heremod swa "eaforum Ecgwelan, Ar-Scyldingum; "ne geweox he him to willan, ac to wæl-fealle "and to deað-cwalum Deniga leodum; "breat bolgen-mod beod-geneatas, "eaxl-gesteallan, oð þæt he ana hwearf, "mære þeoden.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: mon-drēamum from: "þēah þe hine mihtig god mægenes wynnum, "eafeðum stēpte, ofer ealle men "forð gefremede, hwæðere him on ferhðe grēow "brēost-hord blōd-rēow: nallas bēagas geaf "Denum æfter dōme; drēam-lēas gebād, "þæt hē þæs gewinnes weorc þrowade, "lēod-bealo longsum.
text_bare: mon-dreamum from: "þeah þe hine mihtig god mægenes wynnum, "eafeðum stepte, ofer ealle men "forð gefremede, hwæðere him on ferhðe greow "breost-hord blod-reow: nallas beagas geaf "Denum æfter dome; dream-leas gebad, "þæt he þæs gewinnes weorc þrowade, "leod-bealo longsum.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Þū þē lǣr be þon, "gum-cyste ongit!
text_bare: Þu þe lær be þon, "gum-cyste ongit!

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: ic þis gid be þē "āwræc wintrum frōd.
text_bare: ic þis gid be þe "awræc wintrum frod.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: Wundor is tō secganne, "hū mihtig god manna cynne "þurh sīdne sefan snyttru bryttað, "eard and eorl-scipe, hē āh ealra geweald.
text_bare: Wundor is to secganne, "hu mihtig god manna cynne "þurh sidne sefan snyttru bryttað, "eard and eorl-scipe, he ah ealra geweald.

section: XXV. HROTHGAR'S GRATITUDE: HE DISCOURSES.
text: "Hwīlum hē on lufan lǣteð hworfan "monnes mōd-geþonc mǣran cynnes, "seleð him on ēðle eorðan wynne, "tō healdanne hlēo-burh wera, "gedēð him swā gewealdene worolde dǣlas, "sīde rīce, þæt hē his selfa ne mæg "for his un-snyttrum ende geþencean; "wunað hē on wiste, nō hine wiht dweleð, "ādl nē yldo, nē him inwit-sorh "on sefan sweorceð, nē gesacu ōhwǣr, "ecg-hete ēoweð, ac him eal worold "wendeð on willan; hē þæt wyrse ne con, "oð þæt him on innan ofer-hygda dǣl "weaxeð and wridað, þonne se weard swefeð, "sāwele hyrde: bið se slǣp tō fæst, "bisgum gebunden, bona swīðe nēah, "sē þe of flān-bogan fyrenum scēoteð.
text_bare: "Hwilum he on lufan læteð hworfan "monnes mod-geþonc mæran cynnes, "seleð him on eðle eorðan wynne, "to healdanne hleo-burh wera, "gedeð him swa gewealdene worolde dælas, "side rice, þæt he his selfa ne mæg "for his un-snyttrum ende geþencean; "wunað he on wiste, no hine wiht dweleð, "adl ne yldo, ne him inwit-sorh "on sefan sweorceð, ne gesacu ohwær, "ecg-hete eoweð, ac him eal worold "wendeð on willan; he þæt wyrse ne con, "oð þæt him on innan ofer-hygda dæl "weaxeð and wridað, þonne se weard swefeð, "sawele hyrde: bið se slæp to fæst, "bisgum gebunden, bona swiðe neah, "se þe of flan-bogan fyrenum sceoteð.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: "Þonne bið on hreðre under helm drepen "biteran strǣle: him bebeorgan ne con "wom wundor-bebodum wergan gāstes; "þinceð him tō lȳtel, þæt hē tō lange hēold, "gȳtsað grom-hȳdig, nallas on gylp seleð "fǣtte bēagas and hē þā forð-gesceaft "forgyteð and forgȳmeð, þæs þe him ǣr god sealde "wuldres waldend, weorð-mynda dǣl.
text_bare: "Þonne bið on hreðre under helm drepen "biteran stræle: him bebeorgan ne con "wom wundor-bebodum wergan gastes; "þinceð him to lytel, þæt he to lange heold, "gytsað grom-hydig, nallas on gylp seleð "fætte beagas and he þa forð-gesceaft "forgyteð and forgymeð, þæs þe him ær god sealde "wuldres waldend, weorð-mynda dæl.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: "Hit on ende-stæf eft gelimpeð, "þæt se līc-homa lǣne gedrēoseð, "fǣge gefealleð; fēhð ōðer tō, "sē þe unmurnlīce mādmas dǣleð, "eorles ǣr-gestrēon, egesan ne gȳmeð.
text_bare: "Hit on ende-stæf eft gelimpeð, "þæt se lic-homa læne gedreoseð, "fæge gefealleð; fehð oðer to, "se þe unmurnlice madmas dæleð, "eorles ær-gestreon, egesan ne gymeð.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: "Bebeorh þē þone bealo-nīð, Bēowulf lēofa, "secg se betsta, and þē þæt sēlre gecēos, "ēce rǣdas; oferhȳda ne gȳm, "mǣre cempa!
text_bare: "Bebeorh þe þone bealo-nið, Beowulf leofa, "secg se betsta, and þe þæt selre geceos, "ece rædas; oferhyda ne gym, "mære cempa!

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: Nū is þīnes mægnes blǣd "āne hwīle; eft sōna bið, "þæt þec ādl oððe ecg eafoðes getwǣfeð, "oððe fȳres feng oððe flōdes wylm, "oððe gripe mēces oððe gāres fliht, "oððe atol yldo, oððe ēagena bearhtm "forsiteð and forsworceð; semninga bið, "þæt þec, dryht-guma, dēað oferswȳðeð.
text_bare: Nu is þines mægnes blæd "ane hwile; eft sona bið, "þæt þec adl oððe ecg eafoðes getwæfeð, "oððe fyres feng oððe flodes wylm, "oððe gripe meces oððe gares fliht, "oððe atol yldo, oððe eagena bearhtm "forsiteð and forsworceð; semninga bið, "þæt þec, dryht-guma, deað oferswyðeð.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: "Swā ic Hring-Dena hund missēra "wēold under wolcnum, and hig wigge belēac "manigum mǣgða geond þysne middan-geard, "æscum and ecgum, þæt ic mē ǣnigne "under swegles begong gesacan ne tealde.
text_bare: "Swa ic Hring-Dena hund missera "weold under wolcnum, and hig wigge beleac "manigum mægða geond þysne middan-geard, "æscum and ecgum, þæt ic me ænigne "under swegles begong gesacan ne tealde.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: "Hwæt!
text_bare: "Hwæt!

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: mē þæs on ēðle edwenden cwōm, "gyrn æfter gomene, seoððan Grendel wearð, "eald-gewinna, in-genga mīn: "ic þǣre sōcne singāles wæg "mōd-ceare micle.
text_bare: me þæs on eðle edwenden cwom, "gyrn æfter gomene, seoððan Grendel wearð, "eald-gewinna, in-genga min: "ic þære socne singales wæg "mod-ceare micle.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: Þæs sig metode þanc, "ēcean drihtne, þæs þe ic on aldre gebād, "þæt ic on þone hafelan heoro-drēorigne "ofer eald gewin ēagum starige!
text_bare: Þæs sig metode þanc, "ecean drihtne, þæs þe ic on aldre gebad, "þæt ic on þone hafelan heoro-dreorigne "ofer eald gewin eagum starige!

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: "Gā nū tō setle, symbel-wynne drēoh "wīgge weorðad: unc sceal worn fela "māðma gemǣnra, siððan morgen bið." Gēat wæs glæd-mōd, gēong sōna tō, setles nēosan, swā se snottra heht.
text_bare: "Ga nu to setle, symbel-wynne dreoh "wigge weorðad: unc sceal worn fela "maðma gemænra, siððan morgen bið." Geat wæs glæd-mod, geong sona to, setles neosan, swa se snottra heht.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: Þā wæs eft swā ǣr ellen-rōfum, flet-sittendum fægere gereorded nīowan stefne.
text_bare: Þa wæs eft swa ær ellen-rofum, flet-sittendum fægere gereorded niowan stefne.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: Niht-helm geswearc deorc ofer dryht-gumum.
text_bare: Niht-helm geswearc deorc ofer dryht-gumum.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: Duguð eal ārās; wolde blonden-feax beddes nēosan, gamela Scylding.
text_bare: Duguð eal aras; wolde blonden-feax beddes neosan, gamela Scylding.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: Gēat ungemetes wēl, rōfne rand-wigan restan lyste: sōna him sele-þegn sīðes wērgum, feorran-cundum forð wīsade, se for andrysnum ealle beweotede þegnes þearfe, swylce þȳ dōgore hēaðo-līðende habban scoldon.
text_bare: Geat ungemetes wel, rofne rand-wigan restan lyste: sona him sele-þegn siðes wergum, feorran-cundum forð wisade, se for andrysnum ealle beweotede þegnes þearfe, swylce þy dogore heaðo-liðende habban scoldon.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: Reste hine þā rūm-heort; reced hlīfade gēap and gold-fāh, gæst inne swæf, oð þæt hrefn blaca heofones wynne blīð-heort bodode.
text_bare: Reste hine þa rum-heort; reced hlifade geap and gold-fah, gæst inne swæf, oð þæt hrefn blaca heofones wynne blið-heort bodode.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: Þā cōm beorht sunne scacan ofer grundas; scaðan ōnetton, wǣron æðelingas eft tō lēodum fūse tō farenne, wolde feor þanon cuma collen-ferhð cēoles nēosan.
text_bare: Þa com beorht sunne scacan ofer grundas; scaðan onetton, wæron æðelingas eft to leodum fuse to farenne, wolde feor þanon cuma collen-ferhð ceoles neosan.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: Heht þā se hearda Hrunting beran, sunu Ecglāfes, heht his sweord niman, lēoflīc īren; sægde him þæs lēanes þanc, cwæð hē þone gūð-wine gōdne tealde, wīg-cræftigne, nales wordum lōg mēces ecge: þæt wæs mōdig secg.
text_bare: Heht þa se hearda Hrunting beran, sunu Ecglafes, heht his sweord niman, leoflic iren; sægde him þæs leanes þanc, cwæð he þone guð-wine godne tealde, wig-cræftigne, nales wordum log meces ecge: þæt wæs modig secg.

section: XXVI. THE DISCOURSE IS ENDED.—BEOWULF PREPARES TO LEAVE.
text: And þā sīð-frome searwum gearwe wīgend wǣron, ēode weorð Denum æðeling tō yppan, þǣr se ōðer wæs hæle hilde-dēor, Hrōðgār grētte.
text_bare: And þa sið-frome searwum gearwe wigend wæron, eode weorð Denum æðeling to yppan, þær se oðer wæs hæle hilde-deor, Hroðgar grette.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Bēowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: "Nū wē sǣ-līðend secgan wyllað "feorran cumene, þæt wē fundiað "Higelāc sēcan.
text_bare: Beowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: "Nu we sæ-liðend secgan wyllað "feorran cumene, þæt we fundiað "Higelac secan.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Wǣron hēr tela "willum bewenede; þū ūs wēl dohtest.
text_bare: Wæron her tela "willum bewenede; þu us wel dohtest.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: "Gif ic þonne on eorðan ōwihte mæg "þīnre mōd-lufan māran tilian, "gumena dryhten, þonne ic gȳt dyde, "gūð-geweorca ic bēo gearo sōna.
text_bare: "Gif ic þonne on eorðan owihte mæg "þinre mod-lufan maran tilian, "gumena dryhten, þonne ic gyt dyde, "guð-geweorca ic beo gearo sona.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: "Gif ic þæt gefricge ofer flōda begang, "þæt þec ymbe-sittend egesan þȳwað, "swā þec hetende hwīlum dydon, "ic þē þūsenda þegna bringe, "hæleða tō helpe.
text_bare: "Gif ic þæt gefricge ofer floda begang, "þæt þec ymbe-sittend egesan þywað, "swa þec hetende hwilum dydon, "ic þe þusenda þegna bringe, "hæleða to helpe.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Ic on Higelāce wāt, "Gēata dryhten, þēah þe hē geong sȳ, "folces hyrde, þæt hē mec fremman wile "wordum and worcum, þæt ic þē wēl herige, "and þē tō gēoce gār-holt bere "mægenes fultum, þǣr þē bið manna þearf; "gif him þonne Hrēðrīc tō hofum Gēata "geþingeð, þēodnes bearn, hē mæg þǣr fela "frēonda findan: feor-cȳððe bēoð "sēlran gesōhte þǣm þe him selfa dēah." Hrōðgār maðelode him on andsware: "Þē þā word-cwydas wittig drihten "on sefan sende!
text_bare: Ic on Higelace wat, "Geata dryhten, þeah þe he geong sy, "folces hyrde, þæt he mec fremman wile "wordum and worcum, þæt ic þe wel herige, "and þe to geoce gar-holt bere "mægenes fultum, þær þe bið manna þearf; "gif him þonne Hreðric to hofum Geata "geþingeð, þeodnes bearn, he mæg þær fela "freonda findan: feor-cyððe beoð "selran gesohte þæm þe him selfa deah." Hroðgar maðelode him on andsware: "Þe þa word-cwydas wittig drihten "on sefan sende!

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: ne hȳrde ic snotorlīcor "on swā geongum feore guman þingian: "þū eart mægenes strang and on mōde frōd, "wīs word-cwida.
text_bare: ne hyrde ic snotorlicor "on swa geongum feore guman þingian: "þu eart mægenes strang and on mode frod, "wis word-cwida.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Wēn ic talige, "gif þæt gegangeð, þæt þe gār nymeð, "hild heoru-grimme Hrēðles eaferan, "ādl oððe īren ealdor þīnne, "folces hyrde, and þū þīn feorh hafast, "þæt þe Sǣ-Gēatas sēlran næbben "tō gecēosenne cyning ǣnigne, "hord-weard hæleða, gif þū healdan wylt "māga rīce.
text_bare: Wen ic talige, "gif þæt gegangeð, þæt þe gar nymeð, "hild heoru-grimme Hreðles eaferan, "adl oððe iren ealdor þinne, "folces hyrde, and þu þin feorh hafast, "þæt þe Sæ-Geatas selran næbben "to geceosenne cyning ænigne, "hord-weard hæleða, gif þu healdan wylt "maga rice.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Mē þīn mōd-sefa "līcað leng swā wēl, lēofa Bēowulf: "hafast þū gefēred, þæt þām folcum sceal, "Gēata lēodum and Gār-Denum "sib gemǣnum and sacu restan, "inwit-nīðas, þē hīe ǣr drugon; "wesan, þenden ic wealde wīdan rīces, "māðmas gemǣne, manig ōðerne "gōdum gegrētan ofer ganotes bæð; "sceal hring-naca ofer hēaðu bringan "lāc and luf-tācen.
text_bare: Me þin mod-sefa "licað leng swa wel, leofa Beowulf: "hafast þu gefered, þæt þam folcum sceal, "Geata leodum and Gar-Denum "sib gemænum and sacu restan, "inwit-niðas, þe hie ær drugon; "wesan, þenden ic wealde widan rices, "maðmas gemæne, manig oðerne "godum gegretan ofer ganotes bæð; "sceal hring-naca ofer heaðu bringan "lac and luf-tacen.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Ic þā lēode wāt "gē wið fēond gē wið frēond fæste geworhte "ǣghwæs untǣle ealde wīsan." Þā gīt him eorla hlēo inne gesealde, mago Healfdenes māðmas twelfe, hēt hine mid þǣm lācum lēode swǣse sēcean on gesyntum, snūde eft cuman.
text_bare: Ic þa leode wat "ge wið feond ge wið freond fæste geworhte "æghwæs untæle ealde wisan." Þa git him eorla hleo inne gesealde, mago Healfdenes maðmas twelfe, het hine mid þæm lacum leode swæse secean on gesyntum, snude eft cuman.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Gecyste þā cyning æðelum gōd, þēoden Scildinga, þegen betstan and be healse genam; hruron him tēaras, blonden-feaxum: him wæs bēga wēn, ealdum infrōdum, ōðres swīðor, þæt hī seoððan gesēon mōston mōdige on meðle.
text_bare: Gecyste þa cyning æðelum god, þeoden Scildinga, þegen betstan and be healse genam; hruron him tearas, blonden-feaxum: him wæs bega wen, ealdum infrodum, oðres swiðor, þæt hi seoððan geseon moston modige on meðle.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Wæs him se man tō þon lēof, þæt hē þone brēost-wylm forberan ne mehte, ac him on hreðre hyge-bendum fæst æfter dēorum men dyrne langað beorn wið blōde.
text_bare: Wæs him se man to þon leof, þæt he þone breost-wylm forberan ne mehte, ac him on hreðre hyge-bendum fæst æfter deorum men dyrne langað beorn wið blode.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Him Bēowulf þanan, gūð-rinc gold-wlanc græs-moldan træd, since hrēmig: sǣ-genga bād āgend-frēan, sē þe on ancre rād.
text_bare: Him Beowulf þanan, guð-rinc gold-wlanc græs-moldan træd, since hremig: sæ-genga bad agend-frean, se þe on ancre rad.

section: XXVII. THE PARTING WORDS.
text: Þā wæs on gange gifu Hrōðgāres oft geæhted: þæt wæs ān cyning ǣghwæs orleahtre, oð þæt hine yldo benam mægenes wynnum, sē þe oft manegum scōd.
text_bare: Þa wæs on gange gifu Hroðgares oft geæhted: þæt wæs an cyning æghwæs orleahtre, oð þæt hine yldo benam mægenes wynnum, se þe oft manegum scod.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Cwōm þā tō flōde fela-mōdigra hæg-stealdra hēap; hring-net bǣron, locene leoðo-syrcan.
text_bare: Cwom þa to flode fela-modigra hæg-stealdra heap; hring-net bæron, locene leoðo-syrcan.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Land-weard onfand eft-sīð eorla, swā hē ǣr dyde; nō hē mid hearme of hlīðes nosan gæstas grētte, ac him tōgēanes rād; cwæð þæt wilcuman Wedera lēodum scawan scīr-hame tō scipe fōron.
text_bare: Land-weard onfand eft-sið eorla, swa he ær dyde; no he mid hearme of hliðes nosan gæstas grette, ac him togeanes rad; cwæð þæt wilcuman Wedera leodum scawan scir-hame to scipe foron.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Þā wæs on sande sǣ-gēap naca hladen here-wǣdum, hringed-stefna mēarum and māðmum: mæst hlīfade ofer Hrōðgāres hord-gestrēonum.
text_bare: Þa wæs on sande sæ-geap naca hladen here-wædum, hringed-stefna mearum and maðmum: mæst hlifade ofer Hroðgares hord-gestreonum.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Hē þǣm bāt-wearde bunden golde swurd gesealde, þæt hē syððan wæs on meodu-bence māðme þȳ weorðra, yrfe-lāfe.
text_bare: He þæm bat-wearde bunden golde swurd gesealde, þæt he syððan wæs on meodu-bence maðme þy weorðra, yrfe-lafe.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Gewāt him on ȳð-nacan, drēfan dēop wæter, Dena land ofgeaf.
text_bare: Gewat him on yð-nacan, drefan deop wæter, Dena land ofgeaf.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Þā wæs be mæste mere-hrægla sum, segl sāle fæst.
text_bare: Þa wæs be mæste mere-hrægla sum, segl sale fæst.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Sund-wudu þunede, nō þǣr wēg-flotan wind ofer ȳðum sīðes getwǣfde; sǣ-genga fōr, flēat fāmig-heals forð ofer ȳðe, bunden-stefna ofer brim-strēamas, þæt hīe Gēata clifu ongitan meahton, cūðe næssas.
text_bare: Sund-wudu þunede, no þær weg-flotan wind ofer yðum siðes getwæfde; sæ-genga for, fleat famig-heals forð ofer yðe, bunden-stefna ofer brim-streamas, þæt hie Geata clifu ongitan meahton, cuðe næssas.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Cēol up geþrang, lyft-geswenced on lande stōd.
text_bare: Ceol up geþrang, lyft-geswenced on lande stod.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Hraðe wæs æt holme hȳð-weard gearo, sē þe ǣr lange tīd, lēofra manna fūs, æt faroðe feor wlātode; sǣlde tō sande sīd-fæðme scip oncer-bendum fæst, þȳ lǣs hym ȳða þrym wudu wynsuman forwrecan meahte.
text_bare: Hraðe wæs æt holme hyð-weard gearo, se þe ær lange tid, leofra manna fus, æt faroðe feor wlatode; sælde to sande sid-fæðme scip oncer-bendum fæst, þy læs hym yða þrym wudu wynsuman forwrecan meahte.
