section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Hēt þā up beran æðelinga gestrēon, frætwe and fǣt-gold; næs him feor þanon tō gesēcanne sinces bryttan: Higelāc Hrēðling þǣr æt hām wunað, selfa mid gesīðum sǣ-wealle nēah; bold wæs betlīc, brego-rōf cyning, hēa on healle, Hygd swīðe geong, wīs, wēl-þungen, þēah þe wintra lȳt under burh-locan gebiden hæbbe Hæreðes dōhtor: næs hīo hnāh swā þēah, nē tō gnēað gifa Gēata lēodum, māðm-gestrēona.
text_bare: Het þa up beran æðelinga gestreon, frætwe and fæt-gold; næs him feor þanon to gesecanne sinces bryttan: Higelac Hreðling þær æt ham wunað, selfa mid gesiðum sæ-wealle neah; bold wæs betlic, brego-rof cyning, hea on healle, Hygd swiðe geong, wis, wel-þungen, þeah þe wintra lyt under burh-locan gebiden hæbbe Hæreðes dohtor: næs hio hnah swa þeah, ne to gneað gifa Geata leodum, maðm-gestreona.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Mod Þrȳðo wæg, fremu folces cwēn, firen ondrysne: nǣnig þæt dorste dēor genēðan swǣsra gesīða, nefne sin-frēa, þæt hire an dæges ēagum starede; ac him wæl-bende weotode tealde, hand-gewriðene: hraðe seoððan wæs æfter mund-gripe mēce geþinged, þæt hit sceaðen-mǣl scȳran mōste, cwealm-bealu cȳðan.
text_bare: Mod Þryðo wæg, fremu folces cwen, firen ondrysne: nænig þæt dorste deor geneðan swæsra gesiða, nefne sin-frea, þæt hire an dæges eagum starede; ac him wæl-bende weotode tealde, hand-gewriðene: hraðe seoððan wæs æfter mund-gripe mece geþinged, þæt hit sceaðen-mæl scyran moste, cwealm-bealu cyðan.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Ne bið swylc cwēnlīc þēaw idese tō efnanne, þēah þe hīo ǣnlīcu sȳ, þætte freoðu-webbe fēores onsæce æfter līge-torne lēofne mannan.
text_bare: Ne bið swylc cwenlic þeaw idese to efnanne, þeah þe hio ænlicu sy, þætte freoðu-webbe feores onsæce æfter lige-torne leofne mannan.

section: XXVIII. BEOWULF RETURNS TO GEATLAND.—THE QUEENS HYGD AND THRYTHO.
text: Hūru þæt onhōhsnode Heminges mǣg; ealo drincende ōðer sǣdan, þæt hīo lēod-bealewa lǣs gefremede, inwit-nīða, syððan ǣrest wearð gyfen gold-hroden geongum cempan, æðelum dīore, syððan hīo Offan flet ofer fealone flōd be fæder lāre sīðe gesōhte, þǣr hīo syððan wēl in gum-stōle, gōde mǣre, līf-gesceafta lifigende brēac, hīold hēah-lufan wið hæleða brego, ealles mon-cynnes mīne gefrǣge þone sēlestan bī sǣm twēonum eormen-cynnes; forþām Offa wæs geofum and gūðum gār-cēne man, wīde geweorðod; wīsdōme hēold ēðel sīnne, þonon Ēomǣr wōc hæleðum tō helpe, Heminges mǣg, nefa Gārmundes, nīða cræftig.
text_bare: Huru þæt onhohsnode Heminges mæg; ealo drincende oðer sædan, þæt hio leod-bealewa læs gefremede, inwit-niða, syððan ærest wearð gyfen gold-hroden geongum cempan, æðelum diore, syððan hio Offan flet ofer fealone flod be fæder lare siðe gesohte, þær hio syððan wel in gum-stole, gode mære, lif-gesceafta lifigende breac, hiold heah-lufan wið hæleða brego, ealles mon-cynnes mine gefræge þone selestan bi sæm tweonum eormen-cynnes; forþam Offa wæs geofum and guðum gar-cene man, wide geweorðod; wisdome heold eðel sinne, þonon Eomær woc hæleðum to helpe, Heminges mæg, nefa Garmundes, niða cræftig.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Gewāt him þā se hearda mid his hond-scole sylf æfter sande sǣ-wong tredan, wīde waroðas.
text_bare: Gewat him þa se hearda mid his hond-scole sylf æfter sande sæ-wong tredan, wide waroðas.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Woruld-candel scān, sigel sūðan fūs: hī sīð drugon, elne geēodon, tō þæs þe eorla hlēo, bonan Ongenþēowes burgum on innan, geongne gūð-cyning gōdne gefrūnon hringas dǣlan.
text_bare: Woruld-candel scan, sigel suðan fus: hi sið drugon, elne geeodon, to þæs þe eorla hleo, bonan Ongenþeowes burgum on innan, geongne guð-cyning godne gefrunon hringas dælan.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Higelāce wæs sīð Bēowulfes snūde gecȳðed, þæt þǣr on worðig wīgendra hlēo, lind-gestealla lifigende cwōm, heaðo-lāces hāl tō hofe gongan.
text_bare: Higelace wæs sið Beowulfes snude gecyðed, þæt þær on worðig wigendra hleo, lind-gestealla lifigende cwom, heaðo-laces hal to hofe gongan.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Hraðe wæs gerȳmed, swā se rīca bebēad, fēðe-gestum flet innan-weard.
text_bare: Hraðe wæs gerymed, swa se rica bebead, feðe-gestum flet innan-weard.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Gesæt þā wið sylfne, sē þā sæcce genæs, mǣg wið mǣge, syððan man-dryhten þurh hlēoðor-cwyde holdne gegrētte mēaglum wordum.
text_bare: Gesæt þa wið sylfne, se þa sæcce genæs, mæg wið mæge, syððan man-dryhten þurh hleoðor-cwyde holdne gegrette meaglum wordum.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Meodu-scencum hwearf geond þæt reced Hæreðes dōhtor: lufode þā lēode, līð-wǣge bær hǣlum tō handa.
text_bare: Meodu-scencum hwearf geond þæt reced Hæreðes dohtor: lufode þa leode, lið-wæge bær hælum to handa.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Higelāc ongan sīnne geseldan in sele þām hēan fægre fricgean, hyne fyrwet bræc, hwylce Sǣ-Gēata sīðas wǣron: "Hū lomp ēow on lāde, lēofa Bīowulf, "þā þū fǣringa feorr gehogodest, "sæcce sēcean ofer sealt wæter, "hilde tō Hiorote?
text_bare: Higelac ongan sinne geseldan in sele þam hean fægre fricgean, hyne fyrwet bræc, hwylce Sæ-Geata siðas wæron: "Hu lomp eow on lade, leofa Biowulf, "þa þu færinga feorr gehogodest, "sæcce secean ofer sealt wæter, "hilde to Hiorote?

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Ac þū Hrōðgāre "wīd-cūðne wēan wihte gebēttest, "mǣrum þēodne?
text_bare: Ac þu Hroðgare "wid-cuðne wean wihte gebettest, "mærum þeodne?

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Ic þæs mōd-ceare "sorh-wylmum sēað, sīðe ne truwode "lēofes mannes; ic þē lange bæd, "þæt þū þone wæl-gǣst wihte ne grētte, "lēte Sūð-Dene sylfe geweorðan "gūðe wið Grendel.
text_bare: Ic þæs mod-ceare "sorh-wylmum seað, siðe ne truwode "leofes mannes; ic þe lange bæd, "þæt þu þone wæl-gæst wihte ne grette, "lete Suð-Dene sylfe geweorðan "guðe wið Grendel.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Gode ic þanc secge, "þæs þe ic þē gesundne gesēon mōste." Bīowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþīowes: "Þæt is undyrne, dryhten Higelāc, "mǣre gemēting monegum fīra, "hwylc orleg-hwīl uncer Grendles "wearð on þām wange, þǣr hē worna fela "Sige-Scildingum sorge gefremede, "yrmðe tō aldre; ic þæt eal gewræc, "swā ne gylpan þearf Grendeles māga "ǣnig ofer eorðan ūht-hlem þone, "sē þe lengest leofað lāðan cynnes, "fenne bifongen.
text_bare: Gode ic þanc secge, "þæs þe ic þe gesundne geseon moste." Biowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgþiowes: "Þæt is undyrne, dryhten Higelac, "mære gemeting monegum fira, "hwylc orleg-hwil uncer Grendles "wearð on þam wange, þær he worna fela "Sige-Scildingum sorge gefremede, "yrmðe to aldre; ic þæt eal gewræc, "swa ne gylpan þearf Grendeles maga "ænig ofer eorðan uht-hlem þone, "se þe lengest leofað laðan cynnes, "fenne bifongen.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Ic þǣr furðum cwōm, "tō þām hring-sele Hrōðgār grētan: "sōna mē se mǣra mago Healfdenes, "syððan hē mōd-sefan mīnne cūðe, "wið his sylfes sunu setl getǣhte.
text_bare: Ic þær furðum cwom, "to þam hring-sele Hroðgar gretan: "sona me se mæra mago Healfdenes, "syððan he mod-sefan minne cuðe, "wið his sylfes sunu setl getæhte.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: "Weorod wæs on wynne; ne seah ic wīdan feorh "under heofenes hwealf heal-sittendra "medu-drēam māran.
text_bare: "Weorod wæs on wynne; ne seah ic widan feorh "under heofenes hwealf heal-sittendra "medu-dream maran.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Hwīlum mǣru cwēn, "friðu-sibb folca flet eall geond-hwearf, "bǣdde byre geonge; oft hīo bēah-wriðan "secge sealde, ǣr hīo tō setle gēong.
text_bare: Hwilum mæru cwen, "friðu-sibb folca flet eall geond-hwearf, "bædde byre geonge; oft hio beah-wriðan "secge sealde, ær hio to setle geong.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: "Hwīlum for duguðe dōhtor Hrōðgāres "eorlum on ende ealu-wǣge bær, "þā ic Frēaware flet-sittende "nemnan hȳrde, þǣr hīo nægled sinc "hæleðum sealde: sīo gehāten wæs, "geong gold-hroden, gladum suna Frōdan; "hafað þæs geworden wine Scyldinga "rīces hyrde and þæt rǣd talað, "þæt hē mid þȳ wīfe wæl-fǣhða dǣl, "sæcca gesette.
text_bare: "Hwilum for duguðe dohtor Hroðgares "eorlum on ende ealu-wæge bær, "þa ic Freaware flet-sittende "nemnan hyrde, þær hio nægled sinc "hæleðum sealde: sio gehaten wæs, "geong gold-hroden, gladum suna Frodan; "hafað þæs geworden wine Scyldinga "rices hyrde and þæt ræd talað, "þæt he mid þy wife wæl-fæhða dæl, "sæcca gesette.

section: XXIX. HIS ARRIVAL. HYGELAC'S RECEPTION.
text: Oft nō seldan hwǣr "æfter lēod-hryre lȳtle hwīle "bon-gār būgeð, þēah sēo brȳd duge!
text_bare: Oft no seldan hwær "æfter leod-hryre lytle hwile "bon-gar bugeð, þeah seo bryd duge!

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Mæg þæs þonne ofþyncan þēoden Heaðobeardna "and þegna gehwām þāra lēoda, "þonne hē mid fǣmnan on flett gǣð, "dryht-bearn Dena duguða biwenede: "on him gladiað gomelra lāfe "heard and hring-mǣl, Heaðobeardna gestrēon, "þenden hīe þām wǣpnum wealdan mōston, "oð þæt hīe forlǣddan tō þām lind-plegan "swǣse gesīðas ond hyra sylfra feorh.
text_bare: "Mæg þæs þonne ofþyncan þeoden Heaðobeardna "and þegna gehwam þara leoda, "þonne he mid fæmnan on flett gæð, "dryht-bearn Dena duguða biwenede: "on him gladiað gomelra lafe "heard and hring-mæl, Heaðobeardna gestreon, "þenden hie þam wæpnum wealdan moston, "oð þæt hie forlæddan to þam lind-plegan "swæse gesiðas ond hyra sylfra feorh.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Þonne cwið æt bēore, sē þe bēah gesyhð, "eald æsc-wiga, sē þe eall geman "gār-cwealm gumena him bið grim sefa , "onginneð geōmor-mōd geongne cempan "þurh hreðra gehygd higes cunnian, "wīg-bealu weccean and þæt word ācwyð: "'Meaht þū, mīn wine, mēce gecnāwan, "'þone þin fæder tō gefeohte bær "'under here-grīman hindeman sīðe, "'dȳre īren, þǣr hyne Dene slōgon, "'wēoldon wæl-stōwe, syððan wiðer-gyld læg, "'æfter hæleða hryre, hwate Scyldungas?
text_bare: "Þonne cwið æt beore, se þe beah gesyhð, "eald æsc-wiga, se þe eall geman "gar-cwealm gumena him bið grim sefa , "onginneð geomor-mod geongne cempan "þurh hreðra gehygd higes cunnian, "wig-bealu weccean and þæt word acwyð: "'Meaht þu, min wine, mece gecnawan, "'þone þin fæder to gefeohte bær "'under here-griman hindeman siðe, "'dyre iren, þær hyne Dene slogon, "'weoldon wæl-stowe, syððan wiðer-gyld læg, "'æfter hæleða hryre, hwate Scyldungas?

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "'Nu hēr þāra banena byre nāt-hwylces, "'frætwum hrēmig on flet gǣð, "'morðres gylpeð and þone māððum byreð, "'þone þe þū mid rihte rǣdan sceoldest!'" "Manað swā and myndgað mǣla gehwylce "sārum wordum, oð þæt sǣl cymeð, "þæt se fǣmnan þegn fore fæder dǣdum "æfter billes bite blōd-fāg swefeð, "ealdres scyldig; him se ōðer þonan "losað lifigende, con him land geare.
text_bare: "'Nu her þara banena byre nat-hwylces, "'frætwum hremig on flet gæð, "'morðres gylpeð and þone maððum byreð, "'þone þe þu mid rihte rædan sceoldest!'" "Manað swa and myndgað mæla gehwylce "sarum wordum, oð þæt sæl cymeð, "þæt se fæmnan þegn fore fæder dædum "æfter billes bite blod-fag swefeð, "ealdres scyldig; him se oðer þonan "losað lifigende, con him land geare.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Þonne bīoð brocene on bā healfe "āð-sweord eorla; syððan Ingelde "weallað wæl-nīðas and him wīf-lufan "æfter cear-wælmum cōlran weorðað.
text_bare: "Þonne bioð brocene on ba healfe "að-sweord eorla; syððan Ingelde "weallað wæl-niðas and him wif-lufan "æfter cear-wælmum colran weorðað.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Þȳ ic Heaðobeardna hyldo ne telge, "dryht-sibbe dǣl Denum unfǣcne, "frēond-scipe fæstne.
text_bare: "Þy ic Heaðobeardna hyldo ne telge, "dryht-sibbe dæl Denum unfæcne, "freond-scipe fæstne.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: Ic sceal forð sprecan "gēn ymbe Grendel, þæt þū geare cunne, "sinces brytta, tō hwan syððan wearð "hond-rǣs hæleða.
text_bare: Ic sceal forð sprecan "gen ymbe Grendel, þæt þu geare cunne, "sinces brytta, to hwan syððan wearð "hond-ræs hæleða.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: Syððan heofones gim "glād ofer grundas, gæst yrre cwōm, "eatol ǣfen-grom, ūser nēosan, "þǣr wē gesunde sæl weardodon; "þǣr wæs Hondscīo hild onsǣge, "feorh-bealu fǣgum, hē fyrmest læg, "gyrded cempa; him Grendel wearð, "mǣrum magu-þegne tō mūð-bonan, "lēofes mannes līc eall forswealg.
text_bare: Syððan heofones gim "glad ofer grundas, gæst yrre cwom, "eatol æfen-grom, user neosan, "þær we gesunde sæl weardodon; "þær wæs Hondscio hild onsæge, "feorh-bealu fægum, he fyrmest læg, "gyrded cempa; him Grendel wearð, "mærum magu-þegne to muð-bonan, "leofes mannes lic eall forswealg.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Nō þȳ ǣr ūt þā gēn īdel-hende "bona blōdig-tōð bealewa gemyndig, "of þām gold-sele gongan wolde, "ac hē mægnes rōf mīn costode, "grāpode gearo-folm.
text_bare: "No þy ær ut þa gen idel-hende "bona blodig-toð bealewa gemyndig, "of þam gold-sele gongan wolde, "ac he mægnes rof min costode, "grapode gearo-folm.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: Glōf hangode "sīd and syllīc searo-bendum fæst, "sīo wæs orþoncum eall gegyrwed "dēofles cræftum and dracan fellum: "hē mec þǣr on innan unsynnigne, "dīor dǣd-fruma, gedōn wolde, "manigra sumne: hyt ne mihte swā, "syððan ic on yrre upp-riht āstōd.
text_bare: Glof hangode "sid and syllic searo-bendum fæst, "sio wæs orþoncum eall gegyrwed "deofles cræftum and dracan fellum: "he mec þær on innan unsynnigne, "dior dæd-fruma, gedon wolde, "manigra sumne: hyt ne mihte swa, "syððan ic on yrre upp-riht astod.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Tō lang ys tō reccenne, hū ic þām lēod-sceaðan "yfla gehwylces ond-lēan forgeald; "þǣr ic, þēoden mīn, þīne lēode "weorðode weorcum.
text_bare: "To lang ys to reccenne, hu ic þam leod-sceaðan "yfla gehwylces ond-lean forgeald; "þær ic, þeoden min, þine leode "weorðode weorcum.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: Hē on weg losade, "lȳtle hwīle līf-wynna brēac; "hwæðre him sīo swīðre swaðe weardade "hand on Hiorte and hē hēan þonan, "mōdes geōmor mere-grund gefēoll.
text_bare: He on weg losade, "lytle hwile lif-wynna breac; "hwæðre him sio swiðre swaðe weardade "hand on Hiorte and he hean þonan, "modes geomor mere-grund gefeoll.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Mē þone wæl-rǣs wine Scildunga "fǣttan golde fela lēanode, "manegum māðmum, syððan mergen cōm "and wē tō symble geseten hæfdon.
text_bare: "Me þone wæl-ræs wine Scildunga "fættan golde fela leanode, "manegum maðmum, syððan mergen com "and we to symble geseten hæfdon.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Þǣr wæs gidd and glēo; gomela Scilding "fela fricgende feorran rehte; "hwīlum hilde-dēor hearpan wynne, "gomen-wudu grētte; hwīlum gyd āwræc "sōð and sārlīc; hwīlum syllīc spell "rehte æfter rihte rūm-heort cyning.
text_bare: "Þær wæs gidd and gleo; gomela Scilding "fela fricgende feorran rehte; "hwilum hilde-deor hearpan wynne, "gomen-wudu grette; hwilum gyd awræc "soð and sarlic; hwilum syllic spell "rehte æfter rihte rum-heort cyning.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Hwīlum eft ongan eldo gebunden, "gomel gūð-wiga gioguðe cwīðan "hilde-strengo; hreðer inne wēoll, "þonne hē wintrum frōd worn gemunde.
text_bare: "Hwilum eft ongan eldo gebunden, "gomel guð-wiga gioguðe cwiðan "hilde-strengo; hreðer inne weoll, "þonne he wintrum frod worn gemunde.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Swā wē þǣr inne andlangne dæg "nīode nāman, oð þæt niht becwōm "ōðer tō yldum.
text_bare: "Swa we þær inne andlangne dæg "niode naman, oð þæt niht becwom "oðer to yldum.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: Þā wæs eft hraðe "gearo gyrn-wræce Grendeles mōdor, "sīðode sorh-full; sunu dēað fornam, "wīg-hete Wedra.
text_bare: Þa wæs eft hraðe "gearo gyrn-wræce Grendeles modor, "siðode sorh-full; sunu deað fornam, "wig-hete Wedra.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: Wīf unhȳre "hyre bearn gewræc, beorn ācwealde "ellenlīce; þǣr wæs Æsc-here, "frōdan fyrn-witan, feorh ūðgenge; "nōðer hȳ hine ne mōston, syððan mergen cwōm, "dēað-wērigne Denia lēode "bronde forbærnan, nē on bǣl hladan "lēofne mannan: hīo þæt līc ætbær "fēondes fæðmum under firgen-strēam.
text_bare: Wif unhyre "hyre bearn gewræc, beorn acwealde "ellenlice; þær wæs Æsc-here, "frodan fyrn-witan, feorh uðgenge; "noðer hy hine ne moston, syððan mergen cwom, "deað-werigne Denia leode "bronde forbærnan, ne on bæl hladan "leofne mannan: hio þæt lic ætbær "feondes fæðmum under firgen-stream.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Þæt wæs Hrōðgāre hrēowa tornost "þāra þe lēod-fruman lange begeāte; "þā se þēoden mec þīne līfe "healsode hrēoh-mōd, þæt ic on holma geþring "eorl-scipe efnde, ealdre genēðde, "mǣrðo fremede: hē mē mēde gehēt.
text_bare: "Þæt wæs Hroðgare hreowa tornost "þara þe leod-fruman lange begeate; "þa se þeoden mec þine life "healsode hreoh-mod, þæt ic on holma geþring "eorl-scipe efnde, ealdre geneðde, "mærðo fremede: he me mede gehet.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Ic þā þæs wælmes, þē is wīde cūð, "grimne gryrelīcne grund-hyrde fond.
text_bare: "Ic þa þæs wælmes, þe is wide cuð, "grimne gryrelicne grund-hyrde fond.

section: XXX. BEOWULF'S STORY OF THE SLAYINGS.
text: "Þǣr unc hwīle wæs hand gemǣne; "holm heolfre wēoll and ic hēafde becearf "in þām grund-sele Grendeles mōdor "ēacnum ecgum, unsōfte þonan "feorh oðferede; næs ic fǣge þā gȳt, "ac mē eorla hlēo eft gesealde "māðma menigeo, maga Healfdenes.
text_bare: "Þær unc hwile wæs hand gemæne; "holm heolfre weoll and ic heafde becearf "in þam grund-sele Grendeles modor "eacnum ecgum, unsofte þonan "feorh oðferede; næs ic fæge þa gyt, "ac me eorla hleo eft gesealde "maðma menigeo, maga Healfdenes.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: "Swā se þēod-kyning þēawum lyfde; "nealles ic þām lēanum forloren hæfde, "mægnes mēde, ac hē mē māðmas geaf, "sunu Healfdenes, on sīnne sylfes dōm; "þā ic þē, beorn-cyning, bringan wylle, "ēstum geȳwan.
text_bare: "Swa se þeod-kyning þeawum lyfde; "nealles ic þam leanum forloren hæfde, "mægnes mede, ac he me maðmas geaf, "sunu Healfdenes, on sinne sylfes dom; "þa ic þe, beorn-cyning, bringan wylle, "estum geywan.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Gēn is eall æt þē "lissa gelong: ic lȳt hafo "hēafod-māga, nefne Hygelāc þec!" Hēt þā in beran eafor, hēafod-segn, heaðo-stēapne helm, hāre byrnan, gūð-sweord geatolīc, gyd æfter wræc: "Mē þis hilde-sceorp Hrōðgār sealde, "snotra fengel, sume worde hēt, "þæt ic his ǣrest þē eft gesægde, "cwæð þæt hyt hæfde Hiorogār cyning, "lēod Scyldunga lange hwīle: "nō þȳ ǣr suna sīnum syllan wolde, "hwatum Heorowearde, þēah hē him hold wǣre, "brēost-gewǣdu.
text_bare: Gen is eall æt þe "lissa gelong: ic lyt hafo "heafod-maga, nefne Hygelac þec!" Het þa in beran eafor, heafod-segn, heaðo-steapne helm, hare byrnan, guð-sweord geatolic, gyd æfter wræc: "Me þis hilde-sceorp Hroðgar sealde, "snotra fengel, sume worde het, "þæt ic his ærest þe eft gesægde, "cwæð þæt hyt hæfde Hiorogar cyning, "leod Scyldunga lange hwile: "no þy ær suna sinum syllan wolde, "hwatum Heorowearde, þeah he him hold wære, "breost-gewædu.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Brūc ealles well!" Hȳrde ic þæt þām frætwum fēower mēaras lungre gelīce lāst weardode, æppel-fealuwe; hē him ēst getēah mēara and māðma.
text_bare: Bruc ealles well!" Hyrde ic þæt þam frætwum feower mearas lungre gelice last weardode, æppel-fealuwe; he him est geteah meara and maðma.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Swā sceal mǣg dōn, nealles inwit-net ōðrum bregdan, dyrnum cræfte dēað rēnian hond-gesteallan.
text_bare: Swa sceal mæg don, nealles inwit-net oðrum bregdan, dyrnum cræfte deað renian hond-gesteallan.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Hygelāce wæs, nīða heardum, nefa swȳðe hold and gehwæðer ōðrum hrōðra gemyndig.
text_bare: Hygelace wæs, niða heardum, nefa swyðe hold and gehwæðer oðrum hroðra gemyndig.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Hȳrde ic þæt hē þone heals-bēah Hygde gesealde, wrǣtlīcne wundur-māððum, þone þe him Wealhþēo geaf, þēodnes dōhtor, þrīo wicg somod swancor and sadol-beorht; hyre syððan wæs æfter bēah-þege brēost geweorðod.
text_bare: Hyrde ic þæt he þone heals-beah Hygde gesealde, wrætlicne wundur-maððum, þone þe him Wealhþeo geaf, þeodnes dohtor, þrio wicg somod swancor and sadol-beorht; hyre syððan wæs æfter beah-þege breost geweorðod.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Swā bealdode bearn Ecgþēowes, guma gūðum cūð, gōdum dǣdum, drēah æfter dōme, nealles druncne slōg heorð-genēatas; næs him hrēoh sefa, ac hē man-cynnes mǣste cræfte gin-fæstan gife, þē him god sealde, hēold hilde-dēor.
text_bare: Swa bealdode bearn Ecgþeowes, guma guðum cuð, godum dædum, dreah æfter dome, nealles druncne slog heorð-geneatas; næs him hreoh sefa, ac he man-cynnes mæste cræfte gin-fæstan gife, þe him god sealde, heold hilde-deor.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Hēan wæs lange, swā hyne Gēata bearn gōdne ne tealdon, nē hyne on medo-bence micles wyrðne drihten wereda gedōn wolde; swȳðe oft sægdon, þæt hē slēac wǣre, æðeling unfrom: edwenden cwōm tīr-ēadigum menn torna gehwylces.
text_bare: Hean wæs lange, swa hyne Geata bearn godne ne tealdon, ne hyne on medo-bence micles wyrðne drihten wereda gedon wolde; swyðe oft sægdon, þæt he sleac wære, æðeling unfrom: edwenden cwom tir-eadigum menn torna gehwylces.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Hēt þā eorla hlēo in gefetian, heaðo-rōf cyning, Hrēðles lāfe, golde gegyrede; næs mid Gēatum þā sinc-māððum sēlra on sweordes hād; þæt hē on Bīowulfes bearm ālegde, and him gesealde seofan þūsendo, bold and brego-stōl.
text_bare: Het þa eorla hleo in gefetian, heaðo-rof cyning, Hreðles lafe, golde gegyrede; næs mid Geatum þa sinc-maððum selra on sweordes had; þæt he on Biowulfes bearm alegde, and him gesealde seofan þusendo, bold and brego-stol.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Him wæs bām samod on þām lēod-scipe lond gecynde, eard ēðel-riht, ōðrum swīðor sīde rīce, þām þǣr sēlra wæs.
text_bare: Him wæs bam samod on þam leod-scipe lond gecynde, eard eðel-riht, oðrum swiðor side rice, þam þær selra wæs.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Eft þæt geīode ufaran dōgrum hilde-hlæmmum, syððan Hygelāc læg and Heardrēde hilde-mēceas under bord-hrēoðan tō bonan wurdon, þā hyne gesōhtan on sige-þēode hearde hilde-frecan, Heaðo-Scilfingas, nīða genǣgdan nefan Hererīces.
text_bare: Eft þæt geiode ufaran dogrum hilde-hlæmmum, syððan Hygelac læg and Heardrede hilde-meceas under bord-hreoðan to bonan wurdon, þa hyne gesohtan on sige-þeode hearde hilde-frecan, Heaðo-Scilfingas, niða genægdan nefan Hererices.

section: XXXI. HE GIVES PRESENTS TO HYGELAC. HYGELAC REWARDS HIM. HYGELAC'S DEATH. BEOWULF REIGNS.
text: Syððan Bēowulfe brāde rīce on hand gehwearf: hē gehēold tela fīftig wintru wæs þā frōd cyning, eald ēðel-weard , oð þæt ān ongan deorcum nihtum draca rīcsian, sē þe on hēare hǣðe hord beweotode, stān-beorh stēapne: stīg under læg, eldum uncūð.
text_bare: Syððan Beowulfe brade rice on hand gehwearf: he geheold tela fiftig wintru wæs þa frod cyning, eald eðel-weard , oð þæt an ongan deorcum nihtum draca ricsian, se þe on heare hæðe hord beweotode, stan-beorh steapne: stig under læg, eldum uncuð.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Ealle hīe dēað fornam ǣrran mǣlum, and se ān þā gēn lēoda duguðe, sē þǣr lengest hwearf, weard wine-geōmor wīscte þæs yldan, þæt hē lȳtel fæc long-gestrēona brūcan mōste.
text_bare: Ealle hie deað fornam ærran mælum, and se an þa gen leoda duguðe, se þær lengest hwearf, weard wine-geomor wiscte þæs yldan, þæt he lytel fæc long-gestreona brucan moste.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Beorh eal gearo wunode on wonge wæter-ȳðum nēah, nīwe be næsse nearo-cræftum fæst: þǣr on innan bær eorl-gestrēona hringa hyrde hard-fyrdne dǣl fǣttan goldes, fēa worda cwæð: "Heald þū nū, hrūse, nū hæleð ne mōston, "eorla ǣhte.
text_bare: Beorh eal gearo wunode on wonge wæter-yðum neah, niwe be næsse nearo-cræftum fæst: þær on innan bær eorl-gestreona hringa hyrde hard-fyrdne dæl fættan goldes, fea worda cwæð: "Heald þu nu, hruse, nu hæleð ne moston, "eorla æhte.
