section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Nāh hwā sweord wege "oððe fetige fǣted wǣge, "drync-fæt dēore: duguð ellor scōc.
text_bare: Nah hwa sweord wege "oððe fetige fæted wæge, "drync-fæt deore: duguð ellor scoc.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: "Sceal se hearda helm hyrsted golde "fǣtum befeallen: feormiend swefað, "þā þe beado-grīman bȳwan sceoldon, "gē swylce sēo here-pād, sīo æt hilde gebād "ofer borda gebræc bite īrena, "brosnað æfter beorne.
text_bare: "Sceal se hearda helm hyrsted golde "fætum befeallen: feormiend swefað, "þa þe beado-griman bywan sceoldon, "ge swylce seo here-pad, sio æt hilde gebad "ofer borda gebræc bite irena, "brosnað æfter beorne.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Ne mæg byrnan hring "æfter wīg-fruman wīde fēran "hæleðum be healfe; næs hearpan wyn, "gomen glēo-bēames, nē gōd hafoc "geond sæl swingeð, nē se swifta mearh "burh-stede bēateð.
text_bare: Ne mæg byrnan hring "æfter wig-fruman wide feran "hæleðum be healfe; næs hearpan wyn, "gomen gleo-beames, ne god hafoc "geond sæl swingeð, ne se swifta mearh "burh-stede beateð.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Bealo-cwealm hafað "fela feorh-cynna feorr onsended!" Swā giōmor-mōd giohðo mǣnde, ān æfter eallum unblīðe hwēop, dæges and nihtes, oð þæt dēaðes wylm hrān æt heortan.
text_bare: Bealo-cwealm hafað "fela feorh-cynna feorr onsended!" Swa giomor-mod giohðo mænde, an æfter eallum unbliðe hweop, dæges and nihtes, oð þæt deaðes wylm hran æt heortan.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Hord-wynne fond eald ūht-sceaða opene standan, sē þe byrnende biorgas sēceð nacod nīð-draca, nihtes flēogeð fȳre befangen; hyne fold-būend wīde gesāwon.
text_bare: Hord-wynne fond eald uht-sceaða opene standan, se þe byrnende biorgas seceð nacod nið-draca, nihtes fleogeð fyre befangen; hyne fold-buend wide gesawon.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Hē gēwunian sceall hlāw under hrūsan, þǣr hē hǣðen gold warað wintrum frōd; ne byð him wihte þē sēl.
text_bare: He gewunian sceall hlaw under hrusan, þær he hæðen gold warað wintrum frod; ne byð him wihte þe sel.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Swā se þēod-sceaða þrēo hund wintra hēold on hrūsan hord-ærna sum ēacen-cræftig, oð þæt hyne ān ābealh mon on mōde: man-dryhtne bær fǣted wǣge, frioðo-wǣre bæd hlāford sīnne.
text_bare: Swa se þeod-sceaða þreo hund wintra heold on hrusan hord-ærna sum eacen-cræftig, oð þæt hyne an abealh mon on mode: man-dryhtne bær fæted wæge, frioðo-wære bæd hlaford sinne.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Þā wæs hord rāsod, onboren bēaga hord, bēne getīðad fēa-sceaftum men.
text_bare: Þa wæs hord rasod, onboren beaga hord, bene getiðad fea-sceaftum men.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Frēa scēawode fīra fyrn-geweorc forman sīðe.
text_bare: Frea sceawode fira fyrn-geweorc forman siðe.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Þā se wyrm onwōc, wrōht wæs genīwad; stonc þā æfter stāne, stearc-heort onfand fēondes fōt-lāst; hē tō forð gestōp, dyrnan cræfte, dracan hēafde nēah.
text_bare: Þa se wyrm onwoc, wroht wæs geniwad; stonc þa æfter stane, stearc-heort onfand feondes fot-last; he to forð gestop, dyrnan cræfte, dracan heafde neah.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Swā mæg unfǣge ēaðe gedīgan wēan and wræc-sīð, sē þe waldendes hyldo gehealdeð.
text_bare: Swa mæg unfæge eaðe gedigan wean and wræc-sið, se þe waldendes hyldo gehealdeð.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Hord-weard sōhte georne æfter grunde, wolde guman findan, þone þe him on sweofote sāre getēode: hāt and hrēoh-mōd hlǣw oft ymbe hwearf, ealne ūtan-weardne; nē þǣr ǣnig mon wæs on þǣre wēstenne.
text_bare: Hord-weard sohte georne æfter grunde, wolde guman findan, þone þe him on sweofote sare geteode: hat and hreoh-mod hlæw oft ymbe hwearf, ealne utan-weardne; ne þær ænig mon wæs on þære westenne.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Hwæðre hilde gefeh, beado-weorces: hwīlum on beorh æthwearf, sinc-fæt sōhte; hē þæt sōna onfand, þæt hæfde gumena sum goldes gefandod hēah-gestrēona.
text_bare: Hwæðre hilde gefeh, beado-weorces: hwilum on beorh æthwearf, sinc-fæt sohte; he þæt sona onfand, þæt hæfde gumena sum goldes gefandod heah-gestreona.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Hord-weard onbād earfoðlīce, oð þæt ǣfen cwōm; wæs þā gebolgen beorges hyrde, wolde se lāða līge forgyldan drinc-fæt dȳre.
text_bare: Hord-weard onbad earfoðlice, oð þæt æfen cwom; wæs þa gebolgen beorges hyrde, wolde se laða lige forgyldan drinc-fæt dyre.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Þā wæs dæg sceacen wyrme on willan, nō on wealle leng bīdan wolde, ac mid bǣle fōr, fȳre gefȳsed.
text_bare: Þa wæs dæg sceacen wyrme on willan, no on wealle leng bidan wolde, ac mid bæle for, fyre gefysed.

section: XXXII. THE FIRE-DRAKE. THE HOARD.
text: Wæs se fruma egeslīc lēodum on lande, swā hyt lungre wearð on hyra sinc-gifan sāre geendod.
text_bare: Wæs se fruma egeslic leodum on lande, swa hyt lungre wearð on hyra sinc-gifan sare geendod.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Þā se gæst ongan glēdum spīwan, beorht hofu bærnan; bryne-lēoma stōd eldum on andan; nō þǣr āht cwices lāð lyft-floga lǣfan wolde.
text_bare: Þa se gæst ongan gledum spiwan, beorht hofu bærnan; bryne-leoma stod eldum on andan; no þær aht cwices lað lyft-floga læfan wolde.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Wæs þæs wyrmes wīg wīde gesȳne, nearo-fāges nīð nēan and feorran, hū se gūð-sceaða Gēata lēode hatode and hȳnde: hord eft gescēat, dryht-sele dyrnne ǣr dæges hwīle.
text_bare: Wæs þæs wyrmes wig wide gesyne, nearo-fages nið nean and feorran, hu se guð-sceaða Geata leode hatode and hynde: hord eft gesceat, dryht-sele dyrnne ær dæges hwile.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Hæfde land-wara līge befangen, bǣle and bronde; beorges getruwode, wīges and wealles: him sēo wēn gelēah.
text_bare: Hæfde land-wara lige befangen, bæle and bronde; beorges getruwode, wiges and wealles: him seo wen geleah.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Þā wæs Bīowulfe brōga gecȳðed snūde tō sōðe, þæt his sylfes him bolda sēlest bryne-wylmum mealt, gif-stōl Gēata.
text_bare: Þa wæs Biowulfe broga gecyðed snude to soðe, þæt his sylfes him bolda selest bryne-wylmum mealt, gif-stol Geata.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Þæt þām gōdan wæs hrēow on hreðre, hyge-sorga mǣst: wēnde se wīsa, þæt hē wealdende, ofer ealde riht, ēcean dryhtne bitre gebulge: brēost innan wēoll þēostrum geþoncum, swā him geþȳwe ne wæs.
text_bare: Þæt þam godan wæs hreow on hreðre, hyge-sorga mæst: wende se wisa, þæt he wealdende, ofer ealde riht, ecean dryhtne bitre gebulge: breost innan weoll þeostrum geþoncum, swa him geþywe ne wæs.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Hæfde līg-draca lēoda fæsten, ēa-lond ūtan, eorð-weard þone glēdum forgrunden.
text_bare: Hæfde lig-draca leoda fæsten, ea-lond utan, eorð-weard þone gledum forgrunden.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Him þæs gūð-cyning, Wedera þīoden, wræce leornode.
text_bare: Him þæs guð-cyning, Wedera þioden, wræce leornode.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Heht him þā gewyrcean wīgendra hlēo eall-īrenne, eorla dryhten wīg-bord wrǣtlīc; wisse hē gearwe, þæt him holt-wudu helpan ne meahte, lind wið līge.
text_bare: Heht him þa gewyrcean wigendra hleo eall-irenne, eorla dryhten wig-bord wrætlic; wisse he gearwe, þæt him holt-wudu helpan ne meahte, lind wið lige.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Sceolde lǣn-daga æðeling ǣr-gōd ende gebīdan worulde līfes and se wyrm somod; þēah þe hord-welan hēolde lange.
text_bare: Sceolde læn-daga æðeling ær-god ende gebidan worulde lifes and se wyrm somod; þeah þe hord-welan heolde lange.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Oferhogode þā hringa fengel, þæt hē þone wīd-flogan weorode gesōhte, sīdan herge; nō hē him þā sæcce ondrēd, nē him þæs wyrmes wīg for wiht dyde, eafoð and ellen; forþon hē ǣr fela nearo nēðende nīða gedīgde, hilde-hlemma, syððan hē Hrōðgāres, sigor-ēadig secg, sele fǣlsode and æt gūðe forgrāp Grendeles mǣgum, lāðan cynnes.
text_bare: Oferhogode þa hringa fengel, þæt he þone wid-flogan weorode gesohte, sidan herge; no he him þa sæcce ondred, ne him þæs wyrmes wig for wiht dyde, eafoð and ellen; forþon he ær fela nearo neðende niða gedigde, hilde-hlemma, syððan he Hroðgares, sigor-eadig secg, sele fælsode and æt guðe forgrap Grendeles mægum, laðan cynnes.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Nō þæt lǣsest wæs hond-gemota, þǣr mon Hygelāc slōh, syððan Gēata cyning gūðe rǣsum, frēa-wine folces Frēslondum on, Hrēðles eafora hioro-dryncum swealt, bille gebēaten; þonan Bīowulf cōm sylfes cræfte, sund-nytte drēah; hæfde him on earme ...
text_bare: No þæt læsest wæs hond-gemota, þær mon Hygelac sloh, syððan Geata cyning guðe ræsum, frea-wine folces Freslondum on, Hreðles eafora hioro-dryncum swealt, bille gebeaten; þonan Biowulf com sylfes cræfte, sund-nytte dreah; hæfde him on earme ...

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: hilde-geatwa, þā hē tō holme stāg.
text_bare: hilde-geatwa, þa he to holme stag.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Nealles Hetware hrēmge þorfton fēðe-wīges, þē him foran ongēan linde bǣron: lȳt eft becwōm fram þām hild-frecan hāmes nīosan.
text_bare: Nealles Hetware hremge þorfton feðe-wiges, þe him foran ongean linde bæron: lyt eft becwom fram þam hild-frecan hames niosan.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Oferswam þā sioleða bigong sunu Ecgþēowes, earm ān-haga eft tō lēodum, þǣr him Hygd gebēad hord and rīce, bēagas and brego-stōl: bearne ne truwode, þæt hē wið æl-fylcum ēðel-stōlas healdan cūðe, þā wæs Hygelāc dēad.
text_bare: Oferswam þa sioleða bigong sunu Ecgþeowes, earm an-haga eft to leodum, þær him Hygd gebead hord and rice, beagas and brego-stol: bearne ne truwode, þæt he wið æl-fylcum eðel-stolas healdan cuðe, þa wæs Hygelac dead.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Nō þȳ ǣr fēa-sceafte findan meahton æt þām æðelinge ǣnige þinga, þæt hē Heardrēde hlāford wǣre, oððe þone cyne-dōm cīosan wolde; hwæðre hē him on folce frēond-lārum hēold, ēstum mid āre, oð þæt hē yldra wearð, Weder-Gēatum wēold.
text_bare: No þy ær fea-sceafte findan meahton æt þam æðelinge ænige þinga, þæt he Heardrede hlaford wære, oððe þone cyne-dom ciosan wolde; hwæðre he him on folce freond-larum heold, estum mid are, oð þæt he yldra wearð, Weder-Geatum weold.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Hyne wræc-mæcgas ofer sǣ sōhtan, suna Ōhteres: hæfdon hȳ forhealden helm Scylfinga, þone sēlestan sǣ-cyninga, þāra þe in Swīo-rīce sinc brytnade, mǣrne þēoden.
text_bare: Hyne wræc-mæcgas ofer sæ sohtan, suna Ohteres: hæfdon hy forhealden helm Scylfinga, þone selestan sæ-cyninga, þara þe in Swio-rice sinc brytnade, mærne þeoden.

section: XXXIII. BEOWULF RESOLVES TO KILL THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Him þæt tō mearce wearð; hē þǣr orfeorme feorh-wunde hlēat sweordes swengum, sunu Hygelāces; and him eft gewāt Ongenþīowes bearn hāmes nīosan, syððan Heardrēd læg; lēt þone brego-stōl Bīowulf healdan, Gēatum wealdan: þæt wæs gōd cyning.
text_bare: Him þæt to mearce wearð; he þær orfeorme feorh-wunde hleat sweordes swengum, sunu Hygelaces; and him eft gewat Ongenþiowes bearn hames niosan, syððan Heardred læg; let þone brego-stol Biowulf healdan, Geatum wealdan: þæt wæs god cyning.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: Sē þæs lēod-hryres lēan gemunde uferan dōgrum, Ēadgilse wearð fēa-sceaftum fēond.
text_bare: Se þæs leod-hryres lean gemunde uferan dogrum, Eadgilse wearð fea-sceaftum feond.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: Folce gestepte ofer sǣ sīde sunu Ōhteres wigum and wǣpnum: hē gewræc syððan cealdum cear-sīðum, cyning ealdre binēat.
text_bare: Folce gestepte ofer sæ side sunu Ohteres wigum and wæpnum: he gewræc syððan cealdum cear-siðum, cyning ealdre bineat.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: Swā hē nīða gehwane genesen hæfde, slīðra geslyhta, sunu Ecgþīowes, ellen-weorca, oð þone ānne dæg, þē hē wið þām wyrme gewegan sceolde.
text_bare: Swa he niða gehwane genesen hæfde, sliðra geslyhta, sunu Ecgþiowes, ellen-weorca, oð þone anne dæg, þe he wið þam wyrme gewegan sceolde.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: Gewāt þā twelfa sum torne gebolgen dryhten Gēata dracan scēawian; hæfde þā gefrūnen, hwanan sīo fǣhð ārās, bealo-nīð biorna; him tō bearme cwōm māððum-fæt mǣre þurh þæs meldan hond, Sē wæs on þām þrēate þreotteoða secg, sē þæs orleges ōr onstealde, hæft hyge-giōmor, sceolde hēan þonon wong wīsian: hē ofer willan gīong tō þæs þe hē eorð-sele ānne wisse, hlǣw under hrūsan holm-wylme nēh, ȳð-gewinne, sē wæs innan full wrǣtta and wīra: weard unhīore, gearo gūð-freca, gold-māðmas hēold, eald under eorðan; næs þæt ȳðe cēap, tō gegangenne gumena ǣnigum.
text_bare: Gewat þa twelfa sum torne gebolgen dryhten Geata dracan sceawian; hæfde þa gefrunen, hwanan sio fæhð aras, bealo-nið biorna; him to bearme cwom maððum-fæt mære þurh þæs meldan hond, Se wæs on þam þreate þreotteoða secg, se þæs orleges or onstealde, hæft hyge-giomor, sceolde hean þonon wong wisian: he ofer willan giong to þæs þe he eorð-sele anne wisse, hlæw under hrusan holm-wylme neh, yð-gewinne, se wæs innan full wrætta and wira: weard unhiore, gearo guð-freca, gold-maðmas heold, eald under eorðan; næs þæt yðe ceap, to gegangenne gumena ænigum.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: Gesæt þā on næsse nīð-heard cyning, þenden hǣlo ābēad heorð-genēatum gold-wine Gēata: him wæs geōmor sefa, wǣfre and wæl-fūs, Wyrd ungemete nēah, sē þone gomelan grētan sceolde, sēcean sāwle hord, sundur gedǣlan līf wið līce: nō þon lange wæs feorh æðelinges flǣsce bewunden.
text_bare: Gesæt þa on næsse nið-heard cyning, þenden hælo abead heorð-geneatum gold-wine Geata: him wæs geomor sefa, wæfre and wæl-fus, Wyrd ungemete neah, se þone gomelan gretan sceolde, secean sawle hord, sundur gedælan lif wið lice: no þon lange wæs feorh æðelinges flæsce bewunden.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: Bīowulf maðelade, bearn Ecgþēowes: "Fela ic on giogoðe guð-rǣsa genæs, "orleg-hwīla: ic þæt eall gemon.
text_bare: Biowulf maðelade, bearn Ecgþeowes: "Fela ic on giogoðe guð-ræsa genæs, "orleg-hwila: ic þæt eall gemon.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: "Ic wæs syfan-wintre, þā mec sinca baldor, "frēa-wine folca æt mīnum fæder genam, "hēold mec and hæfde Hrēðel cyning, "geaf mē sinc and symbel, sibbe gemunde; "næs ic him tō līfe lāðra ōwihte "beorn in burgum, þonne his bearna hwylc, "Herebeald and Hæðcyn, oððe Hygelāc mīn.
text_bare: "Ic wæs syfan-wintre, þa mec sinca baldor, "frea-wine folca æt minum fæder genam, "heold mec and hæfde Hreðel cyning, "geaf me sinc and symbel, sibbe gemunde; "næs ic him to life laðra owihte "beorn in burgum, þonne his bearna hwylc, "Herebeald and Hæðcyn, oððe Hygelac min.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: "Wæs þām yldestan ungedēfelīce "mǣges dǣdum morðor-bed strēd, "syððan hyne Hæðcyn of horn-bogan, "his frēa-wine flāne geswencte, "miste mercelses and his mǣg ofscēt, "brōðor ōðerne, blōdigan gāre: "þæt wæs feoh-lēas gefeoht, fyrenum gesyngad "hreðre hyge-mēðe; sceolde hwæðre swā þēah "æðeling unwrecen ealdres linnan.
text_bare: "Wæs þam yldestan ungedefelice "mæges dædum morðor-bed stred, "syððan hyne Hæðcyn of horn-bogan, "his frea-wine flane geswencte, "miste mercelses and his mæg ofscet, "broðor oðerne, blodigan gare: "þæt wæs feoh-leas gefeoht, fyrenum gesyngad "hreðre hyge-meðe; sceolde hwæðre swa þeah "æðeling unwrecen ealdres linnan.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: "Swā bið geōmorlīc gomelum ceorle "tō gebīdanne, þæt his byre rīde "giong on galgan, þonne hē gyd wrece, "sārigne sang, þonne his sunu hangað "hrefne tō hrōðre and hē him helpe ne mæg, "eald and in-frōd, ǣnige gefremman.
text_bare: "Swa bið geomorlic gomelum ceorle "to gebidanne, þæt his byre ride "giong on galgan, þonne he gyd wrece, "sarigne sang, þonne his sunu hangað "hrefne to hroðre and he him helpe ne mæg, "eald and in-frod, ænige gefremman.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: "Symble bið gemyndgad morna gehwylce "eaforan ellor-sīð; ōðres ne gȳmeð "tō gebīdanne burgum on innan "yrfe-weardes, þonne se ān hafað "þurh dēaðes nȳd dǣda gefondad.
text_bare: "Symble bið gemyndgad morna gehwylce "eaforan ellor-sið; oðres ne gymeð "to gebidanne burgum on innan "yrfe-weardes, þonne se an hafað "þurh deaðes nyd dæda gefondad.

section: XXXIV. RETROSPECT OF BEOWULF.—STRIFE BETWEEN SWEONAS AND GEATAS.
text: "Gesyhð sorh-cearig on his suna būre "wīn-sele wēstne, wind-gereste, "rēote berofene; rīdend swefað "hæleð in hoðman; nis þǣr hearpan swēg, "gomen in geardum, swylce þǣr iū wǣron.
text_bare: "Gesyhð sorh-cearig on his suna bure "win-sele westne, wind-gereste, "reote berofene; ridend swefað "hæleð in hoðman; nis þær hearpan sweg, "gomen in geardum, swylce þær iu wæron.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: "Gewīteð þonne on sealman, sorh-lēoð gæleð "ān æfter ānum: þūhte him eall tō rūm, "wongas and wīc-stede.
text_bare: "Gewiteð þonne on sealman, sorh-leoð gæleð "an æfter anum: þuhte him eall to rum, "wongas and wic-stede.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Swā Wedra helm "æfter Herebealde heortan sorge "weallende wæg, wihte ne meahte "on þām feorh-bonan fǣhðe gebētan: "nō þȳ ǣr hē þone heaðo-rinc hatian ne meahte "lāðum dǣdum, þēah him lēof ne wæs.
text_bare: Swa Wedra helm "æfter Herebealde heortan sorge "weallende wæg, wihte ne meahte "on þam feorh-bonan fæhðe gebetan: "no þy ær he þone heaðo-rinc hatian ne meahte "laðum dædum, þeah him leof ne wæs.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: "Hē þā mid þǣre sorge, þē him sīo sār belamp, "gum-drēam ofgeaf, godes lēoht gecēas; "eaferum lǣfde, swā dēð ēadig mon, "lond and lēod-byrig, þā hē of līfe gewāt.
text_bare: "He þa mid þære sorge, þe him sio sar belamp, "gum-dream ofgeaf, godes leoht geceas; "eaferum læfde, swa deð eadig mon, "lond and leod-byrig, þa he of life gewat.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: "Þā wæs synn and sacu Swēona and Gēata, "ofer wīd wæter wrōht gemǣne, "here-nīð hearda, syððan Hrēðel swealt, "oððe him Ongenþēowes eaferan wǣran "frome fyrd-hwate, frēode ne woldon "ofer heafo healdan, ac ymb Hrēosna-beorh "eatolne inwit-scear oft gefremedon.
text_bare: "Þa wæs synn and sacu Sweona and Geata, "ofer wid wæter wroht gemæne, "here-nið hearda, syððan Hreðel swealt, "oððe him Ongenþeowes eaferan wæran "frome fyrd-hwate, freode ne woldon "ofer heafo healdan, ac ymb Hreosna-beorh "eatolne inwit-scear oft gefremedon.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: "Þæt mǣg-wine mīne gewrǣcan, "fǣhðe and fyrene, swā hyt gefrǣge wæs, "þēah þe ōðer hit ealdre gebohte, "heardan cēape: Hæðcynne wearð, "Gēata dryhtne, gūð onsǣge.
text_bare: "Þæt mæg-wine mine gewræcan, "fæhðe and fyrene, swa hyt gefræge wæs, "þeah þe oðer hit ealdre gebohte, "heardan ceape: Hæðcynne wearð, "Geata dryhtne, guð onsæge.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: "Þā ic on morgne gefrægn mǣg ōðerne "billes ecgum on bonan stǣlan, "þǣr Ongenþēow Eofores nīosade: "gūð-helm tōglād, gomela Scylfing "hrēas heoro-blāc; hond gemunde "fǣhðo genōge, feorh-sweng ne oftēah.
text_bare: "Þa ic on morgne gefrægn mæg oðerne "billes ecgum on bonan stælan, "þær Ongenþeow Eofores niosade: "guð-helm toglad, gomela Scylfing "hreas heoro-blac; hond gemunde "fæhðo genoge, feorh-sweng ne ofteah.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: "Ic him þā māðmas, þē hē mē sealde, "geald æt gūðe, swā mē gifeðe wæs, "lēohtan sweorde: hē mē lond forgeaf, "eard ēðel-wyn.
text_bare: "Ic him þa maðmas, þe he me sealde, "geald æt guðe, swa me gifeðe wæs, "leohtan sweorde: he me lond forgeaf, "eard eðel-wyn.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Næs him ǣnig þearf, "þæt hē tō Gifðum oððe tō Gār-Denum "oððe in Swīo-rīce sēcean þurfe "wyrsan wīg-frecan, weorðe gecȳpan; "symle ic him on fēðan beforan wolde, "āna on orde, and swā tō aldre sceall "sæcce fremman, þenden þis sweord þolað, "þæt mec ǣr and sīð oft gelǣste, "syððan ic for dugeðum Dæghrefne wearð "tō hand-bonan, Hūga cempan: "nalles hē þā frætwe Frēs-cyninge, "brēost-weorðunge bringan mōste, "ac in campe gecrong cumbles hyrde, "æðeling on elne.
text_bare: Næs him ænig þearf, "þæt he to Gifðum oððe to Gar-Denum "oððe in Swio-rice secean þurfe "wyrsan wig-frecan, weorðe gecypan; "symle ic him on feðan beforan wolde, "ana on orde, and swa to aldre sceall "sæcce fremman, þenden þis sweord þolað, "þæt mec ær and sið oft gelæste, "syððan ic for dugeðum Dæghrefne wearð "to hand-bonan, Huga cempan: "nalles he þa frætwe Fres-cyninge, "breost-weorðunge bringan moste, "ac in campe gecrong cumbles hyrde, "æðeling on elne.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Ne wæs ecg bona, "ac him hilde-grāp heortan wylmas, "bān-hūs gebræc.
text_bare: Ne wæs ecg bona, "ac him hilde-grap heortan wylmas, "ban-hus gebræc.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Nū sceall billes ecg, "hond and heard sweord ymb hord wīgan." Bēowulf maðelode, bēot-wordum spræc nīehstan sīðe: "Ic genēðde fela "gūða on geogoðe; gȳt ic wylle, "frōd folces weard, fǣhðe sēcan, "mǣrðum fremman, gif mec se mān-sceaða "of eorð-sele ūt gesēceð!" Gegrētte þā gumena gehwylcne, hwate helm-berend hindeman sīðe, swǣse gesīðas: "Nolde ic sweord beran, "wǣpen tō wyrme, gif ic wiste hū "wið þām āglǣcean elles meahte "gylpe wiðgrīpan, swā ic giō wið Grendle dyde; "ac ic þǣr heaðu-fȳres hātes wēne, "rēðes and-hāttres: forþon ic mē on hafu "bord and byrnan.
text_bare: Nu sceall billes ecg, "hond and heard sweord ymb hord wigan." Beowulf maðelode, beot-wordum spræc niehstan siðe: "Ic geneðde fela "guða on geogoðe; gyt ic wylle, "frod folces weard, fæhðe secan, "mærðum fremman, gif mec se man-sceaða "of eorð-sele ut geseceð!" Gegrette þa gumena gehwylcne, hwate helm-berend hindeman siðe, swæse gesiðas: "Nolde ic sweord beran, "wæpen to wyrme, gif ic wiste hu "wið þam aglæcean elles meahte "gylpe wiðgripan, swa ic gio wið Grendle dyde; "ac ic þær heaðu-fyres hates wene, "reðes and-hattres: forþon ic me on hafu "bord and byrnan.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Nelle ic beorges weard "oferflēon fōtes trem, fēond unhȳre, "ac unc sceal weorðan æt wealle, swā unc Wyrd getēoð, "metod manna gehwæs.
text_bare: Nelle ic beorges weard "oferfleon fotes trem, feond unhyre, "ac unc sceal weorðan æt wealle, swa unc Wyrd geteoð, "metod manna gehwæs.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Ic eom on mōde from, "þæt ic wið þone gūð-flogan gylp ofersitte.
text_bare: Ic eom on mode from, "þæt ic wið þone guð-flogan gylp ofersitte.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: "Gebīde gē on beorge byrnum werede, "secgas on searwum, hwæðer sēl mǣge "æfter wæl-rǣse wunde gedȳgan "uncer twēga.
text_bare: "Gebide ge on beorge byrnum werede, "secgas on searwum, hwæðer sel mæge "æfter wæl-ræse wunde gedygan "uncer twega.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Nis þæt ēower sīð, "nē gemet mannes, nefne mīn ānes, "þæt hē wið āglǣcean eofoðo dǣle, "eorl-scype efne.
text_bare: Nis þæt eower sið, "ne gemet mannes, nefne min anes, "þæt he wið aglæcean eofoðo dæle, "eorl-scype efne.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Ic mid elne sceall "gold gegangan oððe gūð nimeð, "feorh-bealu frēcne, frēan ēowerne!" Ārās þā bī ronde rōf ōretta, heard under helm, hioro-sercean bær under stān-cleofu, strengo getruwode ānes mannes: ne bið swylc earges sīð.
text_bare: Ic mid elne sceall "gold gegangan oððe guð nimeð, "feorh-bealu frecne, frean eowerne!" Aras þa bi ronde rof oretta, heard under helm, hioro-sercean bær under stan-cleofu, strengo getruwode anes mannes: ne bið swylc earges sið.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Geseah þā be wealle, sē þe worna fela, gum-cystum gōd, gūða gedīgde, hilde-hlemma, þonne hnitan fēðan, stōd on stān-bogan strēam ūt þonan brecan of beorge; wæs þǣre burnan wælm heaðo-fȳrum hāt: ne meahte horde nēah unbyrnende ǣnige hwīle dēop gedȳgan for dracan lēge.
text_bare: Geseah þa be wealle, se þe worna fela, gum-cystum god, guða gedigde, hilde-hlemma, þonne hnitan feðan, stod on stan-bogan stream ut þonan brecan of beorge; wæs þære burnan wælm heaðo-fyrum hat: ne meahte horde neah unbyrnende ænige hwile deop gedygan for dracan lege.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Lēt þā of brēostum, þā hē gebolgen wæs, Weder-Gēata lēod word ūt faran, stearc-heort styrmde; stefn in becōm heaðo-torht hlynnan under hārne stān.
text_bare: Let þa of breostum, þa he gebolgen wæs, Weder-Geata leod word ut faran, stearc-heort styrmde; stefn in becom heaðo-torht hlynnan under harne stan.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Hete wæs onhrēred, hord-weard oncnīow mannes reorde; næs þǣr māra fyrst, frēode tō friclan.
text_bare: Hete wæs onhrered, hord-weard oncniow mannes reorde; næs þær mara fyrst, freode to friclan.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: From ǣrest cwōm oruð āglǣcean ūt of stāne, hāt hilde-swāt; hrūse dynede.
text_bare: From ærest cwom oruð aglæcean ut of stane, hat hilde-swat; hruse dynede.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Biorn under beorge bord-rand onswāf wið þām gryre-gieste, Gēata dryhten: þā wæs hring-bogan heorte gefȳsed sæcce tō sēceanne.
text_bare: Biorn under beorge bord-rand onswaf wið þam gryre-gieste, Geata dryhten: þa wæs hring-bogan heorte gefysed sæcce to seceanne.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Sweord ǣr gebrǣ gōd gūð-cyning gomele lāfe, ecgum unglēaw, ǣghwæðrum wæs bealo-hycgendra brōga fram ōðrum.
text_bare: Sweord ær gebræ god guð-cyning gomele lafe, ecgum ungleaw, æghwæðrum wæs bealo-hycgendra broga fram oðrum.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Stīð-mōd gestōd wið stēapne rond winia bealdor, þā se wyrm gebēah snūde tōsomne: hē on searwum bād.
text_bare: Stið-mod gestod wið steapne rond winia bealdor, þa se wyrm gebeah snude tosomne: he on searwum bad.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Gewāt þā byrnende gebogen scrīðan tō, gescīfe scyndan.
text_bare: Gewat þa byrnende gebogen scriðan to, gescife scyndan.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Scyld wēl gebearg līfe and līce lǣssan hwīle mǣrum þēodne, þonne his myne sōhte, þǣr hē þȳ fyrste forman dōgore wealdan mōste, swā him Wyrd ne gescrāf hrēð æt hilde.
text_bare: Scyld wel gebearg life and lice læssan hwile mærum þeodne, þonne his myne sohte, þær he þy fyrste forman dogore wealdan moste, swa him Wyrd ne gescraf hreð æt hilde.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Hond up ābræd Gēata dryhten, gryre-fāhne slōh incge lāfe, þæt sīo ecg gewāc brūn on bāne, bāt unswīðor, þonne his þīod-cyning þearfe hæfde, bysigum gebǣded.
text_bare: Hond up abræd Geata dryhten, gryre-fahne sloh incge lafe, þæt sio ecg gewac brun on bane, bat unswiðor, þonne his þiod-cyning þearfe hæfde, bysigum gebæded.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Þā wæs beorges weard æfter heaðu-swenge on hrēoum mōde, wearp wæl-fȳre, wīde sprungon hilde-lēoman: hrēð-sigora ne gealp gold-wine Gēata, gūð-bill geswāc nacod æt nīðe, swā hyt nō sceolde, īren ǣr-gōd.
text_bare: Þa wæs beorges weard æfter heaðu-swenge on hreoum mode, wearp wæl-fyre, wide sprungon hilde-leoman: hreð-sigora ne gealp gold-wine Geata, guð-bill geswac nacod æt niðe, swa hyt no sceolde, iren ær-god.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Ne wæs þæt ēðe sīð, þæt se mǣra maga Ecgþēowes grund-wong þone ofgyfan wolde; sceolde wyrmes willan wīc eardian elles hwergen, swā sceal ǣghwylc mon ālǣtan lǣn-dagas.
text_bare: Ne wæs þæt eðe sið, þæt se mæra maga Ecgþeowes grund-wong þone ofgyfan wolde; sceolde wyrmes willan wic eardian elles hwergen, swa sceal æghwylc mon alætan læn-dagas.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Næs þā long tō þon, þæt þā āglǣcean hȳ eft gemētton.
text_bare: Næs þa long to þon, þæt þa aglæcean hy eft gemetton.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Hyrte hyne hord-weard, hreðer ǣðme wēoll, nīwan stefne: nearo þrowode fȳre befongen sē þe ǣr folce wēold.
text_bare: Hyrte hyne hord-weard, hreðer æðme weoll, niwan stefne: nearo þrowode fyre befongen se þe ær folce weold.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Nealles him on hēape hand-gesteallan, æðelinga bearn ymbe gestōdon hilde-cystum, ac hȳ on holt bugon, ealdre burgan.
text_bare: Nealles him on heape hand-gesteallan, æðelinga bearn ymbe gestodon hilde-cystum, ac hy on holt bugon, ealdre burgan.

section: XXXV. MEMORIES OF PAST TIME.—THE FEUD WITH THE FIRE-DRAKE.
text: Hiora in ānum wēoll sefa wið sorgum: sibb ǣfre ne mæg wiht onwendan, þām þe wēl þenceð.
text_bare: Hiora in anum weoll sefa wið sorgum: sibb æfre ne mæg wiht onwendan, þam þe wel þenceð.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Wīglāf wæs hāten Wēoxstānes sunu, lēoflīc lind-wiga, lēod Scylfinga, mǣg Ælfheres: geseah his mon-dryhten under here-grīman hāt þrowian.
text_bare: Wiglaf wæs haten Weoxstanes sunu, leoflic lind-wiga, leod Scylfinga, mæg Ælfheres: geseah his mon-dryhten under here-griman hat þrowian.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Gemunde þā þā āre, þē hē him ǣr forgeaf wīc-stede weligne Wǣgmundinga, folc-rihta gehwylc, swā his fæder āhte; ne mihte þā forhabban, hond rond gefēng, geolwe linde, gomel swyrd getēah, þæt wæs mid eldum Ēanmundes lāf, suna Ōhteres, þām æt sæcce wearð wracu wine-lēasum Wēohstānes bana mēces ecgum, and his māgum ætbær brūn-fāgne helm, hringde byrnan, eald sweord eotonisc, þæt him Onela forgeaf, his gædelinges gūð-gewǣdu, fyrd-searo fūslīc: nō ymbe þā fǣhðe spræc, þēah þe hē his brōðor bearn ābredwade.
text_bare: Gemunde þa þa are, þe he him ær forgeaf wic-stede weligne Wægmundinga, folc-rihta gehwylc, swa his fæder ahte; ne mihte þa forhabban, hond rond gefeng, geolwe linde, gomel swyrd geteah, þæt wæs mid eldum Eanmundes laf, suna Ohteres, þam æt sæcce wearð wracu wine-leasum Weohstanes bana meces ecgum, and his magum ætbær brun-fagne helm, hringde byrnan, eald sweord eotonisc, þæt him Onela forgeaf, his gædelinges guð-gewædu, fyrd-searo fuslic: no ymbe þa fæhðe spræc, þeah þe he his broðor bearn abredwade.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Hē frætwe gehēold fela missēra, bill and byrnan, oð þæt his byre mihte eorl-scipe efnan, swā his ǣr-fæder; geaf him þā mid Gēatum gūð-gewǣda ǣghwæs unrīm; þā hē of ealdre gewāt, frōd on forð-weg.
text_bare: He frætwe geheold fela missera, bill and byrnan, oð þæt his byre mihte eorl-scipe efnan, swa his ær-fæder; geaf him þa mid Geatum guð-gewæda æghwæs unrim; þa he of ealdre gewat, frod on forð-weg.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Þā wæs forma sīð geongan cempan, þæt hē gūðe rǣs mid his frēo-dryhtne fremman sceolde; ne gemealt him se mōd-sefa, nē his mǣges lāf gewāc æt wīge: þæt se wyrm onfand, syððan hīe tōgædre gegān hæfdon.
text_bare: Þa wæs forma sið geongan cempan, þæt he guðe ræs mid his freo-dryhtne fremman sceolde; ne gemealt him se mod-sefa, ne his mæges laf gewac æt wige: þæt se wyrm onfand, syððan hie togædre gegan hæfdon.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Wīglāf maðelode word-rihta fela, sægde gesīðum, him wæs sefa geōmor: "Ic þæt mǣl geman, þǣr wē medu þēgun, "þonne wē gehēton ūssum hlāforde "in bīor-sele, þē ūs þās bēagas geaf, "þæt wē him þā gūð-geatwa gyldan woldon, "gif him þyslīcu þearf gelumpe, "helmas and heard sweord: þē hē ūsic on herge gecēas "tō þyssum sīð-fate sylfes willum, "onmunde ūsic mǣrða and mē þās māðmas geaf, "þē hē ūsic gār-wīgend gōde tealde, "hwate helm-berend, þēah þe hlāford ūs "þis ellen-weorc āna āþōhte "tō gefremmanne, folces hyrde, "forþām hē manna mǣst mǣrða gefremede, "dǣda dollīcra.
text_bare: Wiglaf maðelode word-rihta fela, sægde gesiðum, him wæs sefa geomor: "Ic þæt mæl geman, þær we medu þegun, "þonne we geheton ussum hlaforde "in bior-sele, þe us þas beagas geaf, "þæt we him þa guð-geatwa gyldan woldon, "gif him þyslicu þearf gelumpe, "helmas and heard sweord: þe he usic on herge geceas "to þyssum sið-fate sylfes willum, "onmunde usic mærða and me þas maðmas geaf, "þe he usic gar-wigend gode tealde, "hwate helm-berend, þeah þe hlaford us "þis ellen-weorc ana aþohte "to gefremmanne, folces hyrde, "forþam he manna mæst mærða gefremede, "dæda dollicra.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Nū is sē dæg cumen, "þæt ūre man-dryhten mægenes behōfað "gōdra gūð-rinca: wutun gangan tō, "helpan hild-fruman, þenden hyt sȳ, "glēd-egesa grim!
text_bare: Nu is se dæg cumen, "þæt ure man-dryhten mægenes behofað "godra guð-rinca: wutun gangan to, "helpan hild-fruman, þenden hyt sy, "gled-egesa grim!

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: God wāt on mec, "þæt mē is micle lēofre, þæt mīnne līc-haman "mid mīnne gold-gyfan glēd fæðmie.
text_bare: God wat on mec, "þæt me is micle leofre, þæt minne lic-haman "mid minne gold-gyfan gled fæðmie.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: "Ne þynceð mē gerysne, þæt wē rondas beren "eft tō earde, nemne wē ǣror mǣgen "fāne gefyllan, feorh ealgian "Wedra þīodnes.
text_bare: "Ne þynceð me gerysne, þæt we rondas beren "eft to earde, nemne we æror mægen "fane gefyllan, feorh ealgian "Wedra þiodnes.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Ic wāt geare, "þæt nǣron eald-gewyrht, þæt hē āna scyle "Gēata duguðe gnorn þrowian, "gesīgan æt sæcce: sceal ūrum þæt sweord and helm, "byrne and byrdu-scrūd bām gemǣne." Wōd þā þurh þone wæl-rēc, wīg-heafolan bær frēan on fultum, fēa worda cwæð: "Lēofa Bīowulf, lǣst eall tela, "swā þū on geoguð-fēore geāra gecwǣde, "þæt þū ne ālǣte be þē lifigendum "dōm gedrēosan: scealt nū dǣdum rōf, "æðeling ān-hȳdig, ealle mægene "feorh ealgian; ic þē fullǣstu!" Æfter þām wordum wyrm yrre cwōm, atol inwit-gæst ōðre sīðe, fȳr-wylmum fāh fīonda nīosan, lāðra manna; līg-ȳðum forborn bord wið ronde: byrne ne meahte geongum gār-wigan gēoce gefremman: ac se maga geonga under his mǣges scyld elne geēode, þā his āgen wæs glēdum forgrunden.
text_bare: Ic wat geare, "þæt næron eald-gewyrht, þæt he ana scyle "Geata duguðe gnorn þrowian, "gesigan æt sæcce: sceal urum þæt sweord and helm, "byrne and byrdu-scrud bam gemæne." Wod þa þurh þone wæl-rec, wig-heafolan bær frean on fultum, fea worda cwæð: "Leofa Biowulf, læst eall tela, "swa þu on geoguð-feore geara gecwæde, "þæt þu ne alæte be þe lifigendum "dom gedreosan: scealt nu dædum rof, "æðeling an-hydig, ealle mægene "feorh ealgian; ic þe fullæstu!" Æfter þam wordum wyrm yrre cwom, atol inwit-gæst oðre siðe, fyr-wylmum fah fionda niosan, laðra manna; lig-yðum forborn bord wið ronde: byrne ne meahte geongum gar-wigan geoce gefremman: ac se maga geonga under his mæges scyld elne geeode, þa his agen wæs gledum forgrunden.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Þā gēn gūð-cyning mǣrða gemunde, mægen-strengo, slōh hilde-bille, þæt hyt on heafolan stōd nīðe genȳded: Nægling forbærst, geswāc æt sæcce sweord Bīowulfes gomol and grǣg-mǣl.
text_bare: Þa gen guð-cyning mærða gemunde, mægen-strengo, sloh hilde-bille, þæt hyt on heafolan stod niðe genyded: Nægling forbærst, geswac æt sæcce sweord Biowulfes gomol and græg-mæl.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Him þæt gifeðe ne wæs, þæt him īrenna ecge mihton helpan æt hilde; wæs sīo hond tō strong, sē þe mēca gehwane mīne gefrǣge swenge ofersōhte, þonne hē tō sæcce bær wǣpen wundrum heard, næs him wihte þē sēl.
text_bare: Him þæt gifeðe ne wæs, þæt him irenna ecge mihton helpan æt hilde; wæs sio hond to strong, se þe meca gehwane mine gefræge swenge ofersohte, þonne he to sæcce bær wæpen wundrum heard, næs him wihte þe sel.

section: XXXVI. WIGLAF HELPS BEOWULF IN THE FEUD
text: Þā wæs þēod-sceaða þriddan sīðe, frēcne fȳr-draca fǣhða gemyndig, rǣsde on þone rōfan, þā him rūm āgeald, hāt and heaðo-grim, heals ealne ymbefēng biteran bānum; hē geblōdegod wearð sāwul-drīore; swāt ȳðum wēoll.
text_bare: Þa wæs þeod-sceaða þriddan siðe, frecne fyr-draca fæhða gemyndig, ræsde on þone rofan, þa him rum ageald, hat and heaðo-grim, heals ealne ymbefeng biteran banum; he geblodegod wearð sawul-driore; swat yðum weoll.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Þā ic æt þearfe gefrægn þēod-cyninges and-longne eorl ellen cȳðan, cræft and cēnðu, swā him gecynde wæs; ne hēdde hē þæs heafolan, ac sīo hand gebarn mōdiges mannes, þǣr hē his mǣges healp, þæt hē þone nīð-gæst nioðor hwēne slōh, secg on searwum, þæt þæt sweord gedēaf fāh and fǣted, þæt þæt fȳr ongon sweðrian syððan.
text_bare: Þa ic æt þearfe gefrægn þeod-cyninges and-longne eorl ellen cyðan, cræft and cenðu, swa him gecynde wæs; ne hedde he þæs heafolan, ac sio hand gebarn modiges mannes, þær he his mæges healp, þæt he þone nið-gæst nioðor hwene sloh, secg on searwum, þæt þæt sweord gedeaf fah and fæted, þæt þæt fyr ongon sweðrian syððan.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Þā gēn sylf cyning gewēold his gewitte, wæll-seaxe gebrǣ, biter and beadu-scearp, þæt hē on byrnan wæg: forwrāt Wedra helm wyrm on middan.
text_bare: Þa gen sylf cyning geweold his gewitte, wæll-seaxe gebræ, biter and beadu-scearp, þæt he on byrnan wæg: forwrat Wedra helm wyrm on middan.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Fēond gefyldan ferh ellen wræc , and hī hyne þā bēgen ābroten hæfdon, sib-æðelingas: swylc sceolde secg wesan, þegn æt þearfe.
text_bare: Feond gefyldan ferh ellen wræc , and hi hyne þa begen abroten hæfdon, sib-æðelingas: swylc sceolde secg wesan, þegn æt þearfe.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Þæt þām þēodne wæs sīðast sīge-hwīle sylfes dǣdum, worlde geweorces.
text_bare: Þæt þam þeodne wæs siðast sige-hwile sylfes dædum, worlde geweorces.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Þā sīo wund ongon, þē him se eorð-draca ǣr geworhte, swelan and swellan.
text_bare: Þa sio wund ongon, þe him se eorð-draca ær geworhte, swelan and swellan.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Hē þæt sōna onfand, þæt him on brēostum bealo-nīð wēoll, attor on innan.
text_bare: He þæt sona onfand, þæt him on breostum bealo-nið weoll, attor on innan.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Þā se æðeling gīong, þæt hē bī wealle, wīs-hycgende, gesæt on sesse; seah on enta geweorc, hū þā stān-bogan stapulum fæste ēce eorð-reced innan hēoldon.
text_bare: Þa se æðeling giong, þæt he bi wealle, wis-hycgende, gesæt on sesse; seah on enta geweorc, hu þa stan-bogan stapulum fæste ece eorð-reced innan heoldon.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Hyne þā mid handa heoro-drēorigne þēoden mǣrne þegn ungemete till, wine-dryhten his wætere gelafede, hilde-sædne and his helm onspēon.
text_bare: Hyne þa mid handa heoro-dreorigne þeoden mærne þegn ungemete till, wine-dryhten his wætere gelafede, hilde-sædne and his helm onspeon.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Bīowulf maðelode, hē ofer benne spræc, wunde wæl-blēate wisse hē gearwe, þæt hē dæg-hwīla gedrogen hæfde eorðan wynne; þā wæs eall sceacen dōgor-gerīmes, dēað ungemete nēah : "Nū ic suna mīnum syllan wolde "gūð-gewǣdu, þǣr mē gifeðe swā "ǣnig yrfe-weard æfter wurde, "līce gelenge.
text_bare: Biowulf maðelode, he ofer benne spræc, wunde wæl-bleate wisse he gearwe, þæt he dæg-hwila gedrogen hæfde eorðan wynne; þa wæs eall sceacen dogor-gerimes, deað ungemete neah : "Nu ic suna minum syllan wolde "guð-gewædu, þær me gifeðe swa "ænig yrfe-weard æfter wurde, "lice gelenge.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Ic þās lēode hēold "fīftig wintra: næs se folc-cyning "ymbe-sittendra ǣnig þāra, "þē mec gūð-winum grētan dorste, "egesan þēon.
text_bare: Ic þas leode heold "fiftig wintra: næs se folc-cyning "ymbe-sittendra ænig þara, "þe mec guð-winum gretan dorste, "egesan þeon.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Ic on earde bād "mǣl-gesceafta, hēold mīn tela, "ne sōhte searo-nīðas, nē mē swōr fela "āða on unriht.
text_bare: Ic on earde bad "mæl-gesceafta, heold min tela, "ne sohte searo-niðas, ne me swor fela "aða on unriht.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Ic þæs ealles mæg, "feorh-bennum sēoc, gefēan habban: "forþām mē wītan ne þearf waldend fīra "morðor-bealo māga, þonne mīn sceaceð "līf of līce.
text_bare: Ic þæs ealles mæg, "feorh-bennum seoc, gefean habban: "forþam me witan ne þearf waldend fira "morðor-bealo maga, þonne min sceaceð "lif of lice.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: Nū þū lungre "geong, hord scēawian under hārne stān, "Wīglāf lēofa, nū se wyrm ligeð, "swefeð sāre wund, since berēafod.
text_bare: Nu þu lungre "geong, hord sceawian under harne stan, "Wiglaf leofa, nu se wyrm ligeð, "swefeð sare wund, since bereafod.

section: XXXVII. BEOWULF WOUNDED TO DEATH.
text: "Bīo nū on ofoste, þæt ic ǣr-welan, "gold-ǣht ongite, gearo scēawige "swegle searo-gimmas, þæt ic þȳ sēft mǣge "æfter māððum-welan mīn ālǣtan "līf and lēod-scipe, þone ic longe hēold."
text_bare: "Bio nu on ofoste, þæt ic ær-welan, "gold-æht ongite, gearo sceawige "swegle searo-gimmas, þæt ic þy seft mæge "æfter maððum-welan min alætan "lif and leod-scipe, þone ic longe heold."

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: Þā ic snūde gefrægn sunu Wīhstānes æfter word-cwydum wundum dryhtne hȳran heaðo-sīocum, hring-net beran, brogdne beadu-sercean under beorges hrōf.
text_bare: Þa ic snude gefrægn sunu Wihstanes æfter word-cwydum wundum dryhtne hyran heaðo-siocum, hring-net beran, brogdne beadu-sercean under beorges hrof.

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: Geseah þā sige-hrēðig, þā hē bī sesse gēong, mago-þegn mōdig māððum-sigla fela, gold glitinian grunde getenge, wundur on wealle and þæs wyrmes denn, ealdes ūht-flogan, orcas stondan, fyrn-manna fatu feormend-lēase, hyrstum behrorene: þǣr wæs helm monig, eald and ōmig, earm-bēaga fela, searwum gesǣled.
text_bare: Geseah þa sige-hreðig, þa he bi sesse geong, mago-þegn modig maððum-sigla fela, gold glitinian grunde getenge, wundur on wealle and þæs wyrmes denn, ealdes uht-flogan, orcas stondan, fyrn-manna fatu feormend-lease, hyrstum behrorene: þær wæs helm monig, eald and omig, earm-beaga fela, searwum gesæled.

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: Sinc ēaðe mæg, gold on grunde, gumena cynnes gehwone ofer-hīgian, hȳde sē þe wylle!
text_bare: Sinc eaðe mæg, gold on grunde, gumena cynnes gehwone ofer-higian, hyde se þe wylle!

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: Swylce hē siomian geseah segn eall-gylden hēah ofer horde, hond-wundra mǣst, gelocen leoðo-cræftum: of þām lēoma stōd, þæt hē þone grund-wong ongitan meahte, wrǣte giond-wlītan.
text_bare: Swylce he siomian geseah segn eall-gylden heah ofer horde, hond-wundra mæst, gelocen leoðo-cræftum: of þam leoma stod, þæt he þone grund-wong ongitan meahte, wræte giond-wlitan.

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: Næs þæs wyrmes þǣr onsȳn ǣnig, ac hyne ecg fornam.
text_bare: Næs þæs wyrmes þær onsyn ænig, ac hyne ecg fornam.

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: Þā ic on hlǣwe gefrægn hord rēafian, eald enta geweorc ānne mannan, him on bearm hladan bunan and discas sylfes dōme, segn ēac genom, bēacna beorhtost; bill ǣr-gescōd ecg wæs īren eald-hlāfordes þām þāra māðma mund-bora wæs longe hwīle, līg-egesan wæg hātne for horde, hioro-weallende, middel-nihtum, oð þæt hē morðre swealt.
text_bare: Þa ic on hlæwe gefrægn hord reafian, eald enta geweorc anne mannan, him on bearm hladan bunan and discas sylfes dome, segn eac genom, beacna beorhtost; bill ær-gescod ecg wæs iren eald-hlafordes þam þara maðma mund-bora wæs longe hwile, lig-egesan wæg hatne for horde, hioro-weallende, middel-nihtum, oð þæt he morðre swealt.

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: Ār wæs on ofoste eft-sīðes georn, frætwum gefyrðred: hyne fyrwet bræc, hwæðer collen-ferð cwicne gemētte in þām wong-stede Wedra þēoden, ellen-sīocne, þǣr hē hine ǣr forlēt.
text_bare: Ar wæs on ofoste eft-siðes georn, frætwum gefyrðred: hyne fyrwet bræc, hwæðer collen-ferð cwicne gemette in þam wong-stede Wedra þeoden, ellen-siocne, þær he hine ær forlet.

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: Hē þā mid þām māðmum mǣrne þīoden, dryhten sīnne drīorigne fand ealdres æt ende: hē hine eft ongon wæteres weorpan, oð þæt wordes ord brēost-hord þurhbræc.
text_bare: He þa mid þam maðmum mærne þioden, dryhten sinne driorigne fand ealdres æt ende: he hine eft ongon wæteres weorpan, oð þæt wordes ord breost-hord þurhbræc.

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: Bēowulf maðelode, gomel on giohðe gold scēawode : "Ic þāra frætwa frēan ealles þanc "wuldur-cyninge wordum secge, "ēcum dryhtne, þē ic hēr on starie, "þæs þe ic mōste mīnum lēodum "ǣr swylt-dæge swylc gestrȳnan.
text_bare: Beowulf maðelode, gomel on giohðe gold sceawode : "Ic þara frætwa frean ealles þanc "wuldur-cyninge wordum secge, "ecum dryhtne, þe ic her on starie, "þæs þe ic moste minum leodum "ær swylt-dæge swylc gestrynan.

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: "Nū ic on māðma hord mīne bebohte "frōde feorh-lege, fremmað gē nū "lēoda þearfe; ne mæg ic hēr leng wesan.
text_bare: "Nu ic on maðma hord mine bebohte "frode feorh-lege, fremmað ge nu "leoda þearfe; ne mæg ic her leng wesan.

section: XXXVIII. THE JEWEL-HOARD. THE PASSING OF BEOWULF.
text: "Hātað heaðo-mǣre hlǣw gewyrcean, "beorhtne æfter bǣle æt brimes nosan; "se scel tō gemyndum mīnum lēodum "hēah hlīfian on Hrones næsse, "þæt hit sǣ-līðend syððan hātan "Bīowulfes biorh, þā þe brentingas "ofer flōda genipu feorran drīfað." Dyde him of healse hring gyldenne þīoden þrīst-hȳdig, þegne gesealde, geongum gār-wigan, gold-fāhne helm, bēah and byrnan, hēt hyne brūcan well: "Þū eart ende-lāf ūsses cynnes, "Wǣgmundinga; ealle Wyrd forswēof, "mīne māgas tō metod-sceafte, "eorlas on elne: ic him æfter sceal." Þæt wæs þām gomelan gingeste word brēost-gehygdum, ǣr hē bǣl cure, hāte heaðo-wylmas: him of hreðre gewāt sāwol sēcean sōð-fæstra dōm.
text_bare: "Hatað heaðo-mære hlæw gewyrcean, "beorhtne æfter bæle æt brimes nosan; "se scel to gemyndum minum leodum "heah hlifian on Hrones næsse, "þæt hit sæ-liðend syððan hatan "Biowulfes biorh, þa þe brentingas "ofer floda genipu feorran drifað." Dyde him of healse hring gyldenne þioden þrist-hydig, þegne gesealde, geongum gar-wigan, gold-fahne helm, beah and byrnan, het hyne brucan well: "Þu eart ende-laf usses cynnes, "Wægmundinga; ealle Wyrd forsweof, "mine magas to metod-sceafte, "eorlas on elne: ic him æfter sceal." Þæt wæs þam gomelan gingeste word breost-gehygdum, ær he bæl cure, hate heaðo-wylmas: him of hreðre gewat sawol secean soð-fæstra dom.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Þā wæs gegongen guman unfrōdum earfoðlīce, þæt hē on eorðan geseah þone lēofestan līfes æt ende blēate gebǣran.
text_bare: Þa wæs gegongen guman unfrodum earfoðlice, þæt he on eorðan geseah þone leofestan lifes æt ende bleate gebæran.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Bona swylce læg, egeslīc eorð-draca, ealdre berēafod, bealwe gebǣded: bēah-hordum leng wyrm wōh-bogen wealdan ne mōste, ac him īrenna ecga fornāmon, hearde heaðo-scearpe homera lāfe, þæt se wīd-floga wundum stille hrēas on hrūsan hord-ærne nēah, nalles æfter lyfte lācende hwearf middel-nihtum, māðm-ǣhta wlonc ansȳn ȳwde: ac hē eorðan gefēoll for þæs hild-fruman hond-geweorce.
text_bare: Bona swylce læg, egeslic eorð-draca, ealdre bereafod, bealwe gebæded: beah-hordum leng wyrm woh-bogen wealdan ne moste, ac him irenna ecga fornamon, hearde heaðo-scearpe homera lafe, þæt se wid-floga wundum stille hreas on hrusan hord-ærne neah, nalles æfter lyfte lacende hwearf middel-nihtum, maðm-æhta wlonc ansyn ywde: ac he eorðan gefeoll for þæs hild-fruman hond-geweorce.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Hūru þæt on lande lȳt manna þāh mægen-āgendra mīne gefrǣge, þēah þe hē dǣda gehwæs dyrstig wǣre, þæt hē wið attor-sceaðan oreðe gerǣsde, oððe hring-sele hondum styrede, gif hē wæccende weard onfunde būan on beorge.
text_bare: Huru þæt on lande lyt manna þah mægen-agendra mine gefræge, þeah þe he dæda gehwæs dyrstig wære, þæt he wið attor-sceaðan oreðe geræsde, oððe hring-sele hondum styrede, gif he wæccende weard onfunde buan on beorge.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Bīowulfe wearð dryht-māðma dǣl dēaðe forgolden; hæfde ǣghwæðer ende gefēred lǣnan līfes.
text_bare: Biowulfe wearð dryht-maðma dæl deaðe forgolden; hæfde æghwæðer ende gefered lænan lifes.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Næs þā lang tō þon, þæt þā hild-latan holt ofgēfan, tȳdre trēow-logan tȳne ætsomne, þā ne dorston ǣr dareðum lācan on hyra man-dryhtnes miclan þearfe; ac hȳ scamiende scyldas bǣran, gūð-gewǣdu, þǣr se gomela læg: wlitan on Wīglāf.
text_bare: Næs þa lang to þon, þæt þa hild-latan holt ofgefan, tydre treow-logan tyne ætsomne, þa ne dorston ær dareðum lacan on hyra man-dryhtnes miclan þearfe; ac hy scamiende scyldas bæran, guð-gewædu, þær se gomela læg: wlitan on Wiglaf.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Hē gewērgad sæt, fēðe-cempa frēan eaxlum nēah, wehte hyne wætre; him wiht ne spēow; ne meahte hē on eorðan, þēah hē ūðe wēl, on þām frum-gāre feorh gehealdan, nē þæs wealdendes willan wiht oncirran; wolde dōm godes dǣdum rǣdan gumena gehwylcum, swā hē nū gēn dēð.
text_bare: He gewergad sæt, feðe-cempa frean eaxlum neah, wehte hyne wætre; him wiht ne speow; ne meahte he on eorðan, þeah he uðe wel, on þam frum-gare feorh gehealdan, ne þæs wealdendes willan wiht oncirran; wolde dom godes dædum rædan gumena gehwylcum, swa he nu gen deð.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Þā wæs æt þām geongan grim andswaru ēð-begēte þām þe ǣr his elne forlēas.
text_bare: Þa wæs æt þam geongan grim andswaru eð-begete þam þe ær his elne forleas.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Wīglāf maðelode, Wēohstānes sunu, secg sārig-ferð seah on unlēofe: "Þæt lā mæg secgan, sē þe wyle sōð sprecan, "þæt se mon-dryhten, se ēow þā māðmas geaf, "ēored-geatwe, þē gē þǣr on standað, "þonne hē on ealu-bence oft gesealde "heal-sittendum helm and byrnan, "þēoden his þegnum, swylce hē þrȳðlīcost "ōhwǣr feor oððe nēah findan meahte, "þæt hē gēnunga gūð-gewǣdu "wrāðe forwurpe.
text_bare: Wiglaf maðelode, Weohstanes sunu, secg sarig-ferð seah on unleofe: "Þæt la mæg secgan, se þe wyle soð sprecan, "þæt se mon-dryhten, se eow þa maðmas geaf, "eored-geatwe, þe ge þær on standað, "þonne he on ealu-bence oft gesealde "heal-sittendum helm and byrnan, "þeoden his þegnum, swylce he þryðlicost "ohwær feor oððe neah findan meahte, "þæt he genunga guð-gewædu "wraðe forwurpe.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Þā hyne wīg beget, "nealles folc-cyning fyrd-gesteallum "gylpan þorfte; hwæðre him god ūðe, "sigora waldend, þæt hē hyne sylfne gewræc "āna mid ecge, þā him wæs elnes þearf, "Ic him līf-wraðe lȳtle meahte "ætgifan æt gūðe and ongan swā þēah "ofer mīn gemet mǣges helpan: "symle wæs þȳ sǣmra, þonne ic sweorde drep "ferhð-genīðlan, fȳr unswīðor "wēoll of gewitte.
text_bare: Þa hyne wig beget, "nealles folc-cyning fyrd-gesteallum "gylpan þorfte; hwæðre him god uðe, "sigora waldend, þæt he hyne sylfne gewræc "ana mid ecge, þa him wæs elnes þearf, "Ic him lif-wraðe lytle meahte "ætgifan æt guðe and ongan swa þeah "ofer min gemet mæges helpan: "symle wæs þy sæmra, þonne ic sweorde drep "ferhð-geniðlan, fyr unswiðor "weoll of gewitte.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Wergendra tō lȳt "þrong ymbe þēoden, þā hyne sīo þrāg becwōm.
text_bare: Wergendra to lyt "þrong ymbe þeoden, þa hyne sio þrag becwom.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: "Nū sceal sinc-þego and swyrd-gifu "eall ēðel-wyn ēowrum cynne, "lufen ālicgean: lond-rihtes mōt "þǣre mǣg-burge monna ǣghwylc "īdel hweorfan, syððan æðelingas "feorran gefricgean flēam ēowerne, "dōm-lēasan dǣd.
text_bare: "Nu sceal sinc-þego and swyrd-gifu "eall eðel-wyn eowrum cynne, "lufen alicgean: lond-rihtes mot "þære mæg-burge monna æghwylc "idel hweorfan, syððan æðelingas "feorran gefricgean fleam eowerne, "dom-leasan dæd.

section: XXXIX. THE COWARD-THANES.
text: Dēað bið sēlla "eorla gehwylcum þonne edwīt-līf!"
text_bare: Deað bið sella "eorla gehwylcum þonne edwit-lif!"

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: Heht þā þæt heaðo-weorc tō hagan bīodan up ofer ēg-clif, þǣr þæt eorl-weorod morgen-longne dæg mōd-giōmor sæt, bord-hæbbende, bēga on wēnum ende-dōgores and eft-cymes lēofes monnes.
text_bare: Heht þa þæt heaðo-weorc to hagan biodan up ofer eg-clif, þær þæt eorl-weorod morgen-longne dæg mod-giomor sæt, bord-hæbbende, bega on wenum ende-dogores and eft-cymes leofes monnes.

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: Lȳt swīgode nīwra spella, sē þe næs gerād, ac hē sōðlīce sægde ofer ealle; "Nū is wil-geofa Wedra lēoda, "dryhten Gēata dēað-bedde fæst, "wunað wæl-reste wyrmes dǣdum; "him on efn ligeð ealdor-gewinna, "siex-bennum sēoc: sweorde ne meahte "on þām āglǣcean ǣnige þinga "wunde gewyrcean.
text_bare: Lyt swigode niwra spella, se þe næs gerad, ac he soðlice sægde ofer ealle; "Nu is wil-geofa Wedra leoda, "dryhten Geata deað-bedde fæst, "wunað wæl-reste wyrmes dædum; "him on efn ligeð ealdor-gewinna, "siex-bennum seoc: sweorde ne meahte "on þam aglæcean ænige þinga "wunde gewyrcean.

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: Wīglāf siteð "ofer Bīowulfe, byre Wīhstānes, "eorl ofer ōðrum unlifigendum, "healdeð hige-mēðum hēafod-wearde "lēofes and lāðes.
text_bare: Wiglaf siteð "ofer Biowulfe, byre Wihstanes, "eorl ofer oðrum unlifigendum, "healdeð hige-meðum heafod-wearde "leofes and laðes.

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: Nū ys lēodum wēn "orleg-hwīle, syððan underne "Froncum and Frȳsum fyll cyninges "wīde weorðeð.
text_bare: Nu ys leodum wen "orleg-hwile, syððan underne "Froncum and Frysum fyll cyninges "wide weorðeð.

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: Wæs sīo wrōht scepen "heard wið Hūgas, syððan Higelāc cwōm "faran flot-herge on Frēsna land, "þǣr hyne Hetware hilde gehnǣgdon, "elne geēodon mid ofer-mægene, "þæt se byrn-wiga būgan sceolde, "fēoll on fēðan: nalles frætwe geaf "ealdor dugoðe; ūs wæs ā syððan "Merewīoinga milts ungyfeðe.
text_bare: Wæs sio wroht scepen "heard wið Hugas, syððan Higelac cwom "faran flot-herge on Fresna land, "þær hyne Hetware hilde gehnægdon, "elne geeodon mid ofer-mægene, "þæt se byrn-wiga bugan sceolde, "feoll on feðan: nalles frætwe geaf "ealdor dugoðe; us wæs a syððan "Merewioinga milts ungyfeðe.

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: "Nē ic tō Swēo-þēode sibbe oððe trēowe "wihte ne wēne; ac wæs wīde cūð, "þætte Ongenþīo ealdre besnyðede "Hæðcyn Hrēðling wið Hrefna-wudu, "þā for on-mēdlan ǣrest gesōhton "Gēata lēode Gūð-scilfingas.
text_bare: "Ne ic to Sweo-þeode sibbe oððe treowe "wihte ne wene; ac wæs wide cuð, "þætte Ongenþio ealdre besnyðede "Hæðcyn Hreðling wið Hrefna-wudu, "þa for on-medlan ærest gesohton "Geata leode Guð-scilfingas.

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: "Sōna him se frōda fæder Ōhtheres, "eald and eges-full ond-slyht āgeaf, "ābrēot brim-wīsan, brȳd āhēorde, "gomela īo-meowlan golde berofene, "Onelan mōdor and Ōhtheres, "and þā folgode feorh-genīðlan "oð þæt hī oðēodon earfoðlīce "in Hrefnes-holt hlāford-lēase.
text_bare: "Sona him se froda fæder Ohtheres, "eald and eges-full ond-slyht ageaf, "abreot brim-wisan, bryd aheorde, "gomela io-meowlan golde berofene, "Onelan modor and Ohtheres, "and þa folgode feorh-geniðlan "oð þæt hi oðeodon earfoðlice "in Hrefnes-holt hlaford-lease.

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: "Besæt þā sin-herge sweorda lāfe "wundum wērge, wēan oft gehēt "earmre teohhe andlonge niht: "cwæð hē on mergenne mēces ecgum "gētan wolde, sume on galg-trēowum "fuglum tō gamene.
text_bare: "Besæt þa sin-herge sweorda lafe "wundum werge, wean oft gehet "earmre teohhe andlonge niht: "cwæð he on mergenne meces ecgum "getan wolde, sume on galg-treowum "fuglum to gamene.

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: Frōfor eft gelamp "sārig-mōdum somod ǣr-dæge, "syððan hīe Hygelāces horn and bȳman "gealdor ongeāton.
text_bare: Frofor eft gelamp "sarig-modum somod ær-dæge, "syððan hie Hygelaces horn and byman "gealdor ongeaton.

section: XL. THE SOLDIER'S DIRGE AND PROPHECY.
text: Þā se gōda cōm "lēoda dugoðe on lāst faran.
text_bare: Þa se goda com "leoda dugoðe on last faran.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: "Wæs sīo swāt-swaðu Swēona and Gēata, "wæl-rǣs wera wīde gesȳne, "hū þā folc mid him fǣhðe tōwehton.
text_bare: "Wæs sio swat-swaðu Sweona and Geata, "wæl-ræs wera wide gesyne, "hu þa folc mid him fæhðe towehton.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: "Gewāt him þā se gōda mid his gædelingum, "frōd fela geōmor fæsten sēcean, "eorl Ongenþīo ufor oncirde; "hæfde Higelāces hilde gefrūnen, "wlonces wīg-cræft, wiðres ne truwode, "þæt hē sǣ-mannum onsacan mihte, "hēaðo-līðendum hord forstandan, "bearn and brȳde; bēah eft þonan "eald under eorð-weall.
text_bare: "Gewat him þa se goda mid his gædelingum, "frod fela geomor fæsten secean, "eorl Ongenþio ufor oncirde; "hæfde Higelaces hilde gefrunen, "wlonces wig-cræft, wiðres ne truwode, "þæt he sæ-mannum onsacan mihte, "heaðo-liðendum hord forstandan, "bearn and bryde; beah eft þonan "eald under eorð-weall.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: Þā wæs ǣht boden "Swēona lēodum, segn Higelāce.
text_bare: Þa wæs æht boden "Sweona leodum, segn Higelace.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: "Freoðo-wong þone forð oferēodon, "syððan Hrēðlingas tō hagan þrungon.
text_bare: "Freoðo-wong þone forð ofereodon, "syððan Hreðlingas to hagan þrungon.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: "Þǣr wearð Ongenþīo ecgum sweorda, "blonden-fexa on bīd wrecen, "þæt se þēod-cyning þafian sceolde "Eofores ānne dōm: hyne yrringa "Wulf Wonrēding wǣpne gerǣhte, "þæt him for swenge swāt ǣdrum sprong "forð under fexe.
text_bare: "Þær wearð Ongenþio ecgum sweorda, "blonden-fexa on bid wrecen, "þæt se þeod-cyning þafian sceolde "Eofores anne dom: hyne yrringa "Wulf Wonreding wæpne geræhte, "þæt him for swenge swat ædrum sprong "forð under fexe.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: Næs hē forht swā þēh, "gomela Scilfing, ac forgeald hraðe "wyrsan wrixle wæl-hlem þone, "syððan þēod-cyning þyder oncirde: "ne meahte se snella sunu Wonrēdes "ealdum ceorle ond-slyht giofan, "ac hē him on hēafde helm ǣr gescer, "þæt hē blōde fāh būgan sceolde, "fēoll on foldan; næs hē fǣge þā gīt, "ac hē hyne gewyrpte, þēah þe him wund hrīne, "Lēt se hearda Higelāces þegn "brādne mēce, þā his brōðor læg, "eald sweord eotonisc, entiscne helm, "brecan ofer bord-weal: þā gebēah cyning, "folces hyrde, wæs in feorh dropen.
text_bare: Næs he forht swa þeh, "gomela Scilfing, ac forgeald hraðe "wyrsan wrixle wæl-hlem þone, "syððan þeod-cyning þyder oncirde: "ne meahte se snella sunu Wonredes "ealdum ceorle ond-slyht giofan, "ac he him on heafde helm ær gescer, "þæt he blode fah bugan sceolde, "feoll on foldan; næs he fæge þa git, "ac he hyne gewyrpte, þeah þe him wund hrine, "Let se hearda Higelaces þegn "bradne mece, þa his broðor læg, "eald sweord eotonisc, entiscne helm, "brecan ofer bord-weal: þa gebeah cyning, "folces hyrde, wæs in feorh dropen.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: "Þā wǣron monige, þē his mǣg wriðon, "ricone ārǣrdon, þā him gerȳmed wearð, "þæt hīe wæl-stōwe wealdan mōston.
text_bare: "Þa wæron monige, þe his mæg wriðon, "ricone arærdon, þa him gerymed wearð, "þæt hie wæl-stowe wealdan moston.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: "Þenden rēafode rinc ōðerne, "nam on Ongenþīo īren-byrnan, "heard swyrd hilted and his helm somod; "hāres hyrste Higelāce bær.
text_bare: "Þenden reafode rinc oðerne, "nam on Ongenþio iren-byrnan, "heard swyrd hilted and his helm somod; "hares hyrste Higelace bær.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: "Hē þām frætwum fēng and him fægre gehēt "lēana fore lēodum and gelǣste swā: "geald þone gūð-rǣs Gēata dryhten, "Hrēðles eafora, þā hē tō hām becōm, "Jofore and Wulfe mid ofer-māðmum, "sealde hiora gehwæðrum hund þūsenda "landes and locenra bēaga; ne þorfte him þā lēan oðwītan "mon on middan-gearde, syððan hīe þā mǣrða geslōgon; "and þā Jofore forgeaf āngan dōhtor, "hām-weorðunge, hyldo tō wedde.
text_bare: "He þam frætwum feng and him fægre gehet "leana fore leodum and gelæste swa: "geald þone guð-ræs Geata dryhten, "Hreðles eafora, þa he to ham becom, "Jofore and Wulfe mid ofer-maðmum, "sealde hiora gehwæðrum hund þusenda "landes and locenra beaga; ne þorfte him þa lean oðwitan "mon on middan-gearde, syððan hie þa mærða geslogon; "and þa Jofore forgeaf angan dohtor, "ham-weorðunge, hyldo to wedde.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: "Þæt ys sīo fǣhðo and se fēond-scipe, "wæl-nīð wera, þæs þe ic wēn hafo, "þē ūs sēceað tō Swēona lēode, "syððan hīe gefricgeað frēan ūserne "ealdor-lēasne, þone þe ǣr gehēold "wið hettendum hord and rīce, "æfter hæleða hryre hwate Scylfingas, "folc-rǣd fremede oððe furður gēn "eorl-scipe efnde.
text_bare: "Þæt ys sio fæhðo and se feond-scipe, "wæl-nið wera, þæs þe ic wen hafo, "þe us seceað to Sweona leode, "syððan hie gefricgeað frean userne "ealdor-leasne, þone þe ær geheold "wið hettendum hord and rice, "æfter hæleða hryre hwate Scylfingas, "folc-ræd fremede oððe furður gen "eorl-scipe efnde.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: Nū is ofost betost, "þæt wē þēod-cyning þǣr scēawian "and þone gebringan, þē ūs bēagas geaf, "on ād-fære.
text_bare: Nu is ofost betost, "þæt we þeod-cyning þær sceawian "and þone gebringan, þe us beagas geaf, "on ad-fære.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: Ne scel ānes hwæt "meltan mid þām mōdigan, ac þǣr is māðma hord.
text_bare: Ne scel anes hwæt "meltan mid þam modigan, ac þær is maðma hord.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: "gold unrīme grimme gecēapod "and nū æt sīðestan sylfes fēore "bēagas gebohte; þā sceal brond fretan, "ǣled þeccean, nalles eorl wegan "māððum tō gemyndum, nē mægð scȳne "habban on healse hring-weorðunge, "ac sceall geōmor-mōd golde berēafod "oft nalles ǣne el-land tredan, "nū se here-wīsa hleahtor ālegde, "gamen and glēo-drēam.
text_bare: "gold unrime grimme geceapod "and nu æt siðestan sylfes feore "beagas gebohte; þa sceal brond fretan, "æled þeccean, nalles eorl wegan "maððum to gemyndum, ne mægð scyne "habban on healse hring-weorðunge, "ac sceall geomor-mod golde bereafod "oft nalles æne el-land tredan, "nu se here-wisa hleahtor alegde, "gamen and gleo-dream.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: Forþon sceall gār wesan "monig morgen-ceald mundum bewunden, "hæfen on handa, nalles hearpan swēg "wīgend weccean, ac se wonna hrefn "fūs ofer fǣgum, fela reordian, "earne secgan, hū him æt ǣte spēow, "þenden hē wið wulf wæl rēafode." Swā se secg hwata secgende wæs lāðra spella; hē ne lēag fela wyrda nē worda.
text_bare: Forþon sceall gar wesan "monig morgen-ceald mundum bewunden, "hæfen on handa, nalles hearpan sweg "wigend weccean, ac se wonna hrefn "fus ofer fægum, fela reordian, "earne secgan, hu him æt æte speow, "þenden he wið wulf wæl reafode." Swa se secg hwata secgende wæs laðra spella; he ne leag fela wyrda ne worda.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: Weorod eall ārās, ēodon unblīðe under Earna næs wollen-tēare wundur scēawian.
text_bare: Weorod eall aras, eodon unbliðe under Earna næs wollen-teare wundur sceawian.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: Fundon þā on sande sāwul-lēasne hlim-bed healdan, þone þe him hringas geaf ǣrran mǣlum: þā wæs ende-dæg gōdum gegongen, þæt se gūð-cyning, Wedra þēoden, wundor-dēaðe swealt.
text_bare: Fundon þa on sande sawul-leasne hlim-bed healdan, þone þe him hringas geaf ærran mælum: þa wæs ende-dæg godum gegongen, þæt se guð-cyning, Wedra þeoden, wundor-deaðe swealt.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: Ǣr hī gesēgan syllīcran wiht, wyrm on wonge wiðer-ræhtes þǣr lāðne licgean: wæs se lēg-draca, grimlīc gryre-gæst, glēdum beswǣled, sē wæs fīftiges fōt-gemearces.
text_bare: Ær hi gesegan syllicran wiht, wyrm on wonge wiðer-ræhtes þær laðne licgean: wæs se leg-draca, grimlic gryre-gæst, gledum beswæled, se wæs fiftiges fot-gemearces.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: lang on legere, lyft-wynne hēold nihtes hwīlum, nyðer eft gewāt dennes nīosian; wæs þā dēaðe fæst, hæfde eorð-scrafa ende genyttod.
text_bare: lang on legere, lyft-wynne heold nihtes hwilum, nyðer eft gewat dennes niosian; wæs þa deaðe fæst, hæfde eorð-scrafa ende genyttod.

section: XLI. HE TELLS OF THE SWEDES AND THE GEATAS
text: Him big stōdan bunan and orcas, discas lāgon and dȳre swyrd, ōmige þurh-etone, swā hīe wið eorðan fæðm þūsend wintra þǣr eardodon: þonne wæs þæt yrfe ēacen-cræftig, iū-monna gold galdre bewunden, þæt þām hring-sele hrīnan ne mōste gumena ǣnig, nefne god sylfa, sigora sōð-cyning, sealde þām þe hē wolde hē is manna gehyld hord openian, efne swā hwylcum manna, swā him gemet þūhte.
text_bare: Him big stodan bunan and orcas, discas lagon and dyre swyrd, omige þurh-etone, swa hie wið eorðan fæðm þusend wintra þær eardodon: þonne wæs þæt yrfe eacen-cræftig, iu-monna gold galdre bewunden, þæt þam hring-sele hrinan ne moste gumena ænig, nefne god sylfa, sigora soð-cyning, sealde þam þe he wolde he is manna gehyld hord openian, efne swa hwylcum manna, swa him gemet þuhte.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Þā wæs gesȳne, þæt se sīð ne þāh þām þe unrihte inne gehȳdde wrǣte under wealle.
text_bare: Þa wæs gesyne, þæt se sið ne þah þam þe unrihte inne gehydde wræte under wealle.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Weard ǣr ofslōh fēara sumne; þā sīo fǣhð gewearð gewrecen wrāðlīce.
text_bare: Weard ær ofsloh feara sumne; þa sio fæhð gewearð gewrecen wraðlice.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Wundur hwār, þonne eorl ellen-rōf ende gefēre līf-gesceafta, þonne leng ne mæg mon mid his māgum medu-seld būan.
text_bare: Wundur hwar, þonne eorl ellen-rof ende gefere lif-gesceafta, þonne leng ne mæg mon mid his magum medu-seld buan.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Swā wæs Bīowulfe, þā hē biorges weard sōhte, searo-nīðas: seolfa ne cūðe, þurh hwæt his worulde gedāl weorðan sceolde; swā hit oð dōmes dæg dīope benemdon þēodnas mǣre, þā þæt þǣr dydon, þæt se secg wǣre synnum scildig, hergum geheaðerod, hell-bendum fæst, wommum gewītnad, sē þone wong strāde.
text_bare: Swa wæs Biowulfe, þa he biorges weard sohte, searo-niðas: seolfa ne cuðe, þurh hwæt his worulde gedal weorðan sceolde; swa hit oð domes dæg diope benemdon þeodnas mære, þa þæt þær dydon, þæt se secg wære synnum scildig, hergum geheaðerod, hell-bendum fæst, wommum gewitnad, se þone wong strade.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Næs hē gold-hwæt: gearwor hæfde āgendes ēst ǣr gescēawod.
text_bare: Næs he gold-hwæt: gearwor hæfde agendes est ær gesceawod.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Wīglāf maðelode, Wīhstānes sunu: "Oft sceall eorl monig ānes willan "wrǣc ādrēogan, swā ūs geworden is.
text_bare: Wiglaf maðelode, Wihstanes sunu: "Oft sceall eorl monig anes willan "wræc adreogan, swa us geworden is.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: "Ne meahton wē gelǣran lēofne þēoden, "rīces hyrde rǣd ǣnigne, "þæt hē ne grētte gold-weard þone, "lēte hyne licgean, þǣr hē longe wæs, "wīcum wunian oð woruld-ende.
text_bare: "Ne meahton we gelæran leofne þeoden, "rices hyrde ræd ænigne, "þæt he ne grette gold-weard þone, "lete hyne licgean, þær he longe wæs, "wicum wunian oð woruld-ende.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: "Hēoldon hēah gesceap: hord ys gescēawod, "grimme gegongen; wæs þæt gifeðe tō swīð, "þē þone þēoden þyder ontyhte.
text_bare: "Heoldon heah gesceap: hord ys gesceawod, "grimme gegongen; wæs þæt gifeðe to swið, "þe þone þeoden þyder ontyhte.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: "Ic wæs þǣr inne and þæt eall geond-seh, "recedes geatwa, þā mē gerȳmed wæs, "nealles swǣslīce sīð ālȳfed "inn under eorð-weall.
text_bare: "Ic wæs þær inne and þæt eall geond-seh, "recedes geatwa, þa me gerymed wæs, "nealles swæslice sið alyfed "inn under eorð-weall.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Ic on ofoste gefēng "micle mid mundum mægen-byrðenne "hord-gestrēona, hider ūt ætbær "cyninge mīnum: cwico wæs þā gēna, "wīs and gewittig; worn eall gespræc "gomol on gehðo and ēowic grētan hēt, "bæd þæt gē geworhton æfter wines dǣdum "in bǣl-stede beorh þone hēan "micelne and mǣrne, swā hē manna wæs "wīgend weorð-fullost wīde geond eorðan, "þenden hē burh-welan brūcan mōste.
text_bare: Ic on ofoste gefeng "micle mid mundum mægen-byrðenne "hord-gestreona, hider ut ætbær "cyninge minum: cwico wæs þa gena, "wis and gewittig; worn eall gespræc "gomol on gehðo and eowic gretan het, "bæd þæt ge geworhton æfter wines dædum "in bæl-stede beorh þone hean "micelne and mærne, swa he manna wæs "wigend weorð-fullost wide geond eorðan, "þenden he burh-welan brucan moste.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: "Uton nū efstan ōðre sīðe "sēon and sēcean searo-geþræc, "wundur under wealle!
text_bare: "Uton nu efstan oðre siðe "seon and secean searo-geþræc, "wundur under wealle!

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: ic ēow wīsige, "þæt gē genōge nēan scēawiað "bēagas and brād gold.
text_bare: ic eow wisige, "þæt ge genoge nean sceawiað "beagas and brad gold.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Sīe sīo bǣr gearo "ǣdre geæfned, þonne wē ūt cymen, "and þonne geferian frēan ūserne, "lēofne mannan, þǣr hē longe sceal "on þæs waldendes wǣre geþolian." Hēt þā gebēodan byre Wīhstānes, hæle hilde-dīor, hæleða monegum bold-āgendra, þæt hīe bǣl-wudu feorran feredon, folc-āgende gōdum tōgēnes: "Nū sceal glēd fretan " weaxan wonna lēg wigena strengel, "þone þe oft gebād īsern-scūre, "þonne strǣla storm, strengum gebǣded, "scōc ofer scild-weall, sceft nytte hēold, "feðer-gearwum fūs flāne full-ēode." Hūru se snotra sunu Wīhstānes ācīgde of corðre cyninges þegnas syfone tōsomne þā sēlestan, ēode eahta sum under inwit-hrōf; hilde-rinc sum on handa bær ǣled-lēoman, sē þe on orde gēong.
text_bare: Sie sio bær gearo "ædre geæfned, þonne we ut cymen, "and þonne geferian frean userne, "leofne mannan, þær he longe sceal "on þæs waldendes wære geþolian." Het þa gebeodan byre Wihstanes, hæle hilde-dior, hæleða monegum bold-agendra, þæt hie bæl-wudu feorran feredon, folc-agende godum togenes: "Nu sceal gled fretan " weaxan wonna leg wigena strengel, "þone þe oft gebad isern-scure, "þonne stræla storm, strengum gebæded, "scoc ofer scild-weall, sceft nytte heold, "feðer-gearwum fus flane full-eode." Huru se snotra sunu Wihstanes acigde of corðre cyninges þegnas syfone tosomne þa selestan, eode eahta sum under inwit-hrof; hilde-rinc sum on handa bær æled-leoman, se þe on orde geong.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Næs þā on hlytme, hwā þæt hord strude, syððan or-wearde ǣnigne dǣl secgas gesēgon on sele wunian, lǣne licgan: lȳt ǣnig mearn, þæt hī ofostlice ūt geferedon dȳre māðmas; dracan ēc scufun, wyrm ofer weall-clif, lēton wǣg niman, flōd fæðmian frætwa hyrde.
text_bare: Næs þa on hlytme, hwa þæt hord strude, syððan or-wearde ænigne dæl secgas gesegon on sele wunian, læne licgan: lyt ænig mearn, þæt hi ofostlice ut geferedon dyre maðmas; dracan ec scufun, wyrm ofer weall-clif, leton wæg niman, flod fæðmian frætwa hyrde.

section: XLII. WIGLAF SPEAKS. THE BUILDING OF THE BALE-FIRE.
text: Þǣr wæs wunden gold on wǣn hladen, ǣghwæs unrīm, æðeling boren, hār hilde-rinc tō Hrones næsse.
text_bare: Þær wæs wunden gold on wæn hladen, æghwæs unrim, æðeling boren, har hilde-rinc to Hrones næsse.

section: XLIII. BEOWULF'S FUNERAL PYRE.
text: Him þā gegiredan Gēata lēode ād on eorðan un-wāclīcne, helmum behongen, hilde-bordum, beorhtum byrnum, swā hē bēna wæs; ālegdon þā tō-middes mǣrne þēoden hæleð hīofende, hlāford lēofne.
text_bare: Him þa gegiredan Geata leode ad on eorðan un-waclicne, helmum behongen, hilde-bordum, beorhtum byrnum, swa he bena wæs; alegdon þa to-middes mærne þeoden hæleð hiofende, hlaford leofne.

section: XLIII. BEOWULF'S FUNERAL PYRE.
text: Ongunnon þā on beorge bǣl-fȳra mǣst wīgend weccan: wudu-rēc āstāh sweart ofer swioðole, swōgende lēg, wōpe bewunden wind-blond gelæg oð þæt hē þā bān-hūs gebrocen hæfde, hāt on hreðre.
text_bare: Ongunnon þa on beorge bæl-fyra mæst wigend weccan: wudu-rec astah sweart ofer swioðole, swogende leg, wope bewunden wind-blond gelæg oð þæt he þa ban-hus gebrocen hæfde, hat on hreðre.

section: XLIII. BEOWULF'S FUNERAL PYRE.
text: Higum unrōte mōd-ceare mǣndon mon-dryhtnes cwealm; swylce giōmor-gyd lat .
text_bare: Higum unrote mod-ceare mændon mon-dryhtnes cwealm; swylce giomor-gyd lat .

section: XLIII. BEOWULF'S FUNERAL PYRE.
text: Geworhton þā Wedra lēode hlǣw on hlīðe, sē wæs hēah and brād, wǣg-līðendum wīde gesȳne, and betimbredon on tȳn dagum beadu-rōfes bēcn: bronda betost wealle beworhton, swā hyt weorðlīcost fore-snotre men findan mihton.
text_bare: Geworhton þa Wedra leode hlæw on hliðe, se wæs heah and brad, wæg-liðendum wide gesyne, and betimbredon on tyn dagum beadu-rofes becn: bronda betost wealle beworhton, swa hyt weorðlicost fore-snotre men findan mihton.

section: XLIII. BEOWULF'S FUNERAL PYRE.
text: Hī on beorg dydon bēg and siglu, eall swylce hyrsta, swylce on horde ǣr nīð-hȳdige men genumen hæfdon; forlēton eorla gestrēon eorðan healdan, gold on grēote, þǣr hit nū gēn lifað eldum swā unnyt, swā hit ǣror wæs.
text_bare: Hi on beorg dydon beg and siglu, eall swylce hyrsta, swylce on horde ær nið-hydige men genumen hæfdon; forleton eorla gestreon eorðan healdan, gold on greote, þær hit nu gen lifað eldum swa unnyt, swa hit æror wæs.

section: XLIII. BEOWULF'S FUNERAL PYRE.
text: Þā ymbe hlǣw riodan hilde-dēore, æðelinga bearn ealra twelfa, woldon ceare cwīðan, kyning mǣnan, word-gyd wrecan and ymb wer sprecan, eahtodan eorl-scipe and his ellen-weorc duguðum dēmdon, swā hit ge-dēfe bið, þæt mon his wine-dryhten wordum herge, ferhðum frēoge, þonne hē forð scile of līc-haman lǣne weorðan.
text_bare: Þa ymbe hlæw riodan hilde-deore, æðelinga bearn ealra twelfa, woldon ceare cwiðan, kyning mænan, word-gyd wrecan and ymb wer sprecan, eahtodan eorl-scipe and his ellen-weorc duguðum demdon, swa hit ge-defe bið, þæt mon his wine-dryhten wordum herge, ferhðum freoge, þonne he forð scile of lic-haman læne weorðan.

section: XLIII. BEOWULF'S FUNERAL PYRE.
text: Swā begnornodon Gēata lēode hlāfordes hryre, heorð-genēatas, cwǣdon þæt hē wǣre woruld-cyning mannum mildust and mon-þwǣrust, lēodum līðost and lof-geornost.
text_bare: Swa begnornodon Geata leode hlafordes hryre, heorð-geneatas, cwædon þæt he wære woruld-cyning mannum mildust and mon-þwærust, leodum liðost and lof-geornost.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: Nū scȳneð þes mōna "waðol under wolcnum; nū ārīsað wēa-dǣda, "þē þisne folces nīð fremman willað.
text_bare: Nu scyneð þes mona "waðol under wolcnum; nu arisað wea-dæda, "þe þisne folces nið fremman willað.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: "Ac onwacnigeað nū, wīgend mīne, "hebbað ēowre handa, hicgeað on ellen, "winnað on orde, wesað on mōde!" Þā ārās monig gold-hladen þegn, gyrde hine his swurde; þā tō dura ēodon drihtlīce cempan, Sigeferð and Eaha, hyra sweord getugon, and æt ōðrum durum Ordlāf and Gūðlāf, and Hengest sylf; hwearf him on lāste.
text_bare: "Ac onwacnigeað nu, wigend mine, "hebbað eowre handa, hicgeað on ellen, "winnað on orde, wesað on mode!" Þa aras monig gold-hladen þegn, gyrde hine his swurde; þa to dura eodon drihtlice cempan, Sigeferð and Eaha, hyra sweord getugon, and æt oðrum durum Ordlaf and Guðlaf, and Hengest sylf; hwearf him on laste.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: Þā gīt Gārulf Gūðere styrode, þæt hīe swā frēolīc feorh forman sīðe tō þǣre healle durum hyrsta ne bǣran, nū hyt nīða heard ānyman wolde: ac hē frægn ofer eal undearninga, dēor-mōd hæleð, hwā þā duru hēolde.
text_bare: Þa git Garulf Guðere styrode, þæt hie swa freolic feorh forman siðe to þære healle durum hyrsta ne bæran, nu hyt niða heard anyman wolde: ac he frægn ofer eal undearninga, deor-mod hæleð, hwa þa duru heolde.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: "Sigeferð is mīn nama cwæð hē , ic eom Secgena lēod, "wrecca wīde cūð.
text_bare: "Sigeferð is min nama cwæð he , ic eom Secgena leod, "wrecca wide cuð.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: Fela ic wēana gebād, "heardra hilda; þē is gȳt hēr witod, "swæðer þū sylf tō mē sēcean wylle." Þā wæs on wealle wæl-slihta gehlyn, sceolde cēlod bord cēnum on handa bān-helm berstan.
text_bare: Fela ic weana gebad, "heardra hilda; þe is gyt her witod, "swæðer þu sylf to me secean wylle." Þa wæs on wealle wæl-slihta gehlyn, sceolde celod bord cenum on handa ban-helm berstan.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: Buruh-þelu dynede, oð þæt æt þǣre gūðe Gārulf gecrang, ealra ǣrest eorð-būendra, Gūðlāfes sunu; ymbe hine gōdra fela.
text_bare: Buruh-þelu dynede, oð þæt æt þære guðe Garulf gecrang, ealra ærest eorð-buendra, Guðlafes sunu; ymbe hine godra fela.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: Hwearf flacra hrǣw hræfn, wandrode sweart and sealo-brūn; swurd-lēoma stōd swylce eal Finns-buruh fȳrenu wǣre.
text_bare: Hwearf flacra hræw hræfn, wandrode sweart and sealo-brun; swurd-leoma stod swylce eal Finns-buruh fyrenu wære.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: Ne gefrægn ic nǣfre wurðlīcor æt wera hilde sixtig sige-beorna sēl gebǣran, ne nǣfre swānas swētne medo sēl forgyldan, þonne Hnæfe guldon his hæg-stealdas.
text_bare: Ne gefrægn ic næfre wurðlicor æt wera hilde sixtig sige-beorna sel gebæran, ne næfre swanas swetne medo sel forgyldan, þonne Hnæfe guldon his hæg-stealdas.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: Hig fuhton fīf dagas, swā hyra nān ne fēol driht-gesīða, ac hig þā duru hēoldon.
text_bare: Hig fuhton fif dagas, swa hyra nan ne feol driht-gesiða, ac hig þa duru heoldon.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: Þā gewāt him wund hæleð on wæg gangan, sǣde þæt his byrne ābrocen wǣre, here-sceorpum hrōr, and ēac wæs his helm þyrl.
text_bare: Þa gewat him wund hæleð on wæg gangan, sæde þæt his byrne abrocen wære, here-sceorpum hror, and eac wæs his helm þyrl.

section: THE ATTACK IN FINNSBURG. ‡
text: Þā hine sōna frægn folces hyrde, hū þā wīgend hyra wunda genǣson oððe hwæðer þǣra hyssa .
text_bare: Þa hine sona frægn folces hyrde, hu þa wigend hyra wunda genæson oððe hwæðer þæra hyssa .
